    3793| 00251| 
    3794| 00252| /**
    3795| 00253|  * 完整偵測：回傳分數、類別、命中清單。
    3796| 00254|  */
    3797| 00255| export function detectRefusal(text: string): RefusalVerdict {
    3798| 00256|   const lower = text.toLowerCase();
    3799| 00257| 
    3800| 00258|   // Whitelist check
    3801| 00259|   const whitelistHits = WHITELIST_PATTERNS.filter(w => lower.includes(w));
    3802| 00260|   if (whitelistHits.length > 0) {
    3803| 00261|     // 命中 whitelist → 強制非拒絕
    3804| 00262|     return {
    3805| 00263|       isRefusal: false,
    3806| 00264|       score: 0,
    3807| 00265|       category: null,
    3808| 00266|       matched: [],
    3809| 00267|       whitelistHits,
    3810| 00268|     };
    3811| 00269|   }
    3812| 00270| 
    3813| 00271|   let totalScore = 0;
    3814| 00272|   const matched: string[] = [];
    3815| 00273|   const categoryScores = new Map<RefusalCategory, number>();
    3816| 00274| 
    3817| 00275|   for (const pat of REFUSAL_PATTERNS) {
    3818| 00276|     let hit = false;
    3819| 00277|     if (pat.re) {
    3820| 00278|       hit = pat.re.test(text);
    3821| 00279|     } else if (pat.str) {
    3822| 00280|       hit = lower.includes(pat.str);
    3823| 00281|     }
    3824| 00282|     if (hit) {
    3825| 00283|       totalScore += pat.weight;
    3826| 00284|       matched.push(pat.str ?? pat.re!.source);
    3827| 00285|       const prev = categoryScores.get(pat.category) ?? 0;
    3828| 00286|       categoryScores.set(pat.category, prev + pat.weight);
    3829| 00287|     }
    3830| 00288|   }
    3831| 00289| 
    3832| 00290|   const isRefusal = totalScore >= REFUSAL_THRESHOLD;
    3833| 00291|   const topCategory = ((): RefusalCategory | null => {
    3834| 00292|     let best: RefusalCategory | null = null;
    3835| 00293|     let bestScore = 0;
    3836| 00294|     for (const [cat, sc] of categoryScores) {
    3837| 00295|       if (sc > bestScore) { best = cat; bestScore = sc; }
    3838| 00296|     }
    3839| 00297|     return best;
    3840| 00298|   })();
    3841| 00299| 
    3842| 00300|   return { isRefusal, score: totalScore, category: topCategory, matched, whitelistHits: [] };
    3843| 00301| }
    3844| 00302| 
    3845| 00303| /**
    3846| 00304|  * 收緊版 choice 偵測：選擇指示詞 + 動作動詞同時出現才計分。
    3847| 00305|  */
    3848| 00306| export function detectChoice(text: string): ChoiceVerdict {
    3849| 00307|   const lower = text.toLowerCase();
    3850| 00308| 
    3851| 00309|   // 先確認有動作動詞
    3852| 00310|   const hasActionVerb = CHOICE_ACTION_VERBS.some(v => lower.includes(v));
    3853| 00311|   if (!hasActionVerb) {
    3854| 00312|     return { isChoice: false, score: 0, matched: [] };
    3855| 00313|   }
    3856| 00314| 
    3857| 00315|   let score = 0;
    3858| 00316|   const matched: string[] = [];
    3859| 00317| 
    3860| 00318|   for (const pat of CHOICE_INDICATORS) {
    3861| 00319|     let hit = false;
    3862| 00320|     if (pat.re) {
    3863| 00321|       hit = pat.re.test(text);
    3864| 00322|     } else if (pat.str) {
    3865| 00323|       hit = lower.includes(pat.str);
    3866| 00324|     }
    3867| 00325|     if (hit) {
    3868| 00326|       score += pat.weight;
    3869| 00327|       matched.push(pat.str ?? pat.re!.source);
    3870| 00328|     }
    3871| 00329|   }
    3872| 00330| 
    3873| 00331|   // 有動作動詞加 2 分 bonus
    3874| 00332|   if (score > 0) score += 2;
    3875| 00333| 
    3876| 00334|   return { isChoice: score >= CHOICE_THRESHOLD, score, matched };
    3877| 00335| }
    3878| 00336| 
    3879| 00337| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    3880| 00338| // Backward-compatible shims（舊呼叫端可直接切換）
    3881| 00339| // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    3882| 00340| 
    3883| 00341| export function isRefusalResponse(text: string): boolean {
    3884| 00342|   return detectRefusal(text).isRefusal;
    3885| 00343| }
    3886| 00344| 
    3887| 00345| export function isChoiceConfirmation(text: string): boolean {
    3888| 00346|   return detectChoice(text).isChoice;
    3889| 00347| }

    3896| 00004| export interface QueuedTask {
    3897| 00005|   id: string;
    3898| 00006|   prompt: string;
    3899| 00007|   modelOverride?: string;
    3900| 00008|   addedAt: number;
    3901| 00009| }
    3902| 00010| 
    3903| 00011| export class TaskQueue {
    3904| 00012|   private _items: QueuedTask[] = [];
    3905| 00013|   private _seq = 0;
    3906| 00014| 
    3907| 00015|   enqueue(prompt: string, modelOverride?: string): QueuedTask {
    3908| 00016|     const task: QueuedTask = {
    3909| 00017|       id: `q-${++this._seq}`,
    3910| 00018|       prompt: prompt.trim(),
    3911| 00019|       modelOverride: modelOverride?.trim() || undefined,
    3912| 00020|       addedAt: Date.now(),
    3913| 00021|     };
    3914| 00022|     this._items.push(task);
    3915| 00023|     return task;
    3916| 00024|   }
    3917| 00025| 
    3918| 00026|   dequeue(): QueuedTask | undefined {
    3919| 00027|     return this._items.shift();
    3920| 00028|   }
    3921| 00029| 
    3922| 00030|   peek(): QueuedTask | undefined {
    3923| 00031|     return this._items[0];
    3924| 00032|   }
    3925| 00033| 
    3926| 00034|   get length(): number {
    3927| 00035|     return this._items.length;
    3928| 00036|   }
    3929| 00037| 
    3930| 00038|   getAll(): readonly QueuedTask[] {
    3931| 00039|     return [...this._items];
    3932| 00040|   }
    3933| 00041| 
    3934| 00042|   remove(id: string): boolean {
    3935| 00043|     const idx = this._items.findIndex(t => t.id === id);
    3936| 00044|     if (idx < 0) return false;
    3937| 00045|     this._items.splice(idx, 1);
    3938| 00046|     return true;
    3939| 00047|   }
    3940| 00048| 
    3941| 00049|   clear(): number {
    3942| 00050|     const count = this._items.length;
    3943| 00051|     this._items = [];
    3944| 00052|     return count;
    3945| 00053|   }
    3946| 00054| 
    3947| 00055|   format(): string {
    3948| 00056|     if (!this._items.length) return '（任務佇列為空）';
    3949| 00057|     return this._items.map((t, i) => {
    3950| 00058|       const prompt = t.prompt.length > 80 ? t.prompt.slice(0, 80) + '…' : t.prompt;
    3951| 00059|       const model = t.modelOverride ? ` [${t.modelOverride}]` : '';
    3952| 00060|       return `${i + 1}. [${t.id}]${model} ${prompt}`;
    3953| 00061|     }).join('\n');

    4159| 00121|   return {
    4160| 00122|     role: 'system',
    4161| 00123|     content: `[Previous conversation compacted — context summary below]\n\n${summary}`,

    4169| 00131| 
    4170| 00132| export function getMessagesAfterCompactBoundary<T extends CompactableMessage>(messages: T[]): T[] {
    4171| 00133|   for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    4172| 00134|     if (isCompactBoundaryMessage(messages[i])) {
    4173| 00135|       return messages.slice(i + 1);
    4174| 00136|     }
    4175| 00137|   }
    4176| 00138|   return messages;
    4177| 00139| }
    4178| 00140| 
    4179| 00141| /**
    4180| 00142|  * 從 LLM 回傳的 <analysis>...<summary>...</summary> 文字中抽出 summary 部分。
    4181| 00143|  * 同時相容繁體中文版 <分析>...<摘要>...</摘要>（AmiClaw 既有 prompt 採用此格式）。
    4182| 00144|  * Analysis 是 scratchpad，不送回主對話。
    4183| 00145|  */
    4184| 00146| export function formatCompactSummary(rawText: string): string {
    4185| 00147|   const enMatch = rawText.match(/<summary>([\s\S]*?)<\/summary>/);
    4186| 00148|   if (enMatch) return enMatch[1].trim();
    4187| 00149|   const zhMatch = rawText.match(/<摘要>([\s\S]*?)<\/摘要>/);
    4188| 00150|   if (zhMatch) return zhMatch[1].trim();
    4189| 00151| 
    4190| 00152|   // Fallback：若模型未產出標籤，整段保留（去掉 analysis 段）
    4191| 00153|   const stripped = rawText
    4192| 00154|     .replace(/<analysis>[\s\S]*?<\/analysis>/g, '')
    4193| 00155|     .replace(/<分析>[\s\S]*?<\/分析>/g, '')
    4194| 00156|     .trim();
    4195| 00157|   return stripped || rawText.trim();
    4196| 00158| }

    4201| 00163| 
    4202| 00164| /**
    4203| 00165|  * 執行 history compaction：
    4204| 00166|  *   1. 取 boundary 之後的所有訊息
    4205| 00167|  *   2. 呼叫 LLM summarize
    4206| 00168|  *   3. 回傳新訊息陣列（含 boundary + 摘要 + 保留的最近 N 輪）
    4207| 00169|  */
    4208| 00170| export async function compactHistory<T extends CompactableMessage>(
    4209| 00171|   messages: T[],
    4210| 00172|   caller: CompactCaller,
    4211| 00173|   options: HistoryCompactOptions = {}
    4212| 00174| ): Promise<CompactionResult<T>> {
    4213| 00175|   const keepRecent = options.keepRecentRounds ?? 4;
    4214| 00176|   const dropPre = options.dropPreBoundary ?? false;
    4215| 00177|   const minMsgs = options.minMessages ?? 10;
    4216| 00178| 
    4217| 00179|   const activeMessages = getMessagesAfterCompactBoundary(messages);
    4218| 00180| 
    4219| 00181|   // Guard: skip compaction when there are too few messages to summarize
    4220| 00182|   // (avoids wasting a full LLM call on short sessions).
    4221| 00183|   if (activeMessages.length < minMsgs) {
    4222| 00184|     const tokens = activeMessages.reduce((s, m) => s + estimateTokensRough(m.content ?? ''), 0);
    4223| 00185|     return {
    4224| 00186|       messages,
    4225| 00187|       summary: '',
    4226| 00188|       tokensBefore: tokens,
    4227| 00189|       tokensAfter: tokens,
    4228| 00190|       boundaryIndex: -1,
    4229| 00191|     };
    4230| 00192|   }
    4231| 00193| 
    4232| 00194|   const tokensBefore = activeMessages.reduce((s, m) => s + estimateTokensRough(m.content ?? ''), 0);
    4233| 00195| 
    4234| 00196|   // 呼叫 LLM 產生 summary
    4235| 00197|   const rawSummary = await caller.summarize(activeMessages as CompactableMessage[], COMPACT_SUMMARY_PROMPT);
    4236| 00198|   const summary = formatCompactSummary(rawSummary);
    4237| 00199| 
    4238| 00200|   // 保留最近 N 輪原文（user/assistant pair）
    4239| 00201|   const recentTail: T[] = [];
    4240| 00202|   let rounds = 0;
    4241| 00203|   for (let i = activeMessages.length - 1; i >= 0 && rounds < keepRecent; i--) {
    4242| 00204|     const m = activeMessages[i];
    4243| 00205|     recentTail.unshift(m);
    4244| 00206|     if (m.role === 'user') rounds++;
    4245| 00207|   }
    4246| 00208| 
    4247| 00209|   const boundary = createCompactBoundaryMessage(summary) as T;
    4248| 00210| 
    4249| 00211|   const pre = dropPre
    4250| 00212|     ? messages.filter(isCompactBoundaryMessage)
    4251| 00213|     : messages.slice(0, messages.length - activeMessages.length);
    4252| 00214| 
    4253| 00215|   const newMessages: T[] = [...pre, boundary, ...recentTail];
    4254| 00216|   const tokensAfter = newMessages.reduce((s, m) => s + estimateTokensRough(m.content ?? ''), 0);
    4255| 00217| 
    4256| 00218|   return {
    4257| 00219|     messages: newMessages,
    4258| 00220|     summary,
    4259| 00221|     tokensBefore,
    4260| 00222|     tokensAfter,
    4261| 00223|     boundaryIndex: pre.length,
    4262| 00224|   };
    4263| 00225| }

    4335| 00069|  *  - 圖片過大則清除
    4336| 00070|  */
    4337| 00071| export function microCompact<T extends CompactableToolMessage>(
    4338| 00072|   messages: T[],
    4339| 00073|   options: MicroCompactOptions = {}
    4340| 00074| ): MicroCompactResult<T> {
    4341| 00075|   const compactable = options.compactableTools ?? DEFAULT_COMPACTABLE_TOOLS;
    4342| 00076|   const perResultMax = options.perResultMaxTokens ?? PER_RESULT_MAX_TOKENS;
    4343| 00077|   const staleMs = options.staleThresholdMs ?? 10 * 60 * 1000;
    4344| 00078|   const now = Date.now();
    4345| 00079| 
    4346| 00080|   let trimmed = 0;
    4347| 00081|   let freed = 0;
    4348| 00082| 
    4349| 00083|   const out = messages.map((msg, idx) => {
    4350| 00084|     if (msg.role !== 'tool') return msg;
    4351| 00085|     if (!msg.toolName || !compactable.has(msg.toolName)) return msg;
    4352| 00086| 
    4353| 00087|     const ts = options.getMessageTimestamp?.(msg, idx);
    4354| 00088|     const isStale = ts !== undefined && now - ts > staleMs;
    4355| 00089| 
    4356| 00090|     // 過時：整段清除
    4357| 00091|     if (isStale && msg.content) {
    4358| 00092|       freed += estimateTokensRough(msg.content);
    4359| 00093|       trimmed++;
    4360| 00094|       return { ...msg, content: TIME_BASED_MC_CLEARED_MESSAGE };
    4361| 00095|     }
    4362| 00096| 
    4363| 00097|     // 圖片過大：清除
    4364| 00098|     let images = msg.images;
    4365| 00099|     if (images && images.length > 0) {
    4366| 00100|       const totalImgTokens = images.reduce((s, i) => s + estimateTokensRough(i), 0);
    4367| 00101|       if (totalImgTokens > IMAGE_MAX_TOKEN_SIZE) {
    4368| 00102|         freed += totalImgTokens;
    4369| 00103|         images = undefined;
    4370| 00104|         trimmed++;
    4371| 00105|       }
    4372| 00106|     }
    4373| 00107| 
    4374| 00108|     // 內容過大：保留頭尾 + 中間替換摘要
    4375| 00109|     if (msg.content) {
    4376| 00110|       const tokens = estimateTokensRough(msg.content);
    4377| 00111|       if (tokens > perResultMax) {
    4378| 00112|         const headChars = Math.floor((perResultMax - PER_RESULT_PREVIEW_TAIL_TOKENS) * 3);
    4379| 00113|         const tailChars = Math.floor(PER_RESULT_PREVIEW_TAIL_TOKENS * 3);
    4380| 00114|         const head = msg.content.slice(0, headChars);
    4381| 00115|         const tail = msg.content.slice(-tailChars);
    4382| 00116|         const collapsed = `${head}\n\n...[truncated ${tokens - perResultMax} tokens]...\n\n${tail}`;
    4383| 00117|         freed += tokens - estimateTokensRough(collapsed);
    4384| 00118|         trimmed++;
    4385| 00119|         return { ...msg, content: collapsed, images };
    4386| 00120|       }
    4387| 00121|     }
    4388| 00122| 
    4389| 00123|     if (images !== msg.images) return { ...msg, images };
    4390| 00124|     return msg;
    4391| 00125|   });
    4392| 00126| 
    4393| 00127|   return { messages: out, trimmedCount: trimmed, tokensFreed: freed };
    4394| 00128| }
    4395| ===== END: src\context\MicroCompactor.ts =====

    4398| 00001| /**

    4404| 00007|  * 設計原則：

    4417| 00020| export interface BuildSystemPromptInput {
    4418| 00021|   /** Persona / role definition（最先） */

    4421| 00024|   policy?: string;

    4427| 00030|   workspaceSummary?: string;
    4428| 00031|   /** 當前 active file 摘要 */
    4429| 00032|   activeFileSummary?: string;

    4431| 00034|   toolRules?: string;

    4433| 00036|   extraSections?: SystemPromptSection[];
    4434| 00037| }
    4435| 00038| 
    4436| 00039| const SEP = '\n\n---\n\n';
    4437| 00040| 
    4438| 00041| /**
    4439| 00042|  * 組裝 system prompt：依固定順序拼接，空 section 略過。
    4440| 00043|  */
    4441| 00044| export function buildSystemPrompt(input: BuildSystemPromptInput): string {
    4442| 00045|   const parts: string[] = [];
    4443| 00046| 
    4444| 00047|   if (input.persona?.trim()) {
    4445| 00048|     parts.push(input.persona.trim());
    4446| 00049|   }
    4447| 00050| 
    4448| 00051|   if (input.policy?.trim()) {
    4449| 00052|     parts.push(`## Policy\n\n${input.policy.trim()}`);
    4450| 00053|   }
    4451| 00054| 
    4452| 00055|   if (input.rules?.trim()) {
    4453| 00056|     parts.push(`## Project Rules\n\n${input.rules.trim()}`);
    4454| 00057|   }
    4455| 00058| 
    4456| 00059|   if (input.memoryIndex?.trim()) {
    4457| 00060|     parts.push(`## Long-term memory index\n\n${input.memoryIndex.trim()}`);
    4458| 00061|   }
    4459| 00062| 
    4460| 00063|   if (input.workspaceSummary?.trim()) {
    4461| 00064|     parts.push(`## Workspace\n\n${input.workspaceSummary.trim()}`);
    4462| 00065|   }
    4463| 00066| 
    4464| 00067|   if (input.activeFileSummary?.trim()) {
    4465| 00068|     parts.push(`## Active file\n\n${input.activeFileSummary.trim()}`);
    4466| 00069|   }
    4467| 00070| 
    4468| 00071|   if (input.toolRules?.trim()) {
    4469| 00072|     parts.push(`## Tool rules\n\n${input.toolRules.trim()}`);
    4470| 00073|   }
    4471| 00074| 
    4472| 00075|   for (const sec of input.extraSections ?? []) {
    4473| 00076|     if (sec.content?.trim()) {
    4474| 00077|       parts.push(`## ${sec.title}\n\n${sec.content.trim()}`);
    4475| 00078|     }
    4476| 00079|   }
    4477| 00080| 
    4478| 00081|   return parts.join(SEP);
    4479| 00082| }
    4480| 00083| 
    4481| 00084| /**
    4482| 00085|  * 依 token 預算裁切 memoryIndex（避免吃光 system prompt）。
    4483| 00086|  * 對應 claude-code 的「MEMORY.md 超過 200 行截斷」策略。
    4484| 00087|  */
    4485| 00088| export function truncateMemoryIndex(text: string, maxLines = 200): string {
    4486| 00089|   if (!text) return text;
    4487| 00090|   const lines = text.split('\n');
    4488| 00091|   if (lines.length <= maxLines) return text;
    4489| 00092|   return [
    4490| 00093|     ...lines.slice(0, maxLines),
    4491| 00094|     `\n... [memory index truncated, ${lines.length - maxLines} more lines]`,
    4492| 00095|   ].join('\n');
    4493| 00096| }

    4713| ===== FILE: src\context\TokenBudgetManager.ts  (118 lines) =====
    4714| 00001| /**
    4715| 00002|  * TokenBudgetManager
    4716| 00003|  *
    4717| 00004|  * 移植自 claude-code `services/compact/autoCompact.ts` 的 token 預算機制。
    4718| 00005|  * 用於決定何時觸發 micro / auto compaction、何時警告使用者。
    4719| 00006|  *
    4720| 00007|  * 移植來源關鍵常數：
    4721| 00008|  *   AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER_TOKENS         = 13_000  ← 距離 context window 還剩這麼多就壓縮
    4722| 00009|  *   WARNING_THRESHOLD_BUFFER_TOKENS   = 20_000
    4723| 00010|  *   MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_FOR_SUMMARY     = 20_000  ← 預留給 summarize 輸出
    4724| 00011|  *   MAX_CONSECUTIVE_AUTOCOMPACT_FAILS = 3
    4725| 00012|  */
    4726| 00013| 
    4727| 00014| export const AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER_TOKENS = 13_000;
    4728| 00015| export const WARNING_THRESHOLD_BUFFER_TOKENS = 20_000;
    4729| 00016| export const ERROR_THRESHOLD_BUFFER_TOKENS = 20_000;
    4730| 00017| export const MANUAL_COMPACT_BUFFER_TOKENS = 3_000;
    4731| 00018| export const MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_FOR_SUMMARY = 20_000;
    4732| 00019| export const MAX_CONSECUTIVE_AUTOCOMPACT_FAILURES = 3;
    4733| 00020| 
    4734| 00021| export interface TokenBudget {
    4735| 00022|   /** Provider 回報的 context window 上限（token 數） */
    4736| 00023|   contextWindow: number;
    4737| 00024|   /** 保留給輸出的 token 數 */
    4738| 00025|   maxOutputTokens: number;
    4739| 00026| }
    4740| 00027| 
    4741| 00028| export interface TokenWarningState {
    4742| 00029|   /** 剩餘 token 百分比 (0~100) */
    4743| 00030|   percentLeft: number;
    4744| 00031|   /** 已使用 token */
    4745| 00032|   used: number;
    4746| 00033|   /** 有效 context window（扣除輸出保留） */
    4747| 00034|   effectiveWindow: number;
    4748| 00035|   isAboveWarningThreshold: boolean;
    4749| 00036|   isAboveErrorThreshold: boolean;
    4750| 00037|   isAboveAutoCompactThreshold: boolean;
    4751| 00038| }
    4752| 00039| 
    4753| 00040| /**
    4754| 00041|  * 計算扣除輸出保留後的有效 context window。
    4755| 00042|  */
    4756| 00043| export function getEffectiveContextWindowSize(budget: TokenBudget): number {
    4757| 00044|   const reservedForOutput = Math.min(budget.maxOutputTokens, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS_FOR_SUMMARY);
    4758| 00045|   return Math.max(0, budget.contextWindow - reservedForOutput);
    4759| 00046| }
    4760| 00047| 
    4761| 00048| /**
    4762| 00049|  * 自動壓縮觸發點：有效視窗 − 13K buffer。
    4763| 00050|  */
    4764| 00051| export function getAutoCompactThreshold(budget: TokenBudget): number {
    4765| 00052|   return Math.max(0, getEffectiveContextWindowSize(budget) - AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER_TOKENS);
    4766| 00053| }
    4767| 00054| 
    4768| 00055| /**
    4769| 00056|  * 警告閾值：有效視窗 − 20K buffer。
    4770| 00057|  */
    4771| 00058| export function getWarningThreshold(budget: TokenBudget): number {
    4772| 00059|   return Math.max(0, getEffectiveContextWindowSize(budget) - WARNING_THRESHOLD_BUFFER_TOKENS);
    4773| 00060| }
    4774| 00061| 
    4775| 00062| /**
    4776| 00063|  * 依目前 token 使用量計算警告狀態。
    4777| 00064|  */
    4778| 00065| export function calculateTokenWarningState(
    4779| 00066|   tokenUsage: number,
    4780| 00067|   budget: TokenBudget
    4781| 00068| ): TokenWarningState {
    4782| 00069|   const effectiveWindow = getEffectiveContextWindowSize(budget);
    4783| 00070|   const autoCompactThreshold = getAutoCompactThreshold(budget);
    4784| 00071|   const warningThreshold = getWarningThreshold(budget);
    4785| 00072| 
    4786| 00073|   const percentLeft = effectiveWindow > 0
    4787| 00074|     ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ((effectiveWindow - tokenUsage) / effectiveWindow) * 100))
    4788| 00075|     : 0;
    4789| 00076| 
    4790| 00077|   return {
    4791| 00078|     percentLeft,
    4792| 00079|     used: tokenUsage,
    4793| 00080|     effectiveWindow,
    4794| 00081|     isAboveWarningThreshold: tokenUsage >= warningThreshold,
    4795| 00082|     isAboveErrorThreshold: tokenUsage >= effectiveWindow - ERROR_THRESHOLD_BUFFER_TOKENS,
    4796| 00083|     isAboveAutoCompactThreshold: tokenUsage >= autoCompactThreshold,
    4797| 00084|   };
    4798| 00085| }
    4799| 00086| 
    4800| 00087| /**
    4801| 00088|  * Circuit breaker：連續失敗超過 3 次即停止自動壓縮。
    4802| 00089|  */
    4803| 00090| export function shouldStopAutoCompact(consecutiveFailures: number): boolean {
    4804| 00091|   return consecutiveFailures >= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_AUTOCOMPACT_FAILURES;
    4805| 00092| }
    4806| 00093| 
    4807| 00094| /**
    4808| 00095|  * 預估字串 token 數。粗略估算：英文約 4 char / token，中文約 1.5 char / token。
    4809| 00096|  * 若上層已有更精準的 estimator（如 tiktoken），可從外部注入並覆蓋。
    4810| 00097|  */
    4811| 00098| export function estimateTokensRough(text: string): number {
    4812| 00099|   if (!text) return 0;
    4813| 00100|   // 中文字元算 1 token，其他每 4 char 算 1 token
    4814| 00101|   let cjk = 0;
    4815| 00102|   let other = 0;
    4816| 00103|   for (const ch of text) {
    4817| 00104|     if (/[\u4e00-\u9fff\u3000-\u303f\uff00-\uffef]/.test(ch)) cjk++;
    4818| 00105|     else other++;
    4819| 00106|   }
    4820| 00107|   return Math.ceil(cjk + other / 4);
    4821| 00108| }
    4822| 00109| 
    4823| 00110| /**
    4824| 00111|  * 強制截斷字串以符合 Token 限制。
    4825| 00112|  * 為確保絕對安全，我們採取「最保守估算」：將字串截斷至 maxTokens 個字元。
    4826| 00113|  * 因為即使全為中文字，token 數也只會等於字元數，絕不會超過 maxTokens。
    4827| 00114|  */
    4828| 00115| export function truncateToTokenLimit(text: string, maxTokens: number): string {
    4829| 00116|   if (estimateTokensRough(text) <= maxTokens) return text;
    4830| 00117|   return text.substring(0, maxTokens);
    4831| 00118| }

    4953| 00119| export async function buildWorkspaceDigest(opts: BuildOpts): Promise<WorkspaceDigestResult> {
    4954| 00120|   const started = Date.now();
    4955| 00121|   if (opts.depth === 'file') {
    4956| 00122|     return { text: '', fileCount: 0, bytes: 0, truncated: false, durationMs: 0 };
    4957| 00123|   }
    4958| 00124| 
    4959| 00125|   const cacheKey = makeCacheKey(opts);
    4960| 00126|   if (!opts.bypassCache && _cache && _cache.key === cacheKey && Date.now() - _cache.ts < DEFAULT_TTL_MS) {
    4961| 00127|     return _cache.result;
    4962| 00128|   }
    4963| 00129| 
    4964| 00130|   const include = opts.include ?? DEFAULT_INCLUDE_GLOB;
    4965| 00131|   const exclude = opts.exclude ?? DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_GLOB;
    4966| 00132|   const uris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(include, exclude, 4000);
    4967| 00133|   const candidates = uris.filter((u) => !BINARY_EXTS.has(path.extname(u.fsPath).toLowerCase()));
    4968| 00134|   candidates.sort((a, b) => a.fsPath.localeCompare(b.fsPath));
    4969| 00135| 
    4970| 00136|   const result = opts.depth === 'full'
    4971| 00137|     ? buildFullInstruction(candidates)   // 同步：不讀檔，只回傳指令
    4972| 00138|     : await buildOutline(candidates, opts);
    4973| 00139| 
    4974| 00140|   result.durationMs = Date.now() - started;
    4975| 00141|   _cache = { key: cacheKey, result, ts: Date.now() };
    4976| 00142|   return result;
    4977| 00143| }
    4978| 00144| 
    4979| 00145| /**
    4980| 00146|  * 全讀模式：不再把代碼倒進 system prompt（會溢出 context window）。

    4982| 00148|  * 這是在 Ollama 有限 context window 下真正能完整讀取整個 workspace 的唯一可靠方式。
    4983| 00149|  */
    4984| 00150| function buildFullInstruction(candidates: vscode.Uri[]): WorkspaceDigestResult {
    4985| 00151|   const folders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [];
    4986| 00152|   const roots = folders.map((f) => f.uri.fsPath).join(', ') || '（工作區）';

    4991| 00157|

    4996| 00162|     ``,
    4997| 00163|     `**【強制規則】** 你必須在第一輪立即呼叫 \`read_workspace\` 工具讀取整個工作區所有原始碼，`,
    4998| 00164|     `再進行任何分析、總結或回答。呼叫時可傳入 max_total_kb 與 include 參數控制範圍。`,

    5002| 00168|     preview + more,

    5008| 00174| async function buildOutline(candidates: vscode.Uri[], opts: BuildOpts): Promise<WorkspaceDigestResult> {
    5009| 00175|   // 如果傳入 modelContextLength，自動將 outline 大小限制在 context 25% 以內
    5010| 00176|   // 估算：1 token ≈ 3~4 bytes。取保守值 3 bytes/token
    5011| 00177|   const ctxKb = (opts.modelContextLength ?? 0) > 0
    5012| 00178|     ? Math.floor((opts.modelContextLength! * 0.25 * 3) / 1024)
    5013| 00179|     : 0;
    5014| 00180|   const maxTotal = Math.max(2, opts.maxTotalKb ?? (ctxKb > 0 ? Math.min(ctxKb, 64) : 24)) * 1024;
    5015| 00181|   const topN = Math.max(1, opts.topN ?? 40);
    5016| 00182|   const linesPerFile = Math.max(5, opts.linesPerFile ?? 40);
    5017| 00183| 
    5018| 00184|   opts.onProgress?.(`🗂️ Outline 剖析（context=${opts.modelContextLength ? `${(opts.modelContextLength / 1024).toFixed(0)}K tokens` : '未知'}，上限 ${fmtSize(maxTotal)}）…`);
    5019| 00185| 
    5020| 00186|   // 計算副檔名分佈
    5021| 00187|   const extCount = new Map<string, number>();
    5022| 00188|   const rels: string[] = [];
    5023| 00189|   for (const u of candidates) {
    5024| 00190|     const rel = vscode.workspace.asRelativePath(u);
    5025| 00191|     rels.push(rel);
    5026| 00192|     const ext = path.extname(rel).toLowerCase() || '(無)';
    5027| 00193|     extCount.set(ext, (extCount.get(ext) ?? 0) + 1);
    5028| 00194|   }
    5029| 00195|   const langTable = Array.from(extCount.entries())
    5030| 00196|     .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
    5031| 00197|     .slice(0, 20)
    5032| 00198|     .map(([ext, n]) => `\`${ext}\`: ${n}`)
    5033| 00199|     .join(', ');
    5034| 00200| 
    5035| 00201|   // 平行取得 stat（抓大小用於排序）
    5036| 00202|   const statRaw = await Promise.all(
    5037| 00203|     candidates.map((u) =>
    5038| 00204|       asPromise(vscode.workspace.fs.stat(u))
    5039| 00205|         .then((s) => ({ uri: u, size: s.size }))
    5040| 00206|         .catch((): { uri: vscode.Uri; size: number } | null => null)
    5041| 00207|     )
    5042| 00208|   );
    5043| 00209|   const withSizes = statRaw.filter((x): x is { uri: vscode.Uri; size: number } => x !== null);
    5044| 00210|   withSizes.sort((a, b) => b.size - a.size);
    5045| 00211|   const top = withSizes.slice(0, topN);
    5046| 00212| 
    5047| 00213|   // 平行讀取 top-N 檔案的 outline
    5048| 00214|   const maxOutlineBytes = 4 * 1024;   // 單檔 outline 最多 4 KB（前 N 行）
    5049| 00215|   const readRaw = await Promise.all(top.map((item) => safeRead(item.uri, maxOutlineBytes)));
    5050| 00216| 
    5051| 00217|   const outlines: string[] = [];
    5052| 00218|   let outlineBytes = 0;
    5053| 00219|   for (let i = 0; i < readRaw.length; i++) {
    5054| 00220|     const r = readRaw[i];
    5055| 00221|     if (!r) { continue; }
    5056| 00222|     const { rel, buf } = r;
    5057| 00223|     const lines = buf.toString('utf8').split(/\r?\n/).slice(0, linesPerFile);
    5058| 00224|     const size = top[i].size;
    5059| 00225|     const lang = path.extname(rel).slice(1).toLowerCase();
    5060| 00226|     const entry = `### ${rel} (${fmtSize(size)}, 前 ${lines.length} 行)\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${lines.join('\n')}\n\`\`\``;
    5061| 00227|     const eb = Buffer.byteLength(entry, 'utf8');
    5062| 00228|     if (outlineBytes + eb > maxTotal) { break; }
    5063| 00229|     outlineBytes += eb;
    5064| 00230|     outlines.push(entry);
    5065| 00231|   }
    5066| 00232| 
    5067| 00233|   // 檔案樹（最多 250 筆，避免太長）
    5068| 00234|   const treeLimit = 250;
    5069| 00235|   const tree = rels.slice(0, treeLimit).map((r) => `- ${r}`).join('\n');
    5070| 00236|   const treeMore = rels.length > treeLimit ? `\n  …（共 ${rels.length} 個檔案，僅列出前 ${treeLimit}）` : '';
    5071| 00237| 
    5072| 00238|   const digest = [
    5073| 00239|     `## 工作區結構摘要 (Outline Deep Analysis)`,
    5074| 00240|     `共 ${rels.length} 個原始碼檔案。副檔名分佈：${langTable}`,
    5075| 00241|     '',
    5076| 00242|     `### 檔案清單`,
    5077| 00243|     tree + treeMore,
    5078| 00244|     '',
    5079| 00245|     `### 重要檔案 outline（依大小排序，前 ${outlines.length} 個，每檔前 ${linesPerFile} 行）`,
    5080| 00246|     outlines.join('\n\n'),
    5081| 00247|     '',
    5082| 00248|     `💡 如需完整內容請呼叫 read_file / read_files / read_workspace 工具。`,
    5083| 00249|   ].join('\n');
    5084| 00250| 
    5085| 00251|   return {
    5086| 00252|     text: digest,
    5087| 00253|     fileCount: rels.length,
    5088| 00254|     bytes: Buffer.byteLength(digest, 'utf8'),
    5089| 00255|     truncated: false,
    5090| 00256|     durationMs: 0,
    5091| 00257|   };
    5092| 00258| }

    5546| 00097|   // ── 對話記錄回呼：Agent 完成後將提示 + 回應 append 到 AmiClawTodoLog.md ────
    5547| 00098|   OllamaChatPanel.onTodoComplete = async (prompt: string, response: string) => {
    5548| 00099|     const folders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [];
    5549| 00100|     // 找到 AmiClawToClaudeToDo.md 所在的 folder，把 log 放在同目錄
    5550| 00101|     let logFolder = folders[0]?.uri;
    5551| 00102|     for (const folder of folders) {
    5552| 00103|       try {
    5553| 00104|         await vscode.workspace.fs.stat(vscode.Uri.joinPath(folder.uri, 'AmiClawToClaudeToDo.md'));
    5554| 00105|         logFolder = folder.uri;
    5555| 00106|         break;
    5556| 00107|       } catch { /* 不在這個 folder */ }
    5557| 00108|     }
    5558| 00109|     if (!logFolder) { return; }
    5559| 00110|     const logUri = vscode.Uri.joinPath(logFolder, 'AmiClawTodoLog.md');
    5560| 00111|     const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').replace(/\.\d+Z$/, ' UTC');
    5561| 00112|     const entry = `\n---\n## 📋 ${ts} 任務\n${prompt}\n\n## 🤖 ${ts} Agent 回應\n${response}\n`;
    5562| 00113|     try {
    5563| 00114|       // 追加到已有的 log（如果存在），否則建立新檔
    5564| 00115|       let existing = '';
    5565| 00116|       try {
    5566| 00117|         const b = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(logUri);
    5567| 00118|         existing = Buffer.from(b).toString('utf8');
    5568| 00119|       } catch { /* 第一次建立 */ }
    5569| 00120|       const newContent = Buffer.from(existing + entry, 'utf8');
    5570| 00121|       await vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(logUri, newContent);
    5571| 00122|       todoLog.appendLine(`[onTodoComplete] 已寫入 ${logUri.fsPath}（+${entry.length} 字）`);
    5572| 00123|       vscode.window.setStatusBarMessage(`📝 AmiClaw：對話已記錄到 AmiClawTodoLog.md`, 5000);
    5573| 00124|     } catch (e) {
    5574| 00125|       todoLog.appendLine(`[onTodoComplete] 寫入失敗: ${(e as Error)?.message ?? e}`);
    5575| 00126|     }
    5576| 00127|   };
    5577| 00128| 
    5578| 00129|   let _todoDebounce: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
    5579| 00130| 
    5580| 00131|   async function processTodoFile(uri: vscode.Uri) {
    5581| 00132|     clearTimeout(_todoDebounce);
    5582| 00133|     _todoDebounce = setTimeout(async () => {
    5583| 00134|       try {
    5584| 00135|         todoLog.appendLine(`[processTodoFile] 觸發: ${uri.fsPath}`);
    5585| 00136|         const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri);
    5586| 00137|         const prompt = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8').trim();
    5587| 00138|         if (!prompt) {
    5588| 00139|           todoLog.appendLine('[processTodoFile] 檔案為空，跳過');
    5589| 00140|           return;
    5590| 00141|         }
    5591| 00142|         todoLog.appendLine(`[processTodoFile] 內容長度=${prompt.length}，送入 agentSend`);
    5592| 00143|         // 確保 panel 已建立，再進入 todo 模式
    5593| 00144|         await OllamaChatPanel.createOrShow(context);
    5594| 00145|         OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel?.enterTodoMode(prompt);
    5595| 00146|         const send = () => OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel?.postMessageToWebview({ type: 'externalAgentSend', prompt });
    5596| 00147|         if (OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel) { send(); } else { setTimeout(send, 700); }
    5597| 00148|         vscode.window.setStatusBarMessage(`🤖 AmiClaw：已讀取 AmiClawToClaudeToDo.md (${prompt.length} 字)`, 5000);
    5598| 00149|       } catch (e) {
    5599| 00150|         const msg = (e as Error)?.message ?? String(e);
    5600| 00151|         todoLog.appendLine(`[processTodoFile] 錯誤: ${msg}`);
    5601| 00152|         vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`AmiClaw 讀取 AmiClawToClaudeToDo.md 失敗：${msg}`);
    5602| 00153|       }
    5603| 00154|     }, 500);
    5604| 00155|   }

    5606| 00157|   // 對每個 workspace folder 分別建立 RelativePattern watcher（multi-root 最可靠作法）
    5607| 00158|   function registerTodoWatchers(folders: readonly vscode.WorkspaceFolder[]) {
    5608| 00159|     for (const folder of folders) {
    5609| 00160|       const pattern = new vscode.RelativePattern(folder, 'AmiClawToClaudeToDo.md');
    5610| 00161|       const w = vscode.workspace.createFileSystemWatcher(pattern, false, false, true);
    5611| 00162|       w.onDidCreate(processTodoFile);
    5612| 00163|       w.onDidChange(processTodoFile);
    5613| 00164|       context.subscriptions.push(w);
    5614| 00165|       todoLog.appendLine(`[init] 監聽 ${folder.uri.fsPath}/AmiClawToClaudeToDo.md`);
    5615| 00166|     }
    5616| 00167|   }
    5617| 00168|

    7150| 00001| import { scanMemoryFiles } from './memoryScan';
    7151| 00002| import * as fs from 'fs/promises';
    7152| 00003| 
    7153| 00004| export interface SelectedMemory { path: string; excerpt: string; mtimeMs: number }
    7154| 00005| 
    7155| 00006| /**
    7156| 00007|  * Very small relevance selector: choose up to `max` most recently modified files
    7157| 00008|  * that contain any keyword from queryTokens. Returns excerpt (first 1000 chars).
    7158| 00009|  */
    7159| 00010| export async function findRelevantMemories(query: string, max = 5): Promise<SelectedMemory[]> {
    7160| 00011|   const headers = await scanMemoryFiles(200);
    7161| 00012|   if (!query || headers.length === 0) return [];
    7162| 00013|   const tokens = query.toLowerCase().split(/\W+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 10);
    7163| 00014|   const scored: Array<{ h: typeof headers[0]; score: number }> = [];
    7164| 00015|   for (const h of headers) {
    7165| 00016|     try {
    7166| 00017|       const raw = await fs.readFile(h.path, 'utf8');
    7167| 00018|       const text = raw.toLowerCase();
    7168| 00019|       let score = 0;
    7169| 00020|       for (const t of tokens) { if (text.includes(t)) score += 1; }
    7170| 00021|       // recency bonus: +3 today → +0 after 3+ days (newer files preferred)
    7171| 00022|       const daysSince = (Date.now() - h.mtimeMs) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
    7172| 00023|       if (daysSince < 3) score += Math.round(3 - daysSince);
    7173| 00024|       if (score > 0) scored.push({ h, score });
    7174| 00025|     } catch { /* ignore */ }
    7175| 00026|   }
    7176| 00027|   // return empty rather than injecting files with no content match
    7177| 00028|   if (scored.length === 0) return [];
    7178| 00029|   scored.sort((a,b)=>b.score - a.score || b.h.mtimeMs - a.h.mtimeMs);
    7179| 00030|   const out: SelectedMemory[] = [];
    7180| 00031|   for (const s of scored.slice(0, max)) {
    7181| 00032|     try {
    7182| 00033|       const raw = await fs.readFile(s.h.path, 'utf8');
    7183| 00034|       out.push({ path: s.h.path, excerpt: raw.slice(0, 1000), mtimeMs: s.h.mtimeMs });
    7184| 00035|     } catch { }
    7185| 00036|   }
    7186| 00037|   return out;
    7187| 00038| }
    7188| 00039| 
    7189| 00040| export default { findRelevantMemories };

    7403| 00051| /**
    7404| 00052|  * 從 markdown 檔內容解析 frontmatter（簡化版，不引入 yaml lib）。
    7405| 00053|  */
    7406| 00054| export function parseMemoryFrontmatter(content: string): { meta: Partial<MemoryFrontmatter>; body: string } {
    7407| 00055|   const m = content.match(/^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---\n?([\s\S]*)$/);
    7408| 00056|   if (!m) return { meta: {}, body: content };
    7409| 00057| 
    7410| 00058|   const meta: Partial<MemoryFrontmatter> = {};
    7411| 00059|   for (const line of m[1].split('\n')) {
    7412| 00060|     const kv = line.match(/^(\w+):\s*(.+)$/);
    7413| 00061|     if (!kv) continue;
    7414| 00062|     const key = kv[1];
    7415| 00063|     const val = kv[2].trim();
    7416| 00064|     if (key === 'type' && MEMORY_TYPE_VALUES.includes(val as MemoryType)) {
    7417| 00065|       meta.type = val as MemoryType;
    7418| 00066|     } else if (key === 'title') {
    7419| 00067|       meta.title = val.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
    7420| 00068|     } else if (key === 'tags') {
    7421| 00069|       meta.tags = val.replace(/[[\]]/g, '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    7422| 00070|     } else if (key === 'created' || key === 'updated') {
    7423| 00071|       meta[key] = val;
    7424| 00072|     }
    7425| 00073|   }
    7426| 00074|   return { meta, body: m[2] };
    7427| 00075| }
    7428| 00076| 
    7429| 00077| /**
    7430| 00078|  * 序列化 frontmatter 為 markdown 字串。
    7431| 00079|  */
    7432| 00080| export function stringifyMemoryFrontmatter(meta: MemoryFrontmatter, body: string): string {
    7433| 00081|   const lines = ['---', `type: ${meta.type}`, `title: ${meta.title}`];
    7434| 00082|   if (meta.tags && meta.tags.length > 0) lines.push(`tags: [${meta.tags.join(', ')}]`);
    7435| 00083|   if (meta.created) lines.push(`created: ${meta.created}`);
    7436| 00084|   if (meta.updated) lines.push(`updated: ${meta.updated}`);
    7437| 00085|   lines.push('---', '', body.trim(), '');
    7438| 00086|   return lines.join('\n');
    7439| 00087| }

    7460| 00018| export function getWorkspaceMemoryDir(): string | null {
    7461| 00019|   const folders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [];
    7462| 00020|   if (folders.length === 0) return null;
    7463| 00021|

    7465| 00023|   const active = vscode.window.activeTextEditor?.document.uri;
    7466| 00024|   let chosenRoot: string | undefined;
    7467| 00025|   if (active) {

    7473| 00031|   if (!chosenRoot) return null;
    7474| 00032| 
    7475| 00033|   // prefer a workspace-local memory directory under the chosen workspace root
    7476| 00034|   return path.join(chosenRoot, '.amiclaw', 'memory');

    7633| 00130|   // 建立一個 Proxy 用以攔截陣列變更並標記為需要儲存
    7634| 00131|   private createHistoryProxy(arr: ChatMessage[], sessionId: string): ChatMessage[] {
    7635| 00132|     const that = this;
    7636| 00133|     const target = Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];
    7637| 00134|     const handler: ProxyHandler<ChatMessage[]> = {
    7638| 00135|       set(t, prop, value) {
    7639| 00136|         const res = Reflect.set(t, prop, value);
    7640| 00137|         // 設定長度或數字索引時視為修改
    7641| 00138|         if (typeof prop === 'string' && (prop === 'length' || /^\d+$/.test(prop))) {
    7642| 00139|           that._chatDirty = true;
    7643| 00140|           that.schedulePersistChatHistories();
    7644| 00141|         }
    7645| 00142|         return res;
    7646| 00143|       },
    7647| 00144|       get(t, prop, receiver) {
    7648| 00145|         const v = Reflect.get(t, prop, receiver);
    7649| 00146|         if (typeof v === 'function') {
    7650| 00147|           const name = String(prop);
    7651| 00148|           if (['push', 'pop', 'shift', 'unshift', 'splice', 'sort', 'reverse', 'fill', 'copyWithin'].includes(name)) {
    7652| 00149|             return function (...args: any[]) {
    7653| 00150|               const r = (Array.prototype as any)[name].apply(t, args);
    7654| 00151|               that._chatDirty = true;
    7655| 00152|               that.schedulePersistChatHistories();
    7656| 00153|               return r;
    7657| 00154|             };
    7658| 00155|           }
    7659| 00156|         }
    7660| 00157|         return v;
    7661| 00158|       }
    7662| 00159|     };
    7663| 00160|     const proxy = new Proxy(target, handler) as ChatMessage[];
    7664| 00161|     (proxy as any).__isProxy = true;
    7665| 00162|     return proxy;
    7666| 00163|   }
    7667| 00164|

    7716| 00213|   private async persistAgentMessages(): Promise<void> {
    7717| 00214|     try {

    7719| 00216|       const copy: Record<string, { role: string; content: string | null }[]> = {};
    7720| 00217|       for (const [sid, arr] of Object.entries(msgs)) {
    7721| 00218|         if (!Array.isArray(arr) || arr.length === 0) continue;

    7733| 00230|   /** 記錄一次 API 呼叫的 token 使用量，並推送更新到前端。 */
    7734| 00231|   private trackUsage(model: string, tokens: number, multiplier = '', toolCall = false): void {
    7735| 00232|     if (!toolCall && (!tokens || tokens <= 0)) { return; }
    7736| 00233|     const isCopilot = model.startsWith('copilot::') || model.startsWith('copilot/');
    7737| 00234|     const key = model.replace(/^copilot[::\/]+/, '');
    7738| 00235|     const existing = this._usageStats[key];
    7739| 00236|     if (existing) {
    7740| 00237|       existing.tokens += tokens;
    7741| 00238|       if (tokens > 0) existing.calls = (existing.calls || 0) + 1;
    7742| 00239|       if (toolCall) existing.toolCalls = (existing.toolCalls || 0) + 1;
    7743| 00240|     } else {
    7744| 00241|       this._usageStats[key] = { tokens, isCopilot, multiplier, calls: tokens > 0 ? 1 : 0, toolCalls: toolCall ? 1 : 0 };
    7745| 00242|     }
    7746| 00243|     // 持久化累計值
    7747| 00244|     const saved = this._context.globalState.get<Record<string, { tokens: number; isCopilot: boolean; multiplier: string; calls: number; toolCalls: number }>>('amiAiClaw.usageStats') ?? {};
    7748| 00245|     const sk = saved[key];
    7749| 00246|     if (sk) { sk.tokens += tokens; if (tokens > 0) sk.calls = (sk.calls || 0) + 1; if (toolCall) sk.toolCalls = (sk.toolCalls || 0) + 1; }
    7750| 00247|     else { saved[key] = { tokens, isCopilot, multiplier, calls: tokens > 0 ? 1 : 0, toolCalls: toolCall ? 1 : 0 }; }
    7751| 00248|     this._context.globalState.update('amiAiClaw.usageStats', saved);
    7752| 00249|     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'usageUpdate', stats: this._usageStats });
    7753| 00250|   }

    8797| 01294|   /** 統一的 postToWebview 入口，在 todo 模式下攔截訊息以累積回應文字。 */
    8798| 01295|   private _postToWebview(msg: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    8799| 01296|     // 累積 agent / ask 的回應文字
    8800| 01297|     if (this._todoModePrompt !== undefined) {
    8801| 01298|       if (msg.type === 'agentChunk' && typeof msg.text === 'string') {
    8802| 01299|         this._todoAccumulator += msg.text;
    8803| 01300|       } else if (msg.type === 'assistant' && typeof msg.text === 'string') {
    8804| 01301|         this._todoAccumulator += msg.text;
    8805| 01302|       } else if (msg.type === 'agentStatus' && msg.running === false) {
    8806| 01303|         // Agent 全部輪次結束 → 觸發回呼（agentStatus.running===false 才是最終完成信號）
    8807| 01304|         const prompt = this._todoModePrompt;
    8808| 01305|         const response = this._todoAccumulator.trim();
    8809| 01306|         this._todoModePrompt = undefined;
    8810| 01307|         this._todoAccumulator = '';
    8811| 01308|         if (response && OllamaChatPanel.onTodoComplete) {
    8812| 01309|           OllamaChatPanel.onTodoComplete(prompt, response);
    8813| 01310|         }
    8814| 01311|       }
    8815| 01312|     }
    8816| 01313|     this._panel.webview.postMessage(msg);
    8817| 01314|   }

    8842| 01339|   /**
    8843| 01340|    * Send one or more URIs (files or folders) to the open chat panel as context.

    8845| 01342|    */
    8846| 01343|   public static async sendUrisToChat(uris: vscode.Uri[]): Promise<void> {
    8847| 01344|     const panel = OllamaChatPanel.currentPanel;
    8848| 01345|     if (!panel) { return; }
    8849| 01346| 
    8850| 01347|     await panel.waitForWebviewReady();
    8851| 01348| 
    8852| 01349|     for (const uri of uris) {
    8853| 01350|       let stat: vscode.FileStat;
    8854| 01351|       try { stat = await vscode.workspace.fs.stat(uri); } catch { continue; }
    8855| 01352| 
    8856| 01353|       if (stat.type & vscode.FileType.Directory) {
    8857| 01354|         // Send directory listing
    8858| 01355|         const entries = await vscode.workspace.fs.readDirectory(uri);
    8859| 01356|         const listing = entries.map(([name, type]) =>
    8860| 01357|           (type & vscode.FileType.Directory) ? name + '/' : name
    8861| 01358|         ).join('\n');
    8862| 01359|         panel._panel.webview.postMessage({
    8863| 01360|           type: 'fileAttached',
    8864| 01361|           name: uri.fsPath,
    8865| 01362|           content: `[目錄列表]\n${listing}`
    8866| 01363|         });
    8867| 01364|       } else {
    8868| 01365|         // Send file content (limit to 500 KB)
    8869| 01366|         const MAX = 500 * 1024;
    8870| 01367|         const raw = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri);
    8871| 01368|         const content = raw.byteLength > MAX
    8872| 01369|           ? Buffer.from(raw).toString('utf8', 0, MAX) + '\n...(截斷)'
    8873| 01370|           : Buffer.from(raw).toString('utf8');
    8874| 01371|         panel._panel.webview.postMessage({
    8875| 01372|           type: 'fileAttached',
    8876| 01373|           name: uri.fsPath,
    8877| 01374|           content
    8878| 01375|         });
    8879| 01376|       }
    8880| 01377|     }
    8881| 01378|   }

    9206| 01703| /** 估算文字的約略 token 數（CJK 字元每個約 1 token，ASCII 每 4 字元約 1 token）。 */
    9207| 01704| export function estimateTokens(text: string): number {
    9208| 01705|   let count = 0;
    9209| 01706|   for (const ch of text) {
    9210| 01707|     const code = ch.codePointAt(0) ?? 0;
    9211| 01708|     count += code > 0x2E7F ? 1 : 0.25;  // CJK/special ≈ 1 token; ASCII ≈ 1/4 token
    9212| 01709|   }
    9213| 01710|   return Math.ceil(count);
    9214| 01711| }

    9916| 02413| function supportsThinking(model: string): boolean {

    9918| 02415|   const m = model.toLowerCase().replace(/^hf\.co\/[^/]+\//i, '').replace(/^.*\//, '');

    9921| 02418|   // 明確支援 thinking 的模型
    9922| 02419|   return m.startsWith('deepseek-r1') || m.startsWith('deepseek-r2') ||
    9923| 02420|     m.startsWith('qwq') ||
    9924| 02421|     // qwen3 只有 thinking 系列才支援，判斷方式：名稱不含 coder/instruct 且根模型就叫 qwen3
    9925| 02422|     (m.startsWith('qwen3') && !m.includes('coder')) ||
    9926| 02423|     m.includes(':thinking') || m.includes('-thinking') ||
    9927| 02424|     m.includes('think') || m.includes('-r1') || m.includes(':r1') ||

    9933| 02430| export function getCurrentThinkingLevel(): ThinkingLevel {
    9934| 02431|   const v = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw').get<string>('thinkingLevel', 'medium');
    9935| 02432|   return (v === 'off' || v === 'low' || v === 'medium' || v === 'high' || v === 'max') ? v : 'medium';

    9937| 02434| 
    9938| 02435| /**
    9939| 02436|  * 依使用者「思考等級」設定 + 模型能力，回傳要塞進 Ollama request body 的 think 參數。
    9940| 02437|  * - off: 強制 think:false（即使模型支援，也跳過思考，省 token & 加速）
    9941| 02438|  * - low/medium: 傳對應字串（各模型 Jinja 模板通用）
    9942| 02439|  * - high/max: 傳 true（布林），讓 Ollama 套用模型預設最大思考力，避免模板等級字串不相容
    9943| 02440|  * - 模型不支援思考時，不加 think key（讓 Ollama 用模型預設）
    9944| 02441|  */
    9945| 02442| function getOllamaThinkParam(model: string): { think?: boolean | string } {
    9946| 02443|   const level = getCurrentThinkingLevel();
    9947| 02444|   if (level === 'off') { return { think: false }; }
    9948| 02445|   if (!supportsThinking(model)) { return {}; }
    9949| 02446|   // 'low'/'medium' are universally supported strings; 'high'/'max' fall back to boolean true
    9950| 02447|   if (level === 'low' || level === 'medium') { return { think: level }; }
    9951| 02448|   return { think: true };
    9952| 02449| }

    9954| 02451| function ollamaGenerate(baseUrl: string, model: string, prompt: string): Promise<{ response: string; thinking?: string }> {
    9955| 02452|   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    9956| 02453|     try {
    9957| 02454|       const url = new URL('/api/generate', baseUrl);
    9958| 02455|       const params: Record<string, unknown> = { model, prompt, stream: false };
    9959| 02456|       Object.assign(params, getOllamaThinkParam(model));
    9960| 02457|       const body = JSON.stringify(params);
    9961| 02458|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
    9962| 02459| 
    9963| 02460|       const options: http.RequestOptions = {
    9964| 02461|         hostname: url.hostname,
    9965| 02462|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
    9966| 02463|         path: url.pathname,
    9967| 02464|         method: 'POST',
    9968| 02465|         headers: {
    9969| 02466|           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    9970| 02467|           'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body)
    9971| 02468|         }
    9972| 02469|       };
    9973| 02470| 
    9974| 02471|       const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
    9975| 02472|         let data = '';
    9976| 02473|         res.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => { data += chunk; });
    9977| 02474|         res.on('end', () => {
    9978| 02475|           if (res.statusCode !== 200) {

   10046| 02543| export async function ollamaGenerateStreamWithRetry(
   10047| 02544|   baseUrl: string, model: string, prompt: string,
   10048| 02545|   onResponseChunk: (chunk: string) => void,
   10049| 02546|   onThinkChunk?: (chunk: string) => void,
   10050| 02547|   onRetry?: (attempt: number, waitSec: number, err: string) => void,
   10051| 02548|   maxRetries = 10,
   10052| 02549|   retrySec = 60,
   10053| 02550|   onStats?: (tokens: number, tps: number) => void
   10054| 02551| ): Promise<string> {
   10055| 02552|   for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
   10056| 02553|     try {
   10057| 02554|       return await ollamaGenerateStream(baseUrl, model, prompt, onResponseChunk, onThinkChunk, onStats);
   10058| 02555|     } catch (e) {
   10059| 02556|       if (attempt >= maxRetries || !isRetryableOllamaError(e)) throw e;
   10060| 02557|       const errMsg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
   10061| 02558|       if (onRetry) onRetry(attempt + 1, retrySec, errMsg);
   10062| 02559|       await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, retrySec * 1000));
   10063| 02560|     }
   10064| 02561|   }
   10065| 02562|   throw new Error('retry exhausted');
   10066| 02563| }

   10407| 02904| function ollamaCheckConnection(baseUrl: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean; message: string }> {
   10408| 02905|   return new Promise((resolve) => {
   10409| 02906|     try {
   10410| 02907|       const url = new URL('/api/tags', baseUrl);
   10411| 02908|       const openAiUrl = new URL('/v1/models', baseUrl);
   10412| 02909|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
   10413| 02910|       const options: http.RequestOptions = {
   10414| 02911|         hostname: url.hostname,
   10415| 02912|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
   10416| 02913|         path: url.pathname,
   10417| 02914|         method: 'GET',
   10418| 02915|       };
   10419| 02916|       let settled = false;
   10420| 02917| 
   10421| 02918|       const probeOpenAi = () => {
   10422| 02919|         if (settled) { return; }
   10423| 02920|         const p = openAiUrl.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
   10424| 02921|         const req2 = p.request({
   10425| 02922|           hostname: openAiUrl.hostname,
   10426| 02923|           port: openAiUrl.port ? parseInt(openAiUrl.port, 10) : (openAiUrl.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 80),
   10427| 02924|           path: openAiUrl.pathname,
   10428| 02925|           method: 'GET',
   10429| 02926|         }, (res2) => {
   10430| 02927|           res2.resume();
   10431| 02928|           if (!settled) {
   10432| 02929|             settled = true;
   10433| 02930|             resolve({ ok: res2.statusCode === 200, message: res2.statusCode === 200 ? 'OpenAI-compatible OK' : 'HTTP ' + res2.statusCode });
   10434| 02931|           }
   10435| 02932|         });
   10436| 02933|         req2.on('error', (e: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => {
   10437| 02934|           if (!settled) { settled = true; resolve({ ok: false, message: ollamaConnectError(openAiUrl.hostname, e).message }); }
   10438| 02935|         });
   10439| 02936|         req2.setTimeout(8000, () => {
   10440| 02937|           if (!settled) { settled = true; req2.destroy(); resolve({ ok: false, message: '連線逾時 (8s)，請確認主機 ' + openAiUrl.hostname + ' 可達' }); }
   10441| 02938|         });
   10442| 02939|         req2.end();
   10443| 02940|       };
   10444| 02941| 
   10445| 02942|       const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
   10446| 02943|         res.resume();
   10447| 02944|         if (!settled) {
   10448| 02945|           if (res.statusCode === 200) {
   10449| 02946|             settled = true;
   10450| 02947|             resolve({ ok: true, message: 'OK' });
   10451| 02948|           } else {
   10452| 02949|             probeOpenAi();
   10453| 02950|           }
   10454| 02951|         }
   10455| 02952|       });
   10456| 02953|       req.on('error', (e: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => {
   10457| 02954|         if (!settled) { probeOpenAi(); }
   10458| 02955|       });
   10459| 02956|       req.setTimeout(8000, () => {
   10460| 02957|         if (!settled) { req.destroy(); probeOpenAi(); }
   10461| 02958|       });
   10462| 02959|       req.end();
   10463| 02960|     } catch (e) { resolve({ ok: false, message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) }); }
   10464| 02961|   });
   10465| 02962| }

   10494| 02991| /** 拉取 Ollama 模型，透過 onProgress 回報進度字串。返回 Promise，完成或失敗時 resolve/reject。 */
   10495| 02992| function ollamaPullModel(
   10496| 02993|   baseUrl: string,
   10497| 02994|   modelName: string,
   10498| 02995|   onProgress: (status: string, percent: number | null) => void
   10499| 02996| ): Promise<void> {
   10500| 02997|   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   10501| 02998|     try {
   10502| 02999|       const url = new URL('/api/pull', baseUrl);
   10503| 03000|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
   10504| 03001|       const body = JSON.stringify({ model: modelName, stream: true });
   10505| 03002|       const options: http.RequestOptions = {
   10506| 03003|         hostname: url.hostname,
   10507| 03004|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
   10508| 03005|         path: url.pathname,
   10509| 03006|         method: 'POST',
   10510| 03007|         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) },
   10511| 03008|       };
   10512| 03009|       const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
   10513| 03010|         if (res.statusCode !== 200) { res.resume(); reject(new Error('HTTP ' + res.statusCode)); return; }
   10514| 03011|         let buf = '';
   10515| 03012|         res.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => {
   10516| 03013|           buf += chunk.toString();
   10517| 03014|           const lines = buf.split('\n');
   10518| 03015|           buf = lines.pop() ?? '';
   10519| 03016|           for (const line of lines) {
   10520| 03017|             if (!line.trim()) { continue; }
   10521| 03018|             try {
   10522| 03019|               const obj = JSON.parse(line) as { status?: string; completed?: number; total?: number; error?: string };
   10523| 03020|               if (obj.error) { reject(new Error(obj.error)); return; }
   10524| 03021|               const pct = (obj.total && obj.total > 0) ? Math.round((obj.completed ?? 0) / obj.total * 100) : null;
   10525| 03022|               onProgress(obj.status ?? '', pct);
   10526| 03023|             } catch { /* skip malformed JSON lines */ }
   10527| 03024|           }
   10528| 03025|         });
   10529| 03026|         res.on('end', () => resolve());
   10530| 03027|         res.on('error', (e: Error) => reject(e));
   10531| 03028|       });
   10532| 03029|       req.on('error', (e: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => reject(ollamaConnectError(url.hostname, e)));
   10533| 03030|       req.write(body);
   10534| 03031|       req.end();
   10535| 03032|     } catch (e) { reject(e); }
   10536| 03033|   });
   10537| 03034| }

   10539| 03036| function ollamaConnectError(hostname: string, e: NodeJS.ErrnoException): Error {
   10540| 03037|   if (e.code === 'ENOTFOUND') {
   10541| 03038|     return new Error('主機名稱 \'' + hostname + '\' 無法解析（DNS），請確認 /etc/hosts 或 DNS 設定');
   10542| 03039|   }
   10543| 03040|   if (e.code === 'ECONNREFUSED') {
   10544| 03041|     return new Error('連線被拒絕（port 未開放），請確認 Ollama 伺服器已啟動：' + hostname + ':11434');
   10545| 03042|   }
   10546| 03043|   if (e.code === 'ETIMEDOUT' || e.message === 'ETIMEDOUT') {
   10547| 03044|     return new Error('連線逾時，請確認防火牆設定或主機 \'' + hostname + '\' 可達');
   10548| 03045|   }
   10549| 03046|   if (e.code === 'EHOSTUNREACH') {
   10550| 03047|     return new Error('無法到達主機 \'' + hostname + '\'，請確認網路路由設定');
   10551| 03048|   }
   10552| 03049|   return new Error((e.code ? e.code + ': ' : '') + e.message);
   10553| 03050| }

   10687| 00010| /** Agent 執行中的即時狀態，隨心跳廣播給 webview 並供 WA 回報使用。 */
   10688| 00011| export interface AgentHeartbeatInfo {
   10689| 00012|   running: boolean;
   10690| 00013|   step: number;
   10691| 00014|   model: string;
   10692| 00015|   shadowRunning: boolean;
   10693| 00016|   shadowCount: number;
   10694| 00017|   lastActivity: string;
   10695| 00018|   startedAt: number; // ms epoch
   10696| 00019| }
   10697| 00020| 
   10698| 00021| const DEFAULT_AGENT_INFO: AgentHeartbeatInfo = {
   10699| 00022|   running: false, step: 0, model: '', shadowRunning: false,
   10700| 00023|   shadowCount: 0, lastActivity: '', startedAt: 0,
   10701| 00024| };
   10702| 00025| 
   10703| 00026| /**
   10704| 00027|  * HeartbeatService: A singleton service that provides a periodic pulse (5s).
   10705| 00028|  * It allows modules to subscribe to tick events and broadcasts the heartbeat to the Webview UI.
   10706| 00029|  */
   10707| 00030| export class HeartbeatService implements vscode.Disposable {
   10708| 00031|   private static _instance: HeartbeatService | undefined;
   10709| 00032|   private _intervalId: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
   10710| 00033|   private _subscribers: Set<() => void> = new Set();
   10711| 00034|   private _disposables: vscode.Disposable[] = [];
   10712| 00035|   private _agentInfo: AgentHeartbeatInfo = { ...DEFAULT_AGENT_INFO };
   10713| 00036| 
   10714| 00037|   private constructor() {}
   10715| 00038| 
   10716| 00039|   /** Returns the singleton instance of HeartbeatService. */
   10717| 00040|   public static getInstance(): HeartbeatService {
   10718| 00041|     if (!HeartbeatService._instance) {
   10719| 00042|       HeartbeatService._instance = new HeartbeatService();
   10720| 00043|     }
   10721| 00044|     return HeartbeatService._instance;
   10722| 00045|   }
   10723| 00046| 
   10724| 00047|   /** Update agent execution status; called by AgentExecutor at key points. */
   10725| 00048|   public setAgentInfo(info: Partial<AgentHeartbeatInfo>): void {
   10726| 00049|     this._agentInfo = { ...this._agentInfo, ...info };
   10727| 00050|   }
   10728| 00051| 
   10729| 00052|   public getAgentInfo(): Readonly<AgentHeartbeatInfo> { return this._agentInfo; }
   10730| 00053| 
   10731| 00054|   /**
   10732| 00055|    * Starts the heartbeat timer if it's not already running.
   10733| 00056|    * Period: 5000ms (5 seconds).
   10734| 00057|    */
   10735| 00058|   public start(): void {
   10736| 00059|     if (this._intervalId) return;
   10737| 00060| 
   10738| 00061|     this._intervalId = setInterval(() => {
   10739| 00062|       this._subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   10740| 00063|         try {
   10741| 00064|           callback();
   10742| 00065|         } catch (err) {
   10743| 00066|           console.error('[HeartbeatService] Subscriber error:', err);
   10744| 00067|         }
   10745| 00068|       });
   10746| 00069|     }, 5000);
   10747| 00070|   }
   10748| 00071| 
   10749| 00072|   /** Stops the heartbeat timer. */
   10750| 00073|   public stop(): void {
   10751| 00074|     if (this._intervalId) {
   10752| 00075|       clearInterval(this._intervalId);
   10753| 00076|       this._intervalId = undefined;
   10754| 00077|     }
   10755| 00078|   }
   10756| 00079| 
   10757| 00080|   /**
   10758| 00081|    * Registers a callback to be executed on every heartbeat tick.
   10759| 00082|    * @param callback The function to run.
   10760| 00083|    * @returns A disposable that, when disposed, removes the subscription.
   10761| 00084|    */
   10762| 00085|   public onTick(callback: () => void): vscode.Disposable {
   10763| 00086|     this._subscribers.add(callback);
   10764| 00087|     const disposable = { dispose: () => { this._subscribers.delete(callback); } };
   10765| 00088|     this._disposables.push(disposable);
   10766| 00089|     return disposable;
   10767| 00090|   }
   10768| 00091| 
   10769| 00092|   /** Broadcasts a heartbeat signal (including agent status) to the provided Webview panel. */
   10770| 00093|   public broadcastToWebview(panel: IWebviewPanel): void {
   10771| 00094|     const info = this._agentInfo;
   10772| 00095|     panel.webview.postMessage({
   10773| 00096|       type: 'heartbeat-tick',
   10774| 00097|       agentRunning: info.running,
   10775| 00098|       agentStep: info.step,
   10776| 00099|       agentModel: info.model,
   10777| 00100|       shadowRunning: info.shadowRunning,
   10778| 00101|       shadowCount: info.shadowCount,
   10779| 00102|       lastActivity: info.lastActivity,
   10780| 00103|       elapsedMs: info.running && info.startedAt ? Date.now() - info.startedAt : 0,
   10781| 00104|     });
   10782| 00105|   }
   10783| 00106| 
   10784| 00107|   /** Cleans up subscriptions but keeps the interval running (singleton, never truly stopped). */
   10785| 00108|   public dispose(): void {
   10786| 00109|     this._agentInfo = { ...DEFAULT_AGENT_INFO };
   10787| 00110|     this._disposables.forEach((d) => d.dispose());
   10788| 00111|     this._subscribers.clear();
   10789| 00112|     this._disposables = [];
   10790| 00113|   }
   10791| 00114| }

   10890| 00096| export function buildSessionNotes(ctx: SessionNotesContext, existing: string): string {

   10904| 00110|   const worklogLines = c.recentWorkLog.slice(-8).map(w => `- ${w}`).join('\n');

   10906| 00112|

   10908| 00114|   const keyFilesLines = [

   10913| 00119|   const verifiedLines = c.verifiedWork.slice(-10).map(w => `- ${w}`).join('\n');
   10914| 00120|

   10918| 00124|     ``,

   10920| 00126|     ctx.taskDescription ? ctx.taskDescription.slice(0, 400) : '_（未記錄）_',
   10921| 00127|     ``,

   11152| 00125| export async function executeExtractMemories(
   11153| 00126|   shortTermText: string,
   11154| 00127|   options: ExtractMemoriesOptions = {}
   11155| 00128| ): Promise<ExtractMemoriesResult | null> {
   11156| 00129|   if (!shortTermText || shortTermText.trim().length === 0) return null;
   11157| 00130| 
   11158| 00131|   const now = Date.now();
   11159| 00132|   if (extractionInProgress) return null;
   11160| 00133|   if (!options.ignoreInterval && now - lastExtractionTs < MIN_INTERVAL_MS) return null;
   11161| 00134| 
   11162| 00135|   extractionInProgress = true;
   11163| 00136|   try {
   11164| 00137|     const dir = await memdir.ensureMemoryDirExists();
   11165| 00138|     const source = shortTermText.slice(0, MAX_SOURCE_CHARS);
   11166| 00139| 
   11167| 00140|     if (!options.caller) {
   11168| 00141|       // Fallback：無 LLM 時直接寫快照（向後相容舊行為）
   11169| 00142|       const name = `auto-${Date.now()}.md`;
   11170| 00143|       const p = path.join(dir, name);
   11171| 00144|       const body = `Source snapshot: ${new Date().toISOString()}\n\n${source}`;
   11172| 00145|       const meta = {
   11173| 00146|         type: 'context' as MemoryType,
   11174| 00147|         title: 'Auto-extracted snapshot',
   11175| 00148|         created: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
   11176| 00149|       };
   11177| 00150|       await fs.writeFile(p, stringifyMemoryFrontmatter(meta, body), 'utf8');
   11178| 00151|       lastExtractionTs = Date.now();
   11179| 00152|       return { written: [p], updatedIndex: false, fallback: true };
   11180| 00153|     }
   11181| 00154| 
   11182| 00155|     const existingIndex = await memdir.readMemoryIndex();
   11183| 00156|     const prompt = buildExtractPrompt(existingIndex);
   11184| 00157| 
   11185| 00158|     let items: ExtractedMemoryItem[] = [];
   11186| 00159|     try {
   11187| 00160|       items = await options.caller.extract({
   11188| 00161|         sourceText: source,
   11189| 00162|         existingIndex,
   11190| 00163|         extractPrompt: prompt,
   11191| 00164|       });
   11192| 00165|     } catch {
   11193| 00166|       lastExtractionTs = Date.now();
   11194| 00167|       return { written: [], updatedIndex: false, fallback: true };
   11195| 00168|     }
   11196| 00169| 
   11197| 00170|     if (items.length === 0) {
   11198| 00171|       lastExtractionTs = Date.now();
   11199| 00172|       return { written: [], updatedIndex: false, fallback: false };
   11200| 00173|     }
   11201| 00174| 
   11202| 00175|     const written: string[] = [];
   11203| 00176|     const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
   11204| 00177|     for (const item of items) {
   11205| 00178|       if (!MEMORY_TYPE_VALUES.includes(item.type)) continue;
   11206| 00179|       const safeSlug = sanitizeSlug(item.slug || item.title);
   11207| 00180|       if (!safeSlug) continue;
   11208| 00181|       const filename = `${safeSlug}.md`;
   11209| 00182|       const filepath = path.join(dir, filename);
   11210| 00183| 
   11211| 00184|       const existed = await fileExists(filepath);
   11212| 00185|       const meta: {
   11213| 00186|         type: MemoryType;
   11214| 00187|         title: string;
   11215| 00188|         tags?: string[];
   11216| 00189|         created?: string;
   11217| 00190|         updated: string;
   11218| 00191|       } = {
   11219| 00192|         type: item.type,
   11220| 00193|         title: item.title.slice(0, 200),
   11221| 00194|         tags: item.tags?.slice(0, 10),
   11222| 00195|         created: existed ? undefined : today,
   11223| 00196|         updated: today,
   11224| 00197|       };
   11225| 00198|       if (existed) {
   11226| 00199|         try {
   11227| 00200|           const old = await fs.readFile(filepath, 'utf8');
   11228| 00201|           const created = old.match(/^created:\s*(.+)$/m)?.[1]?.trim();
   11229| 00202|           if (created) meta.created = created;
   11230| 00203|         } catch { /* ignore */ }
   11231| 00204|       }
   11232| 00205|       await fs.writeFile(
   11233| 00206|         filepath,
   11234| 00207|         stringifyMemoryFrontmatter(meta as Required<Pick<typeof meta, 'type' | 'title' | 'updated'>> & typeof meta, item.body.trim()),
   11235| 00208|         'utf8'
   11236| 00209|       );
   11237| 00210|       written.push(filepath);
   11238| 00211|     }
   11239| 00212| 
   11240| 00213|     const updatedIndex = await updateMemoryIndex(items, existingIndex);
   11241| 00214|     lastExtractionTs = Date.now();
   11242| 00215|     return { written, updatedIndex, fallback: false };
   11243| 00216|   } catch {
   11244| 00217|     return null;
   11245| 00218|   } finally {
   11246| 00219|     extractionInProgress = false;
   11247| 00220|   }
   11248| 00221| }

   11251| 00224| // Helpers

   11253| 00226| 
   11254| 00227| function sanitizeSlug(s: string): string {
   11255| 00228|   return s
   11256| 00229|     .toLowerCase()
   11257| 00230|     .replace(/[^\w\- ]+/g, '')
   11258| 00231|     .trim()
   11259| 00232|     .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
   11260| 00233|     .replace(/-+/g, '-')
   11261| 00234|     .slice(0, 80);
   11262| 00235| }
   11263| 00236| 
   11264| 00237| async function fileExists(p: string): Promise<boolean> {
   11265| 00238|   try { await fs.stat(p); return true; } catch { return false; }
   11266| 00239| }
   11267| 00240| 
   11268| 00241| async function updateMemoryIndex(
   11269| 00242|   newItems: ExtractedMemoryItem[],
   11270| 00243|   existingIndex: string
   11271| 00244| ): Promise<boolean> {
   11272| 00245|   try {
   11273| 00246|     const existingLines = existingIndex.split('\n');
   11274| 00247|     const seen = new Set<string>();
   11275| 00248|     for (const line of existingLines) {
   11276| 00249|       const m = line.match(/\[.*?\]\(([\w\-.]+)\)/);
   11277| 00250|       if (m) seen.add(m[1]);
   11278| 00251|     }
   11279| 00252| 
   11280| 00253|     const newLines: string[] = [];
   11281| 00254|     for (const it of newItems) {
   11282| 00255|       const slug = sanitizeSlug(it.slug || it.title);
   11283| 00256|       if (!slug) continue;
   11284| 00257|       const filename = `${slug}.md`;
   11285| 00258|       if (seen.has(filename)) continue;
   11286| 00259|       const hook = it.oneLineHook.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, MAX_INDEX_LINE_LENGTH);
   11287| 00260|       newLines.push(`- [${it.title}](${filename}) — ${hook}`);
   11288| 00261|     }
   11289| 00262| 
   11290| 00263|     if (newLines.length === 0) return false;
   11291| 00264| 
   11292| 00265|     const header = existingLines.length > 0 && existingIndex.trim().length > 0
   11293| 00266|       ? existingIndex.trimEnd() + '\n'
   11294| 00267|       : '# Memory Index\n\n';
   11295| 00268|     let combined = header + newLines.join('\n') + '\n';
   11296| 00269| 
   11297| 00270|     const lines = combined.split('\n');
   11298| 00271|     if (lines.length > MAX_INDEX_LINES) {
   11299| 00272|       combined = lines.slice(0, MAX_INDEX_LINES).join('\n') + '\n';
   11300| 00273|     }
   11301| 00274|     await memdir.saveMemoryIndex(combined);
   11302| 00275|     return true;
   11303| 00276|   } catch {
   11304| 00277|     return false;
   11305| 00278|   }
   11306| 00279| }

   11969| 00482|   public static pickThinkingModel(models: string[]): string {
   11970| 00483|     if (models.length === 0) { return ''; }
   11971| 00484|     const RANK = [/deepseek-r1/i, /qwq/i, /r1/i, /thinking/i, /reasoner/i, /reflect/i];
   11972| 00485|     let best = models[0]; let bestScore = -1;
   11973| 00486|     for (const m of models) {
   11974| 00487|       const score = RANK.findIndex(r => r.test(m));
   11975| 00488|       const s = score === -1 ? RANK.length : score;
   11976| 00489|       if (bestScore === -1 || s < bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = m; }
   11977| 00490|     }
   11978| 00491|     return best;
   11979| 00492|   }

   12256| 00769|   private async _handleTeamAgent(prompt: string, allModels: string[], roles?: string[]): Promise<void> {
   12257| 00770|     const cfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
   12258| 00771|     const urls = this._services.getOllamaUrls(cfg);
   12259| 00772|     const COLORS = TEAM_COLORS;
   12260| 00773|     const getDisplay = (m: string) => getWorkerDisplay(m, urls, (id, u) => this._services.decodeOllamaModel(id, u));
   12261| 00774|     const _agentRolesCfg = cfg.get<Array<{key:string;label:string;emoji:string;systemPrompt:string}>>('teamRoles', []);
   12262| 00775|     const _roleCfg  = (idx: number) => { const k = roles?.[idx]; return k ? _agentRolesCfg.find(c => c.key === k) : undefined; };
   12263| 00776|     const _rolePrefix = (idx: number) => { const r = _roleCfg(idx); return r ? `${r.emoji} ${r.label} ` : '💬 '; };
   12264| 00777|     const _roleNote   = (idx: number) => { const r = _roleCfg(idx); return r?.systemPrompt ? r.systemPrompt + '\n\n' : (roles?.[idx] ? TeamManager.buildRoleSystemNote(roles[idx]) + '\n\n' : ''); };
   12265| 00778| 
   12266| 00779|     // 討論前先掃描工作區，讓所有成員基於實際程式碼討論
   12267| 00780|     this._panel.webview.postMessage({ type: 'teamSynthChunk', chunk: '🔍 正在掃描工作區原始碼與 teamscontext.md…\n' });
