   13231| 00062|  * 純資料產出，不發送任何 UI 訊息（由呼叫端依模式自行發送進度）。
   13232| 00063|  */
   13233| 00064| export async function scanWorkspaceForTeam(): Promise<TeamWorkspaceScan> {
   13234| 00065|   const wsFolders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [];
   13235| 00066|   const wsRoot = wsFolders.length > 0 ? wsFolders[0].uri.fsPath : process.cwd();
   13236| 00067| 
   13237| 00068|   const teamsCtxPath = path.join(wsRoot, 'teamscontext.md');
   13238| 00069|   let teamsCtxContent = '';
   13239| 00070|   try {
   13240| 00071|     const tcBytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(teamsCtxPath));
   13241| 00072|     teamsCtxContent = Buffer.from(tcBytes).toString('utf-8').trim();
   13242| 00073|   } catch { /* 不存在則略過 */ }
   13243| 00074| 
   13244| 00075|   const allUris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles('**/*', SKIP_DIRS, FIND_LIMIT);
   13245| 00076|   allUris.sort((a, b) => a.fsPath.localeCompare(b.fsPath));
   13246| 00077|   const filteredUris = allUris.filter(uri => !SKIP_EXT.has(path.extname(uri.fsPath).toLowerCase()));
   13247| 00078|   const allRelPaths = filteredUris.map(uri => path.relative(wsRoot, uri.fsPath).replace(/\\/g, '/'));
   13248| 00079|   const fileListBlock = `【工作區檔案清單（${allRelPaths.length} 個）】\n${allRelPaths.map(p => `  - ${p}`).join('\n')}`;
   13249| 00080| 
   13250| 00081|   const batches: string[][] = [];
   13251| 00082|   let curBatch: string[] = [];
   13252| 00083|   let curBatchBytes = 0;
   13253| 00084|   let totalBytes = 0;
   13254| 00085|   for (const uri of filteredUris) {
   13255| 00086|     const rel = path.relative(wsRoot, uri.fsPath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
   13256| 00087|     try {
   13257| 00088|       const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri);
   13258| 00089|       let text = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf-8');
   13259| 00090|       if (text.length > MAX_FILE) { text = text.slice(0, MAX_FILE) + `\n...（${rel} 已截斷，僅顯示前段）`; }
   13260| 00091|       const entry = `### ${rel}\n\`\`\`\n${text}\n\`\`\``;
   13261| 00092|       if (curBatchBytes + entry.length > BATCH_SIZE && curBatch.length > 0) {
   13262| 00093|         batches.push(curBatch);
   13263| 00094|         curBatch = []; curBatchBytes = 0;
   13264| 00095|       }
   13265| 00096|       curBatch.push(entry);
   13266| 00097|       curBatchBytes += entry.length;
   13267| 00098|       totalBytes += text.length;
   13268| 00099|     } catch { /* 略過無法讀取的二進位檔 */ }
   13269| 00100|   }
   13270| 00101|   if (curBatch.length > 0) batches.push(curBatch);
   13271| 00102|   const readCount = batches.reduce((s, b) => s + b.length, 0);
   13272| 00103| 
   13273| 00104|   const baseCtx = [
   13274| 00105|     `【工作區路徑】${wsRoot}`,
   13275| 00106|     teamsCtxContent ? `【teamscontext.md — 先前討論紀錄】\n${teamsCtxContent}` : '',
   13276| 00107|     fileListBlock,
   13277| 00108|   ].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');
   13278| 00109| 
   13279| 00110|   return { wsRoot, teamsCtxPath, teamsCtxContent, allRelPaths, batches, totalBytes, readCount, baseCtx };
   13280| 00111| }
   13281| 00112| 
   13282| 00113| /**
   13283| 00114|  * 把掃描結果組裝成「逐批餵碼」的多輪對話歷史。
   13284| 00115|  *   - 有批次：user(baseCtx+第1批) → assistant(已讀第N批) → user(第N+1批) → … → assistant(已讀完。{finalPrompt})
   13285| 00116|  *   - 無批次且提供 emptyFallbackAssistant：user(baseCtx) → assistant(emptyFallbackAssistant)
   13286| 00117|  *   - 無批次且未提供 fallback：回傳空陣列（manager 模式行為）
   13287| 00118|  *
   13288| 00119|  * @param finalPrompt 讀完後 assistant 收尾語（discussion="請提出問題。" / manager="請提出任務。"）
   13289| 00120|  * @param emptyFallbackAssistant 無批次時的 assistant 回覆（僅 discussion 提供）
   13290| 00121|  */
   13291| 00122| export function buildBatchedInitHistory(
   13292| 00123|   scan: TeamWorkspaceScan,
   13293| 00124|   finalPrompt: string,
   13294| 00125|   emptyFallbackAssistant?: string
   13295| 00126| ): TeamHistoryEntry[] {
   13296| 00127|   const { baseCtx, batches, allRelPaths, totalBytes } = scan;
   13297| 00128|   const hist: TeamHistoryEntry[] = [];
   13298| 00129|   if (batches.length > 0) {
   13299| 00130|     hist.push({ role: 'user', content:
   13300| 00131|       `${baseCtx}\n\n【第 1/${batches.length} 批原始碼（${batches[0].length} 個檔案）】\n\n${batches[0].join('\n\n')}`
   13301| 00132|     });
   13302| 00133|     for (let bi = 1; bi < batches.length; bi++) {
   13303| 00134|       hist.push({ role: 'assistant', content: `已閱讀第 ${bi}/${batches.length} 批（${batches[bi - 1].length} 個檔案），繼續接收下一批。` });
   13304| 00135|       hist.push({ role: 'user', content:
   13305| 00136|         `【第 ${bi + 1}/${batches.length} 批原始碼（${batches[bi].length} 個檔案）】\n\n${batches[bi].join('\n\n')}`
   13306| 00137|       });
   13307| 00138|     }
   13308| 00139|     hist.push({ role: 'assistant', content: `已完整閱讀全部 ${batches.length} 批共 ${allRelPaths.length} 個檔案（${Math.round(totalBytes / 1024)}KB）。${finalPrompt}` });
   13309| 00140|   } else if (emptyFallbackAssistant !== undefined) {
   13310| 00141|     hist.push({ role: 'user', content: baseCtx });
   13311| 00142|     hist.push({ role: 'assistant', content: emptyFallbackAssistant });
   13312| 00143|   }
   13313| 00144|   return hist;
   13314| 00145| }
   13315| 00146| 
   13316| 00147| /**
   13317| 00148|  * 把掃描結果攤平成單一字串（供 Copilot 無多輪歷史的路徑使用）。
   13318| 00149|  */
   13319| 00150| export function buildCopilotBatchCtx(scan: TeamWorkspaceScan): string {
   13320| 00151|   const { baseCtx, batches } = scan;
   13321| 00152|   return [baseCtx, ...batches.map((b, i) => `【第 ${i + 1}/${batches.length} 批原始碼】\n\n${b.join('\n\n')}`)].join('\n\n');
   13322| 00153| }

   13382| 00039|       && this._state.status !== 'committed'
   13383| 00040|       && this._state.status !== 'rolled_back';

   13390| 00047|   initShadow(sessionId: string): void {
   13391| 00048|     if (this.isActive()) { this.rollback(); }
   13392| 00049|     this._wsRoot = (vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [])[0]?.uri.fsPath ?? process.cwd();
   13393| 00050|     const shadowDir = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `ami-shadow-${sessionId}-${Date.now()}`);
   13394| 00051|     fs.mkdirSync(shadowDir, { recursive: true });
   13395| 00052|     this._state = { status: 'staging', shadowDir, files: [] };
   13396| 00053|     this._notify();

   13398| 00055|   }
   13399| 00056| 
   13400| 00057|   mapToShadow(originalPath: string): string {
   13401| 00058|     const rel = path.isAbsolute(originalPath)
   13402| 00059|       ? path.relative(this._wsRoot, originalPath)
   13403| 00060|       : originalPath;
   13404| 00061|     return path.join(this._state.shadowDir, rel);
   13405| 00062|   }
   13406| 00063| 
   13407| 00064|   recordChange(entry: Omit<ShadowFileEntry, 'verified'>): void {
   13408| 00065|     const full: ShadowFileEntry = { ...entry, verified: false };
   13409| 00066|     const idx = this._state.files.findIndex(f => f.original === entry.original);
   13410| 00067|     if (idx >= 0) this._state.files[idx] = full;
   13411| 00068|     else this._state.files.push(full);
   13412| 00069|     this._state.status = 'staging';
   13413| 00070|     this._notify();
   13414| 00071|   }
   13415| 00072| 
   13416| 00073|   async verify(): Promise<SandboxVerifyResult> {
   13417| 00074|     if (!this.isActive() || this._state.files.length === 0) {
   13418| 00075|       return { passed: false, output: '影子區無待驗證檔案', errors: [] };
   13419| 00076|     }
   13420| 00077|     this._state.status = 'verifying';
   13421| 00078|     this._notify();
   13422| 00079| 
   13423| 00080|     const errors: SandboxVerifyResult['errors'] = [];
   13424| 00081|     let output = '';
   13425| 00082| 
   13426| 00083|     // 1. 確認影子檔案都存在
   13427| 00084|     for (const f of this._state.files) {
   13428| 00085|       if (f.op !== 'delete' && !fs.existsSync(f.shadow)) {
   13429| 00086|         errors.push({ file: f.original, message: `影子檔案不存在: ${f.shadow}` });
   13430| 00087|       }
   13431| 00088|     }
   13432| 00089| 
   13433| 00090|     // 2. TypeScript 檢查（僅針對 .ts / .tsx 檔案）
   13434| 00091|     const tsFiles = this._state.files.filter(f =>
   13435| 00092|       f.op !== 'delete' && (f.original.endsWith('.ts') || f.original.endsWith('.tsx'))
   13436| 00093|     );
   13437| 00094|     if (tsFiles.length > 0 && errors.length === 0) {
   13438| 00095|       const filePaths = tsFiles.map(f => `"${f.shadow}"`).join(' ');
   13439| 00096|       try {
   13440| 00097|         execSync(`tsc --noEmit --allowJs --skipLibCheck ${filePaths}`, { timeout: 30000, cwd: this._wsRoot });
   13441| 00098|         output += '✅ TypeScript 語法檢查通過\n';
   13442| 00099|         tsFiles.forEach(f => { f.verified = true; });
   13443| 00100|       } catch (e) {
   13444| 00101|         // 同時擷取 stdout + stderr，不截斷，完整寫入 log
   13445| 00102|         const err = e as { stdout?: Buffer | string; stderr?: Buffer | string };
   13446| 00103|         const toStr = (v: Buffer | string | undefined) =>
   13447| 00104|           v ? (Buffer.isBuffer(v) ? v.toString('utf8') : String(v)) : '';
   13448| 00105|         const fullOutput = [toStr(err.stdout), toStr(err.stderr)]
   13449| 00106|           .filter(Boolean).join('\n').trim()
   13450| 00107|           || (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
   13451| 00108|         output += `❌ TypeScript 錯誤:\n${fullOutput.slice(0, 4000)}${
   13452| 00109|           fullOutput.length > 4000 ? `\n…（共 ${fullOutput.length} 字，已截斷前 4000）` : ''}\n`;
   13453| 00110|         this._log(`[Shadow] tsc 完整輸出:\n${fullOutput}`);  // log 不截斷
   13454| 00111|         const lineRe = /(.+?)\((\d+),(\d+)\): error (TS\d+): (.+)/g;
   13455| 00112|         let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
   13456| 00113|         while ((m = lineRe.exec(fullOutput)) !== null) {
   13457| 00114|           errors.push({ file: m[1], message: `${m[4]}: ${m[5]}`, line: Number(m[2]) });
   13458| 00115|         }
   13459| 00116|       }
   13460| 00117|     }
   13461| 00118| 
   13462| 00119|     const passed = errors.length === 0;
   13463| 00120|     this._state.verifyPassed = passed;
   13464| 00121|     this._state.verifyOutput = output + (errors.length > 0 ? `\n${errors.map(e => `  - ${path.basename(e.file)}:${e.line ?? ''} ${e.message}`).join('\n')}` : '');
   13465| 00122|     this._state.status = passed ? 'ready_to_commit' : 'staging';
   13466| 00123|     this._notify();
   13467| 00124|     return { passed, output: this._state.verifyOutput, errors };
   13468| 00125|   }
   13469| 00126| 
   13470| 00127|   async commit(): Promise<string[]> {
   13471| 00128|     const committed: string[] = [];
   13472| 00129|     for (const entry of this._state.files) {
   13473| 00130|       try {
   13474| 00131|         if (entry.op === 'delete') {
   13475| 00132|           fs.rmSync(entry.original, { force: true });
   13476| 00133|         } else {
   13477| 00134|           fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(entry.original), { recursive: true });
   13478| 00135|           fs.copyFileSync(entry.shadow, entry.original);
   13479| 00136|         }
   13480| 00137|         committed.push(entry.original);
   13481| 00138|         this._postToWebview({ type: 'fileModified', filePath: entry.original, op: entry.op, ts: Date.now() });
   13482| 00139|         this._log(`[Shadow] ✅ 提交: ${entry.original}`);
   13483| 00140|       } catch (e) {
   13484| 00141|         this._log(`[Shadow] ❌ 提交失敗 ${entry.original}: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
   13485| 00142|       }
   13486| 00143|     }
   13487| 00144|     this._state.status = 'committed';
   13488| 00145|     this._notify();
   13489| 00146|     // 清理暫存區
   13490| 00147|     setTimeout(() => this._cleanup(), 3000);
   13491| 00148|     return committed;
   13492| 00149|   }
   13493| 00150| 
   13494| 00151|   rollback(): void {
   13495| 00152|     this._log(`[Shadow] 回滾影子工作區: ${this._state.shadowDir}`);
   13496| 00153|     this._cleanup();
   13497| 00154|     this._state = { status: 'rolled_back', shadowDir: '', files: [] };
   13498| 00155|     this._notify();
   13499| 00156|     setTimeout(() => {
   13500| 00157|       this._state = { status: 'idle', shadowDir: '', files: [] };
   13501| 00158|       this._notify();
   13502| 00159|     }, 2000);
   13503| 00160|   }
   13504| 00161| 
   13505| 00162|   // ── 路徑攔截（供 ToolExecutor 呼叫）────────────────────────────────────────
   13506| 00163| 
   13507| 00164|   /**
   13508| 00165|    * 接管工具呼叫：重寫 args 中的路徑指向影子區，
   13509| 00166|    * 執行後記錄變更。回傳影子化後的 args（供下游 provider 使用）。
   13510| 00167|    */
   13511| 00168|   remapArgs(
   13512| 00169|     toolName: string,
   13513| 00170|     args: Record<string, unknown>,
   13514| 00171|   ): Record<string, unknown> {
   13515| 00172|     const remapped: Record<string, unknown> = { ...args };
   13516| 00173|     for (const key of PATH_KEYS) {
   13517| 00174|       if (typeof remapped[key] === 'string' && remapped[key]) {
   13518| 00175|         const orig = remapped[key] as string;
   13519| 00176|         const shadow = this.mapToShadow(orig);
   13520| 00177|         // 確保影子目錄存在
   13521| 00178|         fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(shadow), { recursive: true });
   13522| 00179|         // 若是讀類路徑且原始檔案存在但影子不存在，先複製過去（copy-on-write）
   13523| 00180|         if (fs.existsSync(orig) && !fs.existsSync(shadow)) {
   13524| 00181|           try { fs.copyFileSync(orig, shadow); } catch { /* ignore */ }
   13525| 00182|         }
   13526| 00183|         remapped[key] = shadow;
   13527| 00184|       }
   13528| 00185|     }
   13529| 00186|     // 記錄此次變更：每個工具明確定義哪些路徑鍵對映成哪种 op，覆蓋單一鍵取値的疑義
   13530| 00187|     const toolRecords: Record<string, Array<{ key: string; op: ShadowFileEntry['op'] }>> = {
   13531| 00188|       write_file:          [{ key: 'path', op: 'write' }],
   13532| 00189|       replace_in_file:     [{ key: 'path', op: 'replace' }],
   13533| 00190|       insert_in_file:      [{ key: 'path', op: 'insert' }],
   13534| 00191|       replace_all_in_file: [{ key: 'path', op: 'replace' }],
   13535| 00192|       batch_replace:       [{ key: 'path', op: 'replace' }],
   13536| 00193|       rename_file:         [{ key: 'src', op: 'delete' }, { key: 'dest', op: 'write' }],
   13537| 00194|       copy_file:           [{ key: 'dest', op: 'write' }],
   13538| 00195|       delete_file:         [{ key: 'path', op: 'delete' }],
   13539| 00196|       todo_write:          [{ key: 'path', op: 'write' }],
   13540| 00197|       memory_write:        [{ key: 'path', op: 'write' }],
   13541| 00198|       create_dir:          [{ key: 'path', op: 'write' }],
   13542| 00199|     };
   13543| 00200|     for (const { key, op } of toolRecords[toolName] ?? []) {
   13544| 00201|       const rawPath = args[key] as string | undefined;
   13545| 00202|       if (!rawPath) continue;
   13546| 00203|       const originalPath = path.isAbsolute(rawPath) ? rawPath : path.join(this._wsRoot, rawPath);
   13547| 00204|       this.recordChange({ original: originalPath, shadow: this.mapToShadow(originalPath), op });
   13548| 00205|     }
   13549| 00206|     return remapped;
   13550| 00207|   }
   13551| 00208| 
   13552| 00209|   // ── helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   13553| 00210| 
   13554| 00211|   private _cleanup(): void {
   13555| 00212|     try {
   13556| 00213|       if (this._state.shadowDir && fs.existsSync(this._state.shadowDir)) {
   13557| 00214|         fs.rmSync(this._state.shadowDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
   13558| 00215|       }
   13559| 00216|     } catch { /* ignore cleanup errors */ }
   13560| 00217|   }
   13561| 00218| 
   13562| 00219|   private _notify(): void {
   13563| 00220|     this._postToWebview({ type: 'shadowStateUpdate', state: this.getState() });
   13564| 00221|   }
   13565| 00222| }

   13646| 00019|  */
   13647| 00020| export class ToolAuditLog {
   13648| 00021|   private _entries: AuditEntry[] = [];
   13649| 00022|   private static readonly RUNTIME_MAX = 200;
   13650| 00023|   private static readonly STORAGE_MAX = 500;
   13651| 00024|   private static readonly STORAGE_KEY = 'amiAiClaw.auditLog';
   13652| 00025| 
   13653| 00026|   public constructor(private readonly _context: vscode.ExtensionContext) {
   13654| 00027|     this._entries = (this._context.globalState.get<AuditEntry[]>(ToolAuditLog.STORAGE_KEY) ?? []).slice(-ToolAuditLog.RUNTIME_MAX);
   13655| 00028|   }
   13656| 00029| 
   13657| 00030|   /** 取得儲存的完整 log（最多 500 筆）。會同步刷新 in-memory 視圖。 */

   13664| 00037|   public push(entry: AuditEntry): void {

   13666| 00039|     if (this._entries.length > ToolAuditLog.RUNTIME_MAX) { this._entries.shift(); }
   13667| 00040|     const saved = this._context.globalState.get<AuditEntry[]>(ToolAuditLog.STORAGE_KEY) ?? [];
   13668| 00041|     saved.push(entry);
   13669| 00042|     if (saved.length > ToolAuditLog.STORAGE_MAX) { saved.splice(0, saved.length - ToolAuditLog.STORAGE_MAX); }
   13670| 00043|     void this._context.globalState.update(ToolAuditLog.STORAGE_KEY, saved);
   13671| 00044|   }

   13675| ===== FILE: src\tools\ToolCache.ts  (33 lines) =====
   13676| 00001| // Copyright (c) 2026 YCHsu. All rights reserved.
   13677| 00002| // Licensed under the MIT License.
   13678| 00003| 
   13679| 00004| /**
   13680| 00005|  * 工具結果快取：TTL 內回傳上次值，過期自動失效。
   13681| 00006|  */
   13682| 00007| export class ToolCache {
   13683| 00008|   private _map = new Map<string, { value: string; ts: number }>();
   13684| 00009| 
   13685| 00010|   public constructor(private readonly _ttlMs: number = 30_000) {}
   13686| 00011| 
   13687| 00012|   public get(key: string): string | undefined {
   13688| 00013|     const entry = this._map.get(key);
   13689| 00014|     if (!entry) { return undefined; }
   13690| 00015|     if (Date.now() - entry.ts > this._ttlMs) {
   13691| 00016|       this._map.delete(key);
   13692| 00017|       return undefined;
   13693| 00018|     }
   13694| 00019|     return entry.value;
   13695| 00020|   }
   13696| 00021| 
   13697| 00022|   public set(key: string, value: string): void {
   13698| 00023|     this._map.set(key, { value, ts: Date.now() });
   13699| 00024|   }
   13700| 00025| 
   13701| 00026|   public delete(key: string): void {

   13748| 00037| // ─── Unified Diff helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   13749| 00038| function computeUnifiedDiff(
   13750| 00039|   aLines: string[], bLines: string[],
   13751| 00040|   fileA: string, fileB: string,
   13752| 00041|   contextLines: number
   13753| 00042| ): string {
   13754| 00043|   // 簡易 LCS-based unified diff
   13755| 00044|   const m = aLines.length, n = bLines.length;
   13756| 00045|   // DP LCS table (只存長度，用回溯)
   13757| 00046|   const dp: number[][] = Array.from({ length: m + 1 }, () => new Array(n + 1).fill(0));
   13758| 00047|   for (let i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
   13759| 00048|     for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
   13760| 00049|       if (aLines[i - 1] === bLines[j - 1]) { dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1; }
   13761| 00050|       else { dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]); }
   13762| 00051|     }
   13763| 00052|   }
   13764| 00053|   // Backtrack to get edit script
   13765| 00054|   type Edit = { op: ' ' | '-' | '+'; line: string; ai: number; bi: number };
   13766| 00055|   const edits: Edit[] = [];
   13767| 00056|   let i = m, j = n;
   13768| 00057|   while (i > 0 || j > 0) {
   13769| 00058|     if (i > 0 && j > 0 && aLines[i-1] === bLines[j-1]) {
   13770| 00059|       edits.push({ op: ' ', line: aLines[i-1], ai: i, bi: j }); i--; j--;
   13771| 00060|     } else if (j > 0 && (i === 0 || dp[i][j-1] >= dp[i-1][j])) {
   13772| 00061|       edits.push({ op: '+', line: bLines[j-1], ai: i, bi: j }); j--;
   13773| 00062|     } else {
   13774| 00063|       edits.push({ op: '-', line: aLines[i-1], ai: i, bi: j }); i--;
   13775| 00064|     }
   13776| 00065|   }
   13777| 00066|   edits.reverse();
   13778| 00067|   // Build hunks
   13779| 00068|   const changed = new Set(edits.map((e, idx) => e.op !== ' ' ? idx : -1).filter(x => x >= 0));
   13780| 00069|   if (changed.size === 0) { return ''; }
   13781| 00070|   const inHunk = new Set<number>();
   13782| 00071|   for (const c of changed) {
   13783| 00072|     for (let k = Math.max(0, c - contextLines); k <= Math.min(edits.length - 1, c + contextLines); k++) {
   13784| 00073|       inHunk.add(k);
   13785| 00074|     }
   13786| 00075|   }
   13787| 00076|   const lines: string[] = [`--- ${fileA}`, `+++ ${fileB}`];
   13788| 00077|   let inBlock = false, aStart = 0, bStart = 0, aCount = 0, bCount = 0;
   13789| 00078|   const hunkLines: string[] = [];
   13790| 00079|   const flushHunk = () => {
   13791| 00080|     if (hunkLines.length) {
   13792| 00081|       lines.push(`@@ -${aStart},${aCount} +${bStart},${bCount} @@`);
   13793| 00082|       lines.push(...hunkLines);
   13794| 00083|       hunkLines.length = 0; inBlock = false;
   13795| 00084|     }
   13796| 00085|   };
   13797| 00086|   let aIdx = 1, bIdx = 1;
   13798| 00087|   for (let k = 0; k < edits.length; k++) {
   13799| 00088|     const e = edits[k];
   13800| 00089|     if (inHunk.has(k)) {
   13801| 00090|       if (!inBlock) {
   13802| 00091|         flushHunk();
   13803| 00092|         aStart = e.op === '+' ? aIdx : aIdx;
   13804| 00093|         bStart = e.op === '-' ? bIdx : bIdx;
   13805| 00094|         aCount = 0; bCount = 0; inBlock = true;
   13806| 00095|       }
   13807| 00096|       hunkLines.push(e.op + e.line);
   13808| 00097|       if (e.op !== '+') { aCount++; aIdx++; }
   13809| 00098|       if (e.op !== '-') { bCount++; bIdx++; }
   13810| 00099|     } else {
   13811| 00100|       if (inBlock) { flushHunk(); }
   13812| 00101|       if (e.op !== '+') { aIdx++; }
   13813| 00102|       if (e.op !== '-') { bIdx++; }
   13814| 00103|     }
   13815| 00104|   }
   13816| 00105|   flushHunk();
   13817| 00106|   return lines.join('\n');
   13818| 00107| }
   13819| 00108| 
   13820| 00109| // ─── Diff stats helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   13821| 00110| function computeDiffStatsAndPatch(
   13822| 00111|   before: string, after: string, filePath: string, maxPatchBytes = 6000
   13823| 00112| ): { linesAdded: number; linesRemoved: number; patch: string } {
   13824| 00113|   const aLines = before.split(/\r?\n/);
   13825| 00114|   const bLines = after.split(/\r?\n/);
   13826| 00115|   // 大檔案略過全 diff（LCS O(m*n) 太慢），只回傳行數差
   13827| 00116|   if (aLines.length + bLines.length > 4000) {
   13828| 00117|     return { linesAdded: Math.max(0, bLines.length - aLines.length), linesRemoved: Math.max(0, aLines.length - bLines.length), patch: '' };
   13829| 00118|   }
   13830| 00119|   const baseName = path.basename(filePath);
   13831| 00120|   let patch = computeUnifiedDiff(aLines, bLines, baseName, baseName, 3);
   13832| 00121|   if (patch.length > maxPatchBytes) { patch = patch.slice(0, maxPatchBytes) + '\n…（截斷）'; }
   13833| 00122|   const pLines = patch.split('\n');
   13834| 00123|   const linesAdded = pLines.filter(l => l.startsWith('+') && !l.startsWith('+++')).length;
   13835| 00124|   const linesRemoved = pLines.filter(l => l.startsWith('-') && !l.startsWith('---')).length;
   13836| 00125|   return { linesAdded, linesRemoved, patch };
   13837| 00126| }

   13981| 00270|   /** 遞迴收集目錄下的影像檔（jpg/jpeg/png/webp/bmp/gif），回傳絕對路徑陣列（達 limit 即停止）。 */
   13982| 00271|   private static collectImageFiles(rootDir: string, limit: number): string[] {
   13983| 00272|     const exts = new Set(['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.webp', '.bmp', '.gif']);
   13984| 00273|     const out: string[] = [];
   13985| 00274|     const walk = (dir: string) => {
   13986| 00275|       if (out.length >= limit) { return; }
   13987| 00276|       let entries: import('fs').Dirent[];
   13988| 00277|       try { entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return; }
   13989| 00278|       for (const e of entries) {
   13990| 00279|         if (out.length >= limit) { return; }
   13991| 00280|         const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
   13992| 00281|         if (e.isDirectory()) {
   13993| 00282|           if (e.name.startsWith('.') || e.name === 'node_modules') { continue; }
   13994| 00283|           walk(full);
   13995| 00284|         } else if (exts.has(path.extname(e.name).toLowerCase())) {
   13996| 00285|           out.push(full);
   13997| 00286|         }
   13998| 00287|       }
   13999| 00288|     };
   14000| 00289|     walk(rootDir);
   14001| 00290|     return out;
   14002| 00291|   }

   14014| 00303|   /** 呼叫 Ollama 視覺模型 /api/chat（非串流），傳入多張 base64 影像，回傳 message.content 文字。 */
   14015| 00304|   private static ollamaVisionChat(
   14016| 00305|     baseUrl: string, model: string, prompt: string, imagesB64: string[], timeoutMs: number,
   14017| 00306|   ): Promise<string> {
   14018| 00307|     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   14019| 00308|       let url: URL;
   14020| 00309|       try { url = new URL('/api/chat', baseUrl); } catch { reject(new Error(`Ollama URL 無效: ${baseUrl}`)); return; }
   14021| 00310|       const protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
   14022| 00311|       const buf = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
   14023| 00312|         model,
   14024| 00313|         messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt, images: imagesB64 }],
   14025| 00314|         stream: false,
   14026| 00315|         options: { temperature: 0 },
   14027| 00316|       }), 'utf8');
   14028| 00317|       const options: http.RequestOptions = {
   14029| 00318|         hostname: url.hostname,
   14030| 00319|         port: url.port ? parseInt(url.port, 10) : (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 11434),
   14031| 00320|         path: url.pathname,
   14032| 00321|         method: 'POST',
   14033| 00322|         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': buf.length },
   14034| 00323|       };
   14035| 00324|       const req = protocol.request(options, (res) => {
   14036| 00325|         let data = '';
   14037| 00326|         res.setEncoding('utf8');
   14038| 00327|         res.on('data', (d: string) => { data += d; });
   14039| 00328|         res.on('end', () => {
   14040| 00329|           try {
   14041| 00330|             const j = JSON.parse(data) as { message?: { content?: string }; error?: string };
   14042| 00331|             if (j.error) { reject(new Error(j.error)); return; }
   14043| 00332|             resolve((j.message?.content ?? '').trim());
   14044| 00333|           } catch { reject(new Error(`回應解析失敗: ${data.slice(0, 200)}`)); }
   14045| 00334|         });
   14046| 00335|       });
   14047| 00336|       req.on('error', (e: Error) => reject(e));
   14048| 00337|       req.setTimeout(timeoutMs, () => { req.destroy(); reject(new Error(`Ollama 視覺推論逾時 (${timeoutMs}ms)`)); });
   14049| 00338|       req.write(buf);
   14050| 00339|       req.end();
   14051| 00340|     });
   14052| 00341|   }

   14063| 00352|   }

   14065| 00354|   /** 從 atlassian.atlascode 擷取 Jira auth (bearer token + baseApiUrl)。

   14069| 00358|   private async getAtlascodeJiraAuth(): Promise<{ baseApiUrl: string; accessToken: string } | null> {
   14070| 00359|     if (this._atlasJiraCred && this._atlasJiraCred.expiry > Date.now() + 300_000) {

   14072| 00361|     }

   14078| 00367| 
   14079| 00368|       // Python 腳本：使用內建模組讀 SQLite + DPAPI 解密 master key，輸出 JSON
   14080| 00369|       // 路徑用 JSON.stringify 嵌入：Python 解析 "C:\\Users\\..." = C:\Users\... (正確)

   14124| 00413|         'print(json.dumps({"mk":mk,"buf":ed["data"],"baseApiUrl":s["baseApiUrl"],"host":s.get("host","")}))',
   14125| 00414|       ].join('\n');
   14126| 00415| 
   14127| 00416|       // 寫入 temp file 執行，避免 Windows stdin pipe hang 問題
   14128| 00417|       // 嘗試 py (Windows Launcher) → python → python3
   14129| 00418|       const tmpPy = path.join(appData, 'ami-atlas-auth-tmp.py');
   14130| 00419|       fs.writeFileSync(tmpPy, pyScript, 'utf-8');
   14131| 00420|       let raw = '';
   14132| 00421|       let lastErr: unknown;
   14133| 00422|       const pythonCmds = process.platform === 'win32' ? ['py', 'python'] : ['python3', 'python'];
   14134| 00423|       try {
   14135| 00424|         for (const cmd of pythonCmds) {
   14136| 00425|           try {
   14137| 00426|             raw = execSync(`${cmd} "${tmpPy}"`, { encoding: 'utf-8', timeout: 12_000 }).trim();
   14138| 00427|             lastErr = undefined;
   14139| 00428|             break;
   14140| 00429|           } catch (e) { lastErr = e; }
   14141| 00430|         }
   14142| 00431|         if (lastErr) { throw lastErr; }
   14143| 00432|       } finally {
   14144| 00433|         try { fs.unlinkSync(tmpPy); } catch { /* ignore */ }
   14145| 00434|       }
   14146| 00435|       const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as {
   14147| 00436|         error?: string; mk?: number[]; buf?: number[];
   14148| 00437|         baseApiUrl?: string; host?: string;
   14149| 00438|       };

   14152| 00441|         return null;

   14154| 00443| 
   14155| 00444|       // AES-256-GCM 解密：v10(3) + nonce(12) + ciphertext + tag(16)
   14156| 00445|       const masterKey = Buffer.from(parsed.mk);
   14157| 00446|       const buf = Buffer.from(parsed.buf);
   14158| 00447|       const nonce = buf.slice(3, 15);
   14159| 00448|       const ciphertext = buf.slice(15, buf.length - 16);
   14160| 00449|       const tag = buf.slice(buf.length - 16);
   14161| 00450|       const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', masterKey, nonce);
   14162| 00451|       decipher.setAuthTag(tag);

   14164| 00453|       const cred = JSON.parse(plain.toString('utf-8')) as { access?: string; refresh?: string };
   14165| 00454|       if (!cred.access) { return null; }

   14181| 00470|   /** 探索 Rovo Dev 本地 HTTP server (127.0.0.1:{port})，優先讀 env var，否則掃描 Windows 程序表。
   14182| 00471|    *  正向結果快取 5 分鐘；負向結果快取 30 秒。*/
   14183| 00472|   private async discoverRovoDevUrl(): Promise<{ url: string; token: string } | null> {
   14184| 00473|     if (this._rovoDevCache && Date.now() < this._rovoDevCache.expiry) {
   14185| 00474|       return { url: this._rovoDevCache.url, token: this._rovoDevCache.token };
   14186| 00475|     }

   14190| 00479|

   14192| 00481|       return new Promise(resolve => {

   14196| 00485|           const req = http.request({ hostname: u.hostname, port: parseInt(u.port || '80'), path: u.pathname, method: 'GET', headers }, res => {
   14197| 00486|             res.resume(); resolve(res.statusCode === 200);
   14198| 00487|           });
   14199| 00488|           req.on('error', () => resolve(false));
   14200| 00489|           req.setTimeout(2000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(false); });
   14201| 00490|           req.end();
   14202| 00491|         } catch { resolve(false); }
   14203| 00492|       });
   14204| 00493|     };
   14205| 00494|

   14210| 00499|       if (await tryUrl(url)) {
   14211| 00500|         this._rovoDevCache = { url, token: envToken, expiry: Date.now() + 5 * 60_000 };
   14212| 00501|         return { url, token: envToken };
   14213| 00502|       }
   14214| 00503|     }
   14215| 00504| 
   14216| 00505|     // 2. Windows: find atlassian_cli_rovodev.exe port via tasklist + netstat
   14217| 00506|     if (process.platform === 'win32') {

   14223| 00512|           return { url, token: envToken };
   14224| 00513|         }
   14225| 00514|       }
   14226| 00515|     }
   14227| 00516| 
   14228| 00517|     this._rovoDevCache = undefined;
   14229| 00518|     this._rovoDevNullUntil = Date.now() + 30_000;
   14230| 00519|     return null;
   14231| 00520|   }
   14232| 00521|   /** 用 tasklist + netstat 同步取得 Rovo Dev 監聽 port (Windows)。*/

   14252| 00541|   /** 向 Rovo Dev 本地 HTTP server 提問並以 SSE stream 收集文字回覆。

   14382| 00671|   public async executeTool(name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
   14383| 00672|     // 工具名稱正規化：將常見替代名稱映射至正式名稱
   14384| 00673|     const resolved = ToolExecutor.TOOL_ALIASES[name] ?? name;
   14385| 00674|     if (resolved !== name) {
   14386| 00675|       this._callbacks.log(`executeTool: alias "${name}" → "${resolved}"`);
   14387| 00676|       return this.executeTool(resolved, args);
   14388| 00677|     }
   14389| 00678|     const folders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [];
   14390| 00679|     const wsRoot = folders[0]?.uri.fsPath ?? '';
   14391| 00680|     const resolvePath = (p: string) => {
   14392| 00681|       if (!p) { return wsRoot; }
   14393| 00682|       if (path.isAbsolute(p)) { return p; }
   14394| 00683|       // Check if the relative path exists under any workspace folder
   14395| 00684|       for (const f of folders) {
   14396| 00685|         const candidate = path.join(f.uri.fsPath, p);
   14397| 00686|         // Return first folder that contains the relative prefix
   14398| 00687|         const rel = p.split(/[\\/]/)[0];
   14399| 00688|         if (rel) {
   14400| 00689|           try { require('fs').accessSync(path.join(f.uri.fsPath, rel)); return candidate; } catch { /* try next */ }
   14401| 00690|         }
   14402| 00691|       }
   14403| 00692|       return path.join(wsRoot, p);
   14404| 00693|     };
   14405| 00694| 
   14406| 00695|     /**
   14407| 00696|      * 三層優先順序路徑解析：
   14408| 00697|      *  1. 絕對路徑 / 相對路徑（存在於磁碟）→ 直接使用
   14409| 00698|      *  2. 找不到 → 查 VS Code 已開啟的 openTextDocuments（basename 或 相對路徑 suffix 比對）
   14410| 00699|      *  3. 還找不到 → workspace.findFiles 在整個工作區搜尋
   14411| 00700|      */
   14412| 00701|     const resolvePathWithPriority = async (raw: string): Promise<string> => {
   14413| 00702|       if (!raw) { return wsRoot; }
   14414| 00703|       // ① 絕對路徑直接用
   14415| 00704|       if (path.isAbsolute(raw)) {
   14416| 00705|         try { require('fs').accessSync(raw); return raw; } catch { /* fall through */ }
   14417| 00706|       }
   14418| 00707|       // ① 相對路徑：先嘗試 workspace folder 解析
   14419| 00708|       const candidate = resolvePath(raw);
   14420| 00709|       try { require('fs').accessSync(candidate); return candidate; } catch { /* not on disk */ }
   14421| 00710| 
   14422| 00711|       // ② 已開啟的 editor documents（不須在磁碟，可能是 untitled 或虛擬 FS）
   14423| 00712|       const rawBase = path.basename(raw).toLowerCase();
   14424| 00713|       const rawNorm = raw.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase();
   14425| 00714|       for (const doc of vscode.workspace.textDocuments) {
   14426| 00715|         const docPath = doc.uri.fsPath;
   14427| 00716|         const docNorm = docPath.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase();
   14428| 00717|         if (docNorm.endsWith(rawNorm) || path.basename(docPath).toLowerCase() === rawBase) {
   14429| 00718|           return docPath;
   14430| 00719|         }
   14431| 00720|       }
   14432| 00721| 
   14433| 00722|       // ③ workspace.findFiles 搜全工作區
   14434| 00723|       try {
   14435| 00724|         // 先嘗試精確 glob（保留原始路徑結構）
   14436| 00725|         const exactGlob = `**/${raw.replace(/\\/g, '/')}`;
   14437| 00726|         const found = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(exactGlob, '**/node_modules/**', 5);
   14438| 00727|         if (found.length > 0) {
   14439| 00728|           // 若多個結果，優先選最短路徑（最靠近根目錄）
   14440| 00729|           found.sort((a, b) => a.fsPath.length - b.fsPath.length);
   14441| 00730|           return found[0].fsPath;
   14442| 00731|         }
   14443| 00732|         // basename glob fallback
   14444| 00733|         const baseGlob = `**/${rawBase}`;
   14445| 00734|         const found2 = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(baseGlob, '**/node_modules/**', 5);
   14446| 00735|         if (found2.length > 0) {
   14447| 00736|           found2.sort((a, b) => a.fsPath.length - b.fsPath.length);
   14448| 00737|           return found2[0].fsPath;
   14449| 00738|         }
   14450| 00739|       } catch { /* ignore findFiles error */ }
   14451| 00740| 
   14452| 00741|       // fallback：回傳原始 resolvePath 結果（讓呼叫端的 stat 報「找不到」）
   14453| 00742|       return candidate;
   14454| 00743|     };
   14455| 00744|

   14462| 00751|       }

   14464| 00753|       const provider = this._providerMap.get(name);
   14465| 00754|       if (provider) {

   14485| 00774|     if (name === 'sandbox_rollback') { this._sandbox.rollback(); return '🗑️ 已回滚影子工作區，真實工作區未改動。'; }

   14487| 00776| 
   14488| 00777|     // Provider dispatch：已遷移的工具走 provider 路徑，其餘繼續走原始 switch
   14489| 00778|     const _provider = this._providerMap.get(name);
   14490| 00779|     if (_provider) {

   14492| 00781|         callbacks: this._callbacks,
   14493| 00782|         cache: this._cache,
   14494| 00783|         audit: this._audit,
   14495| 00784|         wsRoot,
   14496| 00785|         folders,
   14497| 00786|         requestPermission: (cat, desc, tool, diff) => this.requestPermission(cat, desc, tool ?? '', diff),

   14504| 00793|     }
   14505| 00794| 
   14506| 00795|     switch (name) {
   14507| 00796|       case 'get_active_file': {
   14508| 00797|         const editor = vscode.window.activeTextEditor;
   14509| 00798|         if (!editor) { return '沒有開啟的檔案'; }
   14510| 00799|         return `檔案: ${editor.document.uri.fsPath}\n\n${editor.document.getText()}`;
   14511| 00800|       }
   14512| 00801|       case 'read_file': {
   14513| 00802|         const fpath = await resolvePathWithPriority(args.path as string);
   14514| 00803|         const rfKey = `rf:${fpath}`;
   14515| 00804|         const rfCached = this._cache.get(rfKey);
   14516| 00805|         if (rfCached !== undefined) { return rfCached; }
   14517| 00806|         // 先檢查檔案大小，避免大型二進位/文字檔案讓 webview 凍結
   14518| 00807|         let fileStat: vscode.FileStat;
   14519| 00808|         try { fileStat = await vscode.workspace.fs.stat(vscode.Uri.file(fpath)); }
   14520| 00809|         catch { return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${fpath}`; }
   14521| 00810|         const MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5 MB
   14522| 00811|         const LOG_SMART_THRESHOLD = 64 * 1024; // 64 KB：超過此大小的 log 改走 error-first 策略
   14523| 00812|         const ext = fpath.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
   14524| 00813|         const isLog = ['log', 'txt', 'out', 'err', 'bld', 'build', 'trace'].includes(ext);
   14525| 00814|         // 各式錯誤/警告關鍵字 pattern（涵蓋 EDKII build、GCC、Python、Node.js、一般系統 log）
   14526| 00815|         const LOG_ERROR_PATTERN =
   14527| 00816|           'error:|Error:|ERROR|warning:|Warning:|WARNING|fatal:|Fatal:|FATAL|' +
   14528| 00817|           'fail:|FAIL|FAILED|BUILD FAILURE|BUILD ERROR|' +
   14529| 00818|           'assert|Assert|ASSERT|exception|Exception|EXCEPTION|' +
   14530| 00819|           'undefined reference|cannot find|unresolved|Unresolved|' +
   14531| 00820|           'ld returned|undefined symbol|' +
   14532| 00821|           'Traceback|SyntaxError|TypeError|ReferenceError|ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError|' +
   14533| 00822|           'abort|Abort|ABORT|crash|Crash|panic|Panic|PANIC|' +

   14536| 00825|

   14540| 00829|           if (isLog) {

   14542| 00831|             const errorResult = await this.executeTool('read_file_smart', {
   14543| 00832|               path: args.path,
   14544| 00833|               pattern: LOG_ERROR_PATTERN,
   14545| 00834|               context_lines: 5,
   14546| 00835|               max_kb: 128,
   14547| 00836|             });

   14550| 00839|               `【尾端 300 行（最終執行結果）】\n${tailResult}`;
   14551| 00840|           } else {
   14552| 00841|             const headResult = await this.executeTool('read_file_smart', { path: args.path, head: 300, max_kb: 64 });

   14554| 00843|           }
   14555| 00844|         }
   14556| 00845| 
   14557| 00846|         // 中型 log（64 KB ~ 5 MB）：先掃描錯誤點再補尾端，避免截斷遺漏關鍵訊息
   14558| 00847|         if (isLog && fileStat.size > LOG_SMART_THRESHOLD) {
   14559| 00848|           const sizeKb = (fileStat.size / 1024).toFixed(0);
   14560| 00849|           const errorResult = await this.executeTool('read_file_smart', {
   14561| 00850|             path: args.path,
   14562| 00851|             pattern: LOG_ERROR_PATTERN,
   14563| 00852|             context_lines: 5,
   14564| 00853|             max_kb: 128,
   14565| 00854|           });
   14566| 00855|           const tailResult = await this.executeTool('read_file_smart', { path: args.path, tail: 100, max_kb: 64 });
   14567| 00856|           return `📋 Log 分析模式（${sizeKb} KB）——先掃描各式錯誤點，再補尾端執行結果\n\n` +
   14568| 00857|             `【錯誤 / 警告點（含前後 5 行 context）】\n${errorResult}\n\n` +
   14569| 00858|             `【尾端 100 行（執行結果）】\n${tailResult}`;
   14570| 00859|         }
   14571| 00860| 
   14572| 00861|         const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));

   14579| 00868|       }
   14580| 00869|       case 'read_file_smart': {

   14615| 00904|             let lineNo = 0;
   14616| 00905|             let outputBytes = 0;

   14618| 00907|             let tailLines: string[] = rfsTail ? [] : [];

   14622| 00911|

   14624| 00913|

   14626| 00915|               if (rfsTail) {

   14628| 00917|                 if (tailLines.length > rfsTail) tailLines.shift();

   14631| 00920|

   14633| 00922|               if (rfsHead && lineNo > rfsHead) { collecting = false; return; }

   14636| 00925|               if (rfsStartLine && lineNo < rfsStartLine) {
   14637| 00926|                 if (rfsCtx > 0) { ringBuffer.push(line); if (ringBuffer.length > rfsCtx) ringBuffer.shift(); }
   14638| 00927|                 return;
   14639| 00928|               }
   14640| 00929|               if (rfsEndLine && lineNo > rfsEndLine) { collecting = false; return; }
   14641| 00930| 
   14642| 00931|               const isMatch = rfsRegex ? rfsRegex.test(line) : true;
   14643| 00932| 
   14644| 00933|               if (isMatch) {
   14645| 00934|                 // 先補前置 context
   14646| 00935|                 if (rfsCtx > 0 && rfsRegex) {
   14647| 00936|                   for (let i = 0; i < ringBuffer.length; i++) {
   14648| 00937|                     const ctxNo = lineNo - ringBuffer.length + i;
   14649| 00938|                     if (!matchedLines.find(m => m.lineNo === ctxNo)) {
   14650| 00939|                       matchedLines.push({ lineNo: ctxNo, text: ringBuffer[i], isContext: true });
   14651| 00940|                     }
   14652| 00941|                   }
   14653| 00942|                   ringBuffer.length = 0;
   14654| 00943|                   // 標記後置 context
   14655| 00944|                   for (let j = 1; j <= rfsCtx; j++) pendingCtxLineNos.add(lineNo + j);
   14656| 00945|                 }
   14657| 00946|                 matchedLines.push({ lineNo, text: line });
   14658| 00947|                 outputBytes += line.length + 1;
   14659| 00948|                 if (outputBytes > maxOutputBytes) { collecting = false; return; }
   14660| 00949|               } else {
   14661| 00950|                 // 後置 context
   14662| 00951|                 if (pendingCtxLineNos.has(lineNo)) {
   14663| 00952|                   pendingCtxLineNos.delete(lineNo);
   14664| 00953|                   matchedLines.push({ lineNo, text: line, isContext: true });
   14665| 00954|                   outputBytes += line.length + 1;
   14666| 00955|                 }
   14667| 00956|                 if (rfsCtx > 0 && rfsRegex) {
   14668| 00957|                   ringBuffer.push(line);
   14669| 00958|                   if (ringBuffer.length > rfsCtx) ringBuffer.shift();
   14670| 00959|                 }
   14671| 00960|               }
   14672| 00961|             });
   14673| 00962|             rl.on('close', () => {
   14674| 00963|               totalFileLines = lineNo;
   14675| 00964|               // 處理 tail 模式結果
   14676| 00965|               if (rfsTail && tailLines.length > 0) {
   14677| 00966|                 const tailStart = lineNo - tailLines.length + 1;
   14678| 00967|                 tailLines.forEach((tl, i) => {
   14679| 00968|                   matchedLines.push({ lineNo: tailStart + i, text: tl });
   14680| 00969|                 });
   14681| 00970|               }
   14682| 00971|               resolve();
   14683| 00972|             });
   14684| 00973|             rl.on('error', reject);
   14685| 00974|           });
   14686| 00975| 
   14687| 00976|           const header = `📄 ${rfsFpath}  (${fileSizeMb} MB, ${totalFileLines.toLocaleString()} 行)` +
   14688| 00977|             (rfsPattern  ? `  pattern="${rfsPattern}"` : '') +
   14689| 00978|             (rfsStartLine ? `  lines=${rfsStartLine}-${rfsEndLine ?? '∞'}` : '') +
   14690| 00979|             (rfsHead     ? `  head=${rfsHead}` : '') +
   14691| 00980|             (rfsTail     ? `  tail=${rfsTail}` : '') +
   14692| 00981|             `  matched=${matchedLines.length} 行\n`;
   14693| 00982| 
   14694| 00983|           if (matchedLines.length === 0) {
   14695| 00984|             return header + '（無匹配行）';
   14696| 00985|           }
   14697| 00986| 
   14698| 00987|           let totalOut = 0;
   14699| 00988|           const lines = matchedLines.map(m => {
   14700| 00989|             totalOut += m.text.length + 1;
   14701| 00990|             const pct = totalFileLines > 0 ? ` (${(m.lineNo * 100 / totalFileLines).toFixed(1)}%)` : '';
   14702| 00991|             return `${m.isContext ? '  ' : ''}${String(m.lineNo).padStart(6)}${pct}: ${m.text}`;
   14703| 00992|           });
   14704| 00993| 
   14705| 00994|           const truncated = totalOut > maxOutputBytes;
   14706| 00995|           const body = lines.join('\n') + (truncated ? `\n…（已達 ${rfsMaxKb}KB 輸出上限，請縮小範圍或增大 max_kb）` : '');
   14707| 00996|           return header + body;
   14708| 00997|         } catch (e) {
   14709| 00998|           return `read_file_smart 錯誤：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
   14710| 00999|         }
   14711| 01000|       }
   14712| 01001|       case 'grep_file': {
   14713| 01002|         // 多關鍵字搜尋超大型檔案，逐行 streaming，不把整個檔案載入 buffer。
   14714| 01003|         // 每個 keyword 獨立分組回傳，重疊 context 自動合併去重，達上限截斷各組。
   14715| 01004|         const gfPath    = await resolvePathWithPriority(args.path as string);
   14716| 01005|         const gfKws     = Array.isArray(args.keywords)
   14717| 01006|           ? (args.keywords as unknown[]).map(String).filter(Boolean)
   14718| 01007|           : [];
   14719| 01008|         if (gfKws.length === 0) { return '錯誤：keywords 為空'; }
   14720| 01009|         const gfCtx     = args.context_lines     ? Math.max(0, Number(args.context_lines))     : 3;
   14721| 01010|         const gfMaxPerKw= args.max_matches_per_kw ? Math.max(1, Number(args.max_matches_per_kw)) : 30;
   14722| 01011|         const gfMaxKb   = args.max_kb            ? Math.max(1, Math.min(512, Number(args.max_kb))) : 128;
   14723| 01012|         const gfCaseSens= args.case_sensitive === true;
   14724| 01013|         const gfMaxBytes= gfMaxKb * 1024;
   14725| 01014| 
   14726| 01015|         try {
   14727| 01016|           const nodefs   = require('fs') as typeof import('fs');
   14728| 01017|           const readline = require('readline') as typeof import('readline');
   14729| 01018| 
   14730| 01019|           let stat: import('fs').Stats;
   14731| 01020|           try { stat = nodefs.statSync(gfPath); }
   14732| 01021|           catch { return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${gfPath}`; }
   14733| 01022|           const fileSizeMb = (stat.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1);
   14734| 01023| 
   14735| 01024|           // 每個關鍵字建立獨立 regex 與匹配記錄
   14736| 01025|           const gfFlag = gfCaseSens ? '' : 'i';
   14737| 01026|           type KwGroup = {
   14738| 01027|             kw: string;
   14739| 01028|             re: RegExp;
   14740| 01029|             matches: Array<{ lineNo: number; text: string; isCtx?: boolean }>;
   14741| 01030|             totalHits: number;
   14742| 01031|             capped: boolean;
   14743| 01032|           };
   14744| 01033|           const groups: KwGroup[] = gfKws.map(kw => ({
   14745| 01034|             kw,
   14746| 01035|             re: new RegExp(kw, gfFlag),
   14747| 01036|             matches: [],
   14748| 01037|             totalHits: 0,
   14749| 01038|             capped: false,
   14750| 01039|           }));
   14751| 01040| 
   14752| 01041|           // ring buffer（前置 context）與後置 context 追蹤
   14753| 01042|           const ring: string[] = [];
   14754| 01043|           // pendingCtx[kwIdx] = Set of future line numbers to capture as context
   14755| 01044|           const pendingCtx: Set<number>[] = groups.map(() => new Set<number>());
   14756| 01045|           let totalFileLines = 0;
   14757| 01046| 
   14758| 01047|           await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
   14759| 01048|             const rl = readline.createInterface({
   14760| 01049|               input: nodefs.createReadStream(gfPath, { encoding: 'utf8' }),
   14761| 01050|               crlfDelay: Infinity,
   14762| 01051|             });
   14763| 01052|             let lineNo = 0;
   14764| 01053| 
   14765| 01054|             rl.on('line', (line: string) => {
   14766| 01055|               lineNo++;
   14767| 01056| 
   14768| 01057|               for (let gi = 0; gi < groups.length; gi++) {
   14769| 01058|                 const g = groups[gi];
   14770| 01059| 
   14771| 01060|                 // 後置 context
   14772| 01061|                 if (pendingCtx[gi].has(lineNo)) {
   14773| 01062|                   pendingCtx[gi].delete(lineNo);
   14774| 01063|                   // 若此行也是 match，不重複加；等下面 match 邏輯加
   14775| 01064|                   if (!g.re.test(line)) {
   14776| 01065|                     if (!g.matches.find(m => m.lineNo === lineNo)) {
   14777| 01066|                       g.matches.push({ lineNo, text: line, isCtx: true });
   14778| 01067|                     }
   14779| 01068|                   }
   14780| 01069|                 }
   14781| 01070| 
   14782| 01071|                 // 命中檢查
   14783| 01072|                 if (g.re.test(line)) {
   14784| 01073|                   g.totalHits++;
   14785| 01074|                   if (!g.capped) {
   14786| 01075|                     if (g.totalHits <= gfMaxPerKw) {
   14787| 01076|                       // 前置 context：從 ring buffer 補
   14788| 01077|                       if (gfCtx > 0) {
   14789| 01078|                         const ringStart = Math.max(0, ring.length - gfCtx);
   14790| 01079|                         for (let ri = ringStart; ri < ring.length; ri++) {
   14791| 01080|                           const ctxNo = lineNo - (ring.length - ri);
   14792| 01081|                           if (ctxNo >= 1 && !g.matches.find(m => m.lineNo === ctxNo)) {
   14793| 01082|                             g.matches.push({ lineNo: ctxNo, text: ring[ri], isCtx: true });
   14794| 01083|                           }
   14795| 01084|                         }
   14796| 01085|                       }
   14797| 01086|                       // 本行 match（先移除若已由後置 context 加過）
   14798| 01087|                       const existing = g.matches.findIndex(m => m.lineNo === lineNo);
   14799| 01088|                       if (existing !== -1) { g.matches.splice(existing, 1); }
   14800| 01089|                       g.matches.push({ lineNo, text: line, isCtx: false });
   14801| 01090|                       // 後置 context
   14802| 01091|                       for (let j = 1; j <= gfCtx; j++) pendingCtx[gi].add(lineNo + j);
   14803| 01092|                     } else {
   14804| 01093|                       g.capped = true;
   14805| 01094|                     }
   14806| 01095|                   }
   14807| 01096|                 }
   14808| 01097|               }
   14809| 01098| 
   14810| 01099|               // 維護 ring buffer
   14811| 01100|               ring.push(line);
   14812| 01101|               if (ring.length > gfCtx + 1) ring.shift();
   14813| 01102|             });
   14814| 01103| 
   14815| 01104|             rl.on('close', () => { totalFileLines = lineNo; resolve(); });
   14816| 01105|             rl.on('error', reject);
   14817| 01106|           });
   14818| 01107| 
   14819| 01108|           // 組裝輸出
   14820| 01109|           const allHits = groups.reduce((s, g) => s + g.totalHits, 0);
   14821| 01110|           const hdr = `📄 ${gfPath}  (${fileSizeMb} MB, ${totalFileLines.toLocaleString()} 行)\n` +
   14822| 01111|             `🔍 Keywords: ${gfKws.map(k => `"${k}"`).join(', ')}  |  context=${gfCtx}  |  total hits: ${allHits}\n`;
   14823| 01112| 
   14824| 01113|           const sections: string[] = [];
   14825| 01114|           let outputBytes = hdr.length;
   14826| 01115| 
   14827| 01116|           for (const g of groups) {
   14828| 01117|             if (outputBytes >= gfMaxBytes) { sections.push(`…（已達 ${gfMaxKb}KB 上限）`); break; }
   14829| 01118| 
   14830| 01119|             // 排序並去重（多個 keywords 可能標記同一行為 context）
   14831| 01120|             const sorted = g.matches.sort((a, b) => a.lineNo - b.lineNo);
   14832| 01121|             const deduped: typeof sorted = [];
   14833| 01122|             for (const m of sorted) {
   14834| 01123|               if (!deduped.length || deduped[deduped.length - 1].lineNo !== m.lineNo) {
   14835| 01124|                 deduped.push(m);
   14836| 01125|               } else if (!m.isCtx) {
   14837| 01126|                 // 若已有同行 context，升格為 match
   14838| 01127|                 deduped[deduped.length - 1].isCtx = false;
   14839| 01128|               }
   14840| 01129|             }
   14841| 01130| 
   14842| 01131|             const capNote = g.capped ? ` (顯示前 ${gfMaxPerKw}，共 ${g.totalHits} 處)` : ` (${g.totalHits} 處)`;
   14843| 01132|             let section = `\n━━━ "${g.kw}" ${g.totalHits === 0 ? '— 無匹配' : capNote} ━━━\n`;
   14844| 01133| 
   14845| 01134|             if (deduped.length === 0) {
   14846| 01135|               section += '（無匹配行）\n';
   14847| 01136|             } else {
   14848| 01137|               // 分布摘要：列出 match 的 % 位置
   14849| 01138|               const matchNos = deduped.filter(m => !m.isCtx).map(m => m.lineNo);
   14850| 01139|               const distrib = matchNos.map(n => `${(n * 100 / totalFileLines).toFixed(1)}%`).join(', ');
   14851| 01140|               if (matchNos.length > 0) { section += `   📍 分布位置：${distrib}\n`; }
   14852| 01141| 
   14853| 01142|               let prevLineNo = -999;
   14854| 01143|               for (const m of deduped) {
   14855| 01144|                 if (m.lineNo > prevLineNo + 1 && prevLineNo !== -999) {
   14856| 01145|                   section += '   ——\n';
   14857| 01146|                 }
   14858| 01147|                 const pct = totalFileLines > 0 ? ` (${(m.lineNo * 100 / totalFileLines).toFixed(1)}%)` : '';
   14859| 01148|                 section += `${m.isCtx ? '  ' : '▶ '}${String(m.lineNo).padStart(6)}${pct}: ${m.text}\n`;
   14860| 01149|                 prevLineNo = m.lineNo;
   14861| 01150|               }
   14862| 01151|             }
   14863| 01152| 
   14864| 01153|             if (outputBytes + section.length > gfMaxBytes) {
   14865| 01154|               section = section.slice(0, gfMaxBytes - outputBytes) + '\n…（截斷）\n';
   14866| 01155|             }
   14867| 01156|             sections.push(section);
   14868| 01157|             outputBytes += section.length;
   14869| 01158|           }
   14870| 01159| 
   14871| 01160|           return hdr + sections.join('');
   14872| 01161|         } catch (e) {
   14873| 01162|           return `grep_file 錯誤：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
   14874| 01163|         }
   14875| 01164|       }
   14876| 01165|       case 'read_files': {
   14877| 01166|         const rawPaths = Array.isArray(args.paths) ? (args.paths as unknown[]).map(String).filter(Boolean) : [];
   14878| 01167|         if (rawPaths.length === 0) { return '錯誤：paths 為空陣列'; }
   14879| 01168|         const MAX_FILES = 30;
   14880| 01169|         const truncatedPaths = rawPaths.slice(0, MAX_FILES);
   14881| 01170|         const overflowFiles = rawPaths.length > MAX_FILES ? rawPaths.length - MAX_FILES : 0;
   14882| 01171|         const maxPerFileKb = Math.max(1, Math.min(512, Number(args.max_per_file_kb) || 64));
   14883| 01172|         const maxTotalKb = Math.max(maxPerFileKb, Math.min(2048, Number(args.max_total_kb) || 256));
   14884| 01173|         const maxPerBytes = maxPerFileKb * 1024;
   14885| 01174|         const maxTotalBytes = maxTotalKb * 1024;
   14886| 01175|         const FILE_HARD_MAX = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
   14887| 01176|         const parts: string[] = [];
   14888| 01177|         let totalBytes = 0;
   14889| 01178|         let stoppedAt = -1;
   14890| 01179|         for (let i = 0; i < truncatedPaths.length; i++) {
   14891| 01180|           if (totalBytes >= maxTotalBytes) { stoppedAt = i; break; }
   14892| 01181|           const p = truncatedPaths[i];
   14893| 01182|           const fpath = resolvePath(p);
   14894| 01183|           let header = `=== ${p} ===\n`;
   14895| 01184|           let body = '';
   14896| 01185|           try {
   14897| 01186|             const stat = await vscode.workspace.fs.stat(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
   14898| 01187|             if (stat.size > FILE_HARD_MAX) {
   14899| 01188|               body = `（檔案過大 ${(stat.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB > 5 MB，跳過）\n`;
   14900| 01189|             } else {
   14901| 01190|               const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
   14902| 01191|               let text = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8');
   14903| 01192|               if (text.length > maxPerBytes) {
   14904| 01193|                 text = text.slice(0, maxPerBytes) + `\n…（已截斷至 ${maxPerFileKb}KB，原始 ${Math.round(text.length / 1024)}KB）\n`;
   14905| 01194|               }
   14906| 01195|               const remaining = maxTotalBytes - totalBytes - header.length;
   14907| 01196|               if (text.length > remaining) {
   14908| 01197|                 text = text.slice(0, Math.max(0, remaining)) + `\n…（達總量上限 ${maxTotalKb}KB，本檔截斷）\n`;
   14909| 01198|               }
   14910| 01199|               body = text + (text.endsWith('\n') ? '' : '\n');
   14911| 01200|             }
   14912| 01201|           } catch {
   14913| 01202|             body = `（找不到檔案：${fpath}）\n`;
   14914| 01203|           }
   14915| 01204|           parts.push(header + body);
   14916| 01205|           totalBytes += header.length + body.length;
   14917| 01206|         }
   14918| 01207|         const summary: string[] = [];
   14919| 01208|         const readCount = stoppedAt === -1 ? truncatedPaths.length : stoppedAt;
   14920| 01209|         summary.push(`📚 read_files: 已讀取 ${readCount}/${rawPaths.length} 個檔案，總 ${(totalBytes / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB`);
   14921| 01210|         if (stoppedAt !== -1) {
   14922| 01211|           const skipped = truncatedPaths.slice(stoppedAt).concat(rawPaths.slice(MAX_FILES));
   14923| 01212|           summary.push(`⚠️ 達總量上限（${maxTotalKb}KB），未讀取：${skipped.slice(0, 10).join(', ')}${skipped.length > 10 ? ` …(+${skipped.length - 10})` : ''}`);
   14924| 01213|           summary.push(`💡 請對剩餘檔案再次呼叫 read_files 並調整 max_total_kb，或改用 search_regex 縮小範圍。`);
   14925| 01214|         } else if (overflowFiles > 0) {
   14926| 01215|           summary.push(`⚠️ paths 數量超過上限 ${MAX_FILES}，未處理 ${overflowFiles} 個檔案。`);
   14927| 01216|         }
   14928| 01217|         return summary.join('\n') + '\n\n' + parts.join('\n');
   14929| 01218|       }
   14930| 01219|       case 'write_file': {
   14931| 01220|         const fpath = resolvePath(args.path as string);
   14932| 01221|         const content = (args.content as string) ?? '';
   14933| 01222|         let wfBefore = '';
   14934| 01223|         try { wfBefore = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))).toString('utf8'); } catch { /* new file */ }

   14942| 01231|             }
   14943| 01232|           } catch { /* file might be new */ }
   14944| 01233|         }

   14947| 01236|         if (!allowed) { return '使用者已拒絕寫入操作'; }

   14949| 01238|         this._cache.delete(`rf:${fpath}`);
   14950| 01239|         this._fileReadTimes.delete(fpath);
   14951| 01240|         const wfStats = computeDiffStatsAndPatch(wfDiff.before, wfDiff.after, fpath);

   14953| 01242|         return `已寫入 ${fpath}（${content.length} 字元）`;
   14954| 01243|       }
   14955| 01244|       case 'replace_in_file': {
   14956| 01245|         const fpath = resolvePath(args.path as string);
   14957| 01246|         const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
   14958| 01247|         const original = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8');
   14959| 01248|         const oldStr = args.old_str as string;
   14960| 01249|         const newStr = (args.new_str as string) ?? '';
   14961| 01250|         // Conflict detection
   14962| 01251|         const rifReadTime = this._fileReadTimes.get(fpath);
   14963| 01252|         if (rifReadTime !== undefined) {

   14969| 01258|           } catch { /* ignore */ }
   14970| 01259|         }

   14983| 01272|         }

   16997| 03286| function runDockerPython(pyCode: string, dockerImage: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<string> {
   16998| 03287|   return new Promise(res => {
   16999| 03288|     try {
   17000| 03289|       const { spawn } = require('child_process') as typeof import('child_process');
   17001| 03290|       const proc = spawn('docker', ['run', '--rm', '-i', '--network=host', dockerImage, 'python', '-']);
   17002| 03291|       let out = '', err = '';
   17003| 03292|       proc.stdout.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { out += d.toString(); });
   17004| 03293|       proc.stderr.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { err += d.toString(); });
   17005| 03294|       proc.on('close', () => {
   17006| 03295|         const combined = (out + (err ? '\n[stderr]\n' + err : '')).trim();
   17007| 03296|         res(combined.slice(0, 10000) || '(無輸出)');
   17008| 03297|       });
   17009| 03298|       proc.on('error', (e: Error) => res(`Docker 錯誤: ${e.message} — 請確認 Docker Desktop 正在執行`));
   17010| 03299|       const timer = setTimeout(() => { try { proc.kill(); } catch { /* noop */ } res('逾時 (' + timeoutMs + 'ms)'); }, timeoutMs);
   17011| 03300|       proc.on('close', () => clearTimeout(timer));
   17012| 03301|       proc.stdin.write(pyCode, 'utf-8');
   17013| 03302|       proc.stdin.end();
   17014| 03303|     } catch (e) {
   17015| 03304|       res(`Docker 執行失敗: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
   17016| 03305|     }
   17017| 03306|   });
   17018| 03307| }

   17080| 00033| const AUTO_WRITE_TOOLS = new Set([

   17085| 00038| // ── Effect-based rule DSL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   17086| 00039| 
   17087| 00040| export type ToolEffect = 'write' | 'shell' | 'network' | 'delete' | 'any';
   17088| 00041| 
   17089| 00042| /**
   17090| 00043|  * Single ACL rule. Stored in `amiAiClaw.toolPolicyRules` (VS Code setting).
   17091| 00044|  * Rules are evaluated top-to-bottom; first match wins.
   17092| 00045|  * Effects: write=file mutations, shell=commands, network=HTTP/browser, delete=destructive.
   17093| 00046|  * Pattern: glob for write/delete (file path); substring for shell (command) / network (URL).
   17094| 00047|  */
   17095| 00048| export interface PolicyRule {
   17096| 00049|   effect: ToolEffect;
   17097| 00050|   action: 'allow' | 'deny' | 'ask';
   17098| 00051|   pattern?: string;
   17099| 00052| }
   17100| 00053| 
   17101| 00054| const _WRITE_EFFECT = new Set([
   17102| 00055|   'write_file','replace_in_file','insert_in_file','replace_all_in_file',
   17103| 00056|   'batch_replace','rename_file','copy_file','todo_write','memory_write','lsp_rename_symbol',
   17104| 00057| ]);
   17105| 00058| const _SHELL_EFFECT  = new Set(['run_command','run_terminal','run_python']);
   17106| 00059| const _NET_EFFECT    = new Set(['http_request','fetch_url','browser_navigate','browser_screenshot','browser_script']);
   17107| 00060| 
   17108| 00061| function _getEffect(toolName: string): ToolEffect | null {
   17109| 00062|   if (_WRITE_EFFECT.has(toolName)) return 'write';
   17110| 00063|   if (_SHELL_EFFECT.has(toolName)) return 'shell';
   17111| 00064|   if (_NET_EFFECT.has(toolName))   return 'network';
   17112| 00065|   if (toolName === 'delete_file')  return 'delete';
   17113| 00066|   return null;
   17114| 00067| }
   17115| 00068| 
   17116| 00069| /** Minimal glob: * = any non-separator chars, ** = anything including /. */
   17117| 00070| function _globMatch(pattern: string, value: string): boolean {
   17118| 00071|   const v = value.replace(/\\/g, '/');
   17119| 00072|   const re = pattern
   17120| 00073|     .replace(/\\/g, '/')
   17121| 00074|     .replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]]/g, '\\$&')
   17122| 00075|     .replace(/\*\*/g, '\x00')
   17123| 00076|     .replace(/\*/g, '[^/]*')
   17124| 00077|     .replace(/\x00/g, '.*');
   17125| 00078|   // match against full path or path suffix (allows `src/**` to match `C:/ws/src/foo.ts`)
   17126| 00079|   return new RegExp(`(^|/)${re}$`, 'i').test(v) || new RegExp(`^${re}$`, 'i').test(v);
   17127| 00080| }
   17128| 00081| 
   17129| 00082| /** Evaluate ordered rules; returns first matching action or null. */
   17130| 00083| export function evaluatePolicyRules(
   17131| 00084|   rules: PolicyRule[],
   17132| 00085|   effect: ToolEffect,
   17133| 00086|   value: string,
   17134| 00087| ): 'allow' | 'deny' | 'ask' | null {
   17135| 00088|   for (const rule of rules) {
   17136| 00089|     if (rule.effect !== effect && rule.effect !== 'any') continue;
   17137| 00090|     if (!rule.pattern) return rule.action;
   17138| 00091|     if (effect === 'write' || effect === 'delete') {
   17139| 00092|       if (_globMatch(rule.pattern, value)) return rule.action;
   17140| 00093|     } else {
   17141| 00094|       if (value.toLowerCase().includes(rule.pattern.toLowerCase())) return rule.action;
   17142| 00095|     }
   17143| 00096|   }
   17144| 00097|   return null;
   17145| 00098| }
   17146| 00099| 
   17147| 00100| /**
   17148| 00101|  * 工具權限政策：alwaysAllow 集合 + 一次性確認佇列（pending promise）。
   17149| 00102|  * 把 forceConfirm / WA agent auto-allow / agentAutoApproveWrite / config alwaysAllowList
   17150| 00103|  * 這幾條規則整合在 requestPermission 內。
   17151| 00104|  */
   17152| 00105| export class ToolPolicies {
   17153| 00106|   private _alwaysAllow = new Set<string>();
   17154| 00107|   private _pendingPermission: ((allow: boolean) => void) | null = null;
   17155| 00108| 
   17156| 00109|   public constructor(private readonly _cb: ToolPoliciesCallbacks) {}

   17160| 00113|   }

   17164| 00117|   }
   17165| 00118| 
   17166| 00119|   public hasPending(): boolean {
   17167| 00120|     return this._pendingPermission !== null;
   17168| 00121|   }
   17169| 00122| 
   17170| 00123|   public resolvePending(allow: boolean): boolean {
   17171| 00124|     if (!this._pendingPermission) { return false; }
   17172| 00125|     const resolve = this._pendingPermission;
   17173| 00126|     this._pendingPermission = null;
   17174| 00127|     resolve(allow);
   17175| 00128|     return true;
   17176| 00129|   }
   17177| 00130| 
   17178| 00131|   public async requestPermission(
   17179| 00132|     category: string,
   17180| 00133|     description: string,
   17181| 00134|     toolName = '',
   17182| 00135|     diff?: ToolPermissionDiff,
   17183| 00136|   ): Promise<boolean> {
   17184| 00137|     // ── Effect-based rule DSL（最優先）───────────────────────────────────────
   17185| 00138|     if (toolName) {
   17186| 00139|       const ruleCfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
   17187| 00140|       const rules = ruleCfg.get<PolicyRule[]>('toolPolicyRules') ?? [];
   17188| 00141|       if (rules.length > 0) {
   17189| 00142|         const effect = _getEffect(toolName);
   17190| 00143|         if (effect) {
   17191| 00144|           let matchValue = description;
   17192| 00145|           if (effect === 'write' || effect === 'delete') {
   17193| 00146|             matchValue = diff?.filePath ?? '';
   17194| 00147|           } else if (effect === 'network') {
   17195| 00148|             const m = description.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
   17196| 00149|             if (m) matchValue = m[0];
   17197| 00150|           }
   17198| 00151|           const ruleDecision = evaluatePolicyRules(rules, effect, matchValue);
   17199| 00152|           if (ruleDecision === 'allow') { this._cb.log(`Rule DSL allow: ${toolName} [${effect}] ${matchValue.slice(0,60)}`); return true; }
   17200| 00153|           if (ruleDecision === 'deny')  { this._cb.log(`Rule DSL deny: ${toolName} [${effect}] ${matchValue.slice(0,60)}`);  return false; }
   17201| 00154|           // 'ask' 跳過 AutoPilot，直接展示對話框
   17202| 00155|           if (ruleDecision === 'ask') return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
   17203| 00156|             this._pendingPermission = resolve;
   17204| 00157|             this._cb.postToWebview({ type: 'permissionRequest', category, description, forceConfirm: true, diff });
   17205| 00158|           });
   17206| 00159|         }
   17207| 00160|       }
   17208| 00161|     }
   17209| 00162|     // ── AutoPilot gateway（次優先，短路後續所有邏輯）───────────────────────
   17210| 00163|     if (isAutoPilotActive() && this._cb.getAutoPilotServices) {
   17211| 00164|       const services = this._cb.getAutoPilotServices();
   17212| 00165|       const transcript = this._cb.getRecentTranscript?.() ?? [];
   17213| 00166|       const wsFolders = (vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? []).map(f => f.uri.fsPath);
   17214| 00167|       try {
   17215| 00168|         // Build full toolArgs for classifier (was: only filePath)
   17216| 00169|         const apArgs: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   17217| 00170|         if (diff) {
   17218| 00171|           apArgs.path = diff.filePath;
   17219| 00172|           if (diff.oldStr) apArgs.old_str = diff.oldStr;
   17220| 00173|           if (diff.newStr) apArgs.new_str = diff.newStr;
   17221| 00174|           if (diff.mode)   apArgs.mode    = diff.mode;
   17222| 00175|         }
   17223| 00176|         if ((toolName === 'run_command' || toolName === 'run_terminal') && !apArgs.command) {
   17224| 00177|           apArgs.command = description.replace(/^[^:：]+[：:]\s*/, '');
   17225| 00178|         }
   17226| 00179|         if (!apArgs.url) { const urlM = description.match(/https?:\/\/\S+/); if (urlM) apArgs.url = urlM[0]; }
   17227| 00180|         const decision = await decideAutoPilotAction({
   17228| 00181|           toolName,
   17229| 00182|           toolArgs: apArgs,
   17230| 00183|           toolDisplay: description,
   17231| 00184|           recentTranscript: transcript,
   17232| 00185|           workspaceFolders: wsFolders,
   17233| 00186|           services,
   17234| 00187|         });
   17235| 00188|         if (decision.kind === 'allow') {
   17236| 00189|           this._cb.log(`AutoPilot allow: ${toolName} — ${decision.reason}`);
   17237| 00190|           recordAutoPilotSuccess();
   17238| 00191|           return true;
   17239| 00192|         }
   17240| 00193|         if (decision.kind === 'deny') {
   17241| 00194|           this._cb.log(`AutoPilot deny: ${toolName} — ${decision.reason}`);
   17242| 00195|           recordAutoPilotDenial({ toolName: toolName || category, display: description, reason: decision.reason, timestamp: Date.now() });
   17243| 00196|           this._cb.postToWebview({ type: 'autoPilotDenied', tool: toolName, reason: decision.reason });
   17244| 00197|           return false;
   17245| 00198|         }
   17246| 00199|         // pass-through / fallback-ask → 繼續走下面原本邏輯
   17247| 00200|       } catch (e) {
   17248| 00201|         this._cb.log(`AutoPilot gateway error（fallback to manual）: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
   17249| 00202|       }
   17250| 00203|     }
   17251| 00204|     // ── 原本邏輯（不變）──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   17252| 00205|     const pcfg = vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('amiAiClaw');
   17253| 00206|     const alwaysAllowList = pcfg.get<string[]>('toolAlwaysAllow') ?? [];
   17254| 00207|     const alwaysConfirmList = pcfg.get<string[]>('toolAlwaysConfirm') ?? [];
   17255| 00208|     const forceConfirm = toolName ? alwaysConfirmList.includes(toolName) : false;
   17256| 00209| 
   17257| 00210|     if (this._cb.isWaAgentMode() && !forceConfirm && category !== 'delete') {
   17258| 00211|       this._cb.log(`WA agent: auto-allow tool category=${category} tool=${toolName || '(none)'}`);
   17259| 00212|       return Promise.resolve(true);
   17260| 00213|     }
   17261| 00214|     if (pcfg.get<boolean>('agentAutoApproveWrite', false) && (category === 'write' || (toolName && AUTO_WRITE_TOOLS.has(toolName)))) {
   17262| 00215|       return Promise.resolve(true);
   17263| 00216|     }
   17264| 00217|     if ((toolName && alwaysAllowList.includes(toolName)) || alwaysAllowList.includes(category)) {
   17265| 00218|       return Promise.resolve(true);
   17266| 00219|     }
   17267| 00220|     if (!forceConfirm && this._alwaysAllow.has(category)) { return Promise.resolve(true); }
   17268| 00221| 
   17269| 00222|     return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
   17270| 00223|       this._pendingPermission = resolve;
   17271| 00224|       this._cb.postToWebview({ type: 'permissionRequest', category, description, forceConfirm, diff });
   17272| 00225|     });
   17273| 00226|   }
   17274| 00227| }

   17434| 00157| // ── TF-IDF tool search ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   17435| 00158| 
   17436| 00159| function _tokenize(text: string): string[] {
   17437| 00160|   return text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\w\s]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(t => t.length > 1);
   17438| 00161| }
   17439| 00162| 
   17440| 00163| /** Smoothed IDF: log((N+1)/(df+1)) + 1, computed once at module load. */
   17441| 00164| const _idf: ReadonlyMap<string, number> = (() => {
   17442| 00165|   const N = EXTRA_TOOLS.length;
   17443| 00166|   const df = new Map<string, number>();
   17444| 00167|   for (const tool of EXTRA_TOOLS) {
   17445| 00168|     const terms = new Set(_tokenize(`${tool.function.name} ${tool.function.description}`));
   17446| 00169|     for (const t of terms) df.set(t, (df.get(t) ?? 0) + 1);
   17447| 00170|   }
   17448| 00171|   const idf = new Map<string, number>();
   17449| 00172|   for (const [term, count] of df) idf.set(term, Math.log((N + 1) / (count + 1)) + 1);
   17450| 00173|   return idf;
   17451| 00174| })();
   17452| 00175| 
   17453| 00176| function _tfidfVec(tokens: string[]): Map<string, number> {
   17454| 00177|   const tf = new Map<string, number>();
   17455| 00178|   for (const t of tokens) tf.set(t, (tf.get(t) ?? 0) + 1);
   17456| 00179|   const vec = new Map<string, number>();
   17457| 00180|   const len = tokens.length || 1;
   17458| 00181|   // unseen terms get IDF = log((N+1)/1)+1 ≈ high weight for novel query terms
   17459| 00182|   const unseenIdf = Math.log(EXTRA_TOOLS.length + 2) + 1;
   17460| 00183|   for (const [t, count] of tf) vec.set(t, (count / len) * (_idf.get(t) ?? unseenIdf));
   17461| 00184|   return vec;
   17462| 00185| }
   17463| 00186| 
   17464| 00187| function _cosine(a: Map<string, number>, b: Map<string, number>): number {
   17465| 00188|   let dot = 0, normA = 0, normB = 0;
   17466| 00189|   for (const [t, v] of a) { dot += v * (b.get(t) ?? 0); normA += v * v; }
   17467| 00190|   for (const v of b.values()) normB += v * v;
   17468| 00191|   return normA === 0 || normB === 0 ? 0 : dot / (Math.sqrt(normA) * Math.sqrt(normB));
   17469| 00192| }
   17470| 00193| 
   17471| 00194| /** Pre-computed TF-IDF vectors for all EXTRA_TOOLS (avoids recompute per query). */
   17472| 00195| const _toolVecs: ReadonlyMap<string, Map<string, number>> = (() => {
   17473| 00196|   const m = new Map<string, Map<string, number>>();
   17474| 00197|   for (const tool of EXTRA_TOOLS) {
   17475| 00198|     m.set(tool.function.name, _tfidfVec(_tokenize(`${tool.function.name} ${tool.function.description}`)));
   17476| 00199|   }
   17477| 00200|   return m;
   17478| 00201| })();
   17479| 00202| 
   17480| 00203| /**
   17481| 00204|  * TF-IDF + cosine similarity search over EXTRA_TOOLS.
   17482| 00205|  * Returns up to topK tool definitions ranked by semantic relevance.
   17483| 00206|  */
   17484| 00207| export function searchExtraTools(query: string, topK = 5): typeof EXTRA_TOOLS {
   17485| 00208|   const queryTokens = _tokenize(query);
   17486| 00209|   if (queryTokens.length === 0) return EXTRA_TOOLS.slice(0, topK);
   17487| 00210|   const queryVec = _tfidfVec(queryTokens);
   17488| 00211|   const scored = EXTRA_TOOLS.map(tool => ({
   17489| 00212|     tool,
   17490| 00213|     score: _cosine(queryVec, _toolVecs.get(tool.function.name)!),
   17491| 00214|   }));
   17492| 00215|   return scored
   17493| 00216|     .filter(s => s.score > 0)
   17494| 00217|     .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
   17495| 00218|     .slice(0, topK)
   17496| 00219|     .map(s => s.tool);
   17497| 00220| }
