   17755| 00126|   private _jiraRequest(url: string, method: string, header: string, body?: string): Promise<{status:number;data:string}> {
   17756| 00127|     return new Promise(resolve => {
   17757| 00128|       try {
   17758| 00129|         const u = new URL(url); const isHttps = u.protocol === 'https:'; const proto = isHttps ? https : http;
   17759| 00130|         const buf = body ? Buffer.from(body, 'utf8') : undefined;
   17760| 00131|         const req = proto.request({
   17761| 00132|           hostname: u.hostname, port: u.port ? parseInt(u.port) : (isHttps?443:80), path: u.pathname+u.search, method,
   17762| 00133|           headers: { 'Authorization': header, 'Accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(buf?{'Content-Length':buf.length}:{}) },
   17763| 00134|         }, res => {
   17764| 00135|           let data = '';
   17765| 00136|           res.on('data', (c: Buffer) => { data += c; });
   17766| 00137|           res.on('end', () => resolve({ status: res.statusCode ?? 0, data }));
   17767| 00138|         });
   17768| 00139|         req.on('error', (e: Error) => resolve({ status: 0, data: e.message }));
   17769| 00140|         req.setTimeout(15000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve({ status: 0, data: '逾時 (15s)' }); });
   17770| 00141|         if (buf) req.write(buf);
   17771| 00142|         req.end();
   17772| 00143|       } catch(e) { resolve({ status: 0, data: String(e) }); }
   17773| 00144|     });
   17774| 00145|   }

   18029| 00043|   private async _run(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {

   18194| 00039|   private _pyauto(code: string): Promise<string> {
   18195| 00040|     const tmpFile = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `ami_computer_${Date.now()}.py`);
   18196| 00041|     try {
   18197| 00042|       fs.writeFileSync(tmpFile, code, 'utf8');
   18198| 00043|     } catch (e) {
   18199| 00044|       return Promise.resolve(`錯誤：無法建立暫存檔案 — ${e}`);
   18200| 00045|     }
   18201| 00046|     return new Promise(resolve => {
   18202| 00047|       const cmds = process.platform === 'win32'
   18203| 00048|         ? ['py', 'python', 'python3']
   18204| 00049|         : ['python3', 'python'];
   18205| 00050|       let tried = 0;
   18206| 00051|       const tryNext = () => {
   18207| 00052|         if (tried >= cmds.length) {
   18208| 00053|           _cleanup(tmpFile);
   18209| 00054|           resolve('錯誤：找不到 Python（pip install pyautogui pillow mss）');
   18210| 00055|           return;
   18211| 00056|         }
   18212| 00057|         const c = cmds[tried++];
   18213| 00058|         exec(`${c} "${tmpFile}"`, { timeout: 20_000 }, (err, stdout, stderr) => {
   18214| 00059|           if (err && (err as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'ENOENT') { tryNext(); return; }
   18215| 00060|           _cleanup(tmpFile);
   18216| 00061|           const out = (stdout || '').trim();
   18217| 00062|           const err2 = (stderr || '').trim();
   18218| 00063|           resolve(out || (err2 ? `[stderr] ${err2}` : '✅ 完成'));
   18219| 00064|         });
   18220| 00065|       };
   18221| 00066|       tryNext();
   18222| 00067|     });
   18223| 00068|   }

   18590| 00231|         let data=''; res.setEncoding('utf8');
   18591| 00232|         res.on('data',(d:string)=>{data+=d;});
   18592| 00233|         res.on('end',()=>{ try { const j=JSON.parse(data) as {message?:{content?:string};error?:string}; if (j.error) reject(new Error(j.error)); else resolve((j.message?.content??'').trim()); } catch { reject(new Error(`回應解析失敗: ${data.slice(0,200)}`)); } });
   18593| 00234|       });
   18594| 00235|       req.on('error',(e:Error)=>reject(e));
   18595| 00236|       req.setTimeout(timeoutMs,()=>{ req.destroy(); reject(new Error(`Ollama 視覺推論逾時 (${timeoutMs}ms)`)); });

   18616| 00006| export function runDockerPython(pyCode: string, dockerImage: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<string> {
   18617| 00007|   return new Promise(res => {
   18618| 00008|     try {
   18619| 00009|       const proc = spawn('docker', ['run', '--rm', '-i', '--network=host', dockerImage, 'python', '-']);
   18620| 00010|       let out = '', err = '';
   18621| 00011|       proc.stdout.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { out += d.toString(); });
   18622| 00012|       proc.stderr.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { err += d.toString(); });
   18623| 00013|       proc.on('close', () => res((out + (err ? '\n[stderr]\n' + err : '')).trim().slice(0, 10000) || '(無輸出)'));
   18624| 00014|       proc.on('error', (e: Error) => res(`Docker 錯誤: ${e.message} — 請確認 Docker Desktop 正在執行`));
   18625| 00015|       const timer = setTimeout(() => { try { proc.kill(); } catch { /* noop */ } res(`逾時 (${timeoutMs}ms)`); }, timeoutMs);
   18626| 00016|       proc.on('close', () => clearTimeout(timer));
   18627| 00017|       proc.stdin.write(pyCode, 'utf-8');
   18628| 00018|       proc.stdin.end();
   18629| 00019|     } catch (e) { res(`Docker 執行失敗: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`); }
   18630| 00020|   });
   18631| 00021| }

   18661| 00009| // ── computeUnifiedDiff (moved from ToolExecutor top-level) ────────────────────
   18662| 00010| function computeUnifiedDiff(aLines: string[], bLines: string[], fileA: string, fileB: string, contextLines: number): string {
   18663| 00011|   const m = aLines.length, n = bLines.length;
   18664| 00012|   const dp: number[][] = Array.from({ length: m + 1 }, () => new Array(n + 1).fill(0));
   18665| 00013|   for (let i = 1; i <= m; i++) for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) dp[i][j] = aLines[i-1] === bLines[j-1] ? dp[i-1][j-1]+1 : Math.max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]);
   18666| 00014|   type Edit = { op: ' '|'-'|'+'; line: string; ai: number; bi: number };
   18667| 00015|   const edits: Edit[] = [];
   18668| 00016|   let i = m, j = n;
   18669| 00017|   while (i > 0 || j > 0) {
   18670| 00018|     if (i > 0 && j > 0 && aLines[i-1] === bLines[j-1]) { edits.push({ op: ' ', line: aLines[i-1], ai: i, bi: j }); i--; j--; }
   18671| 00019|     else if (j > 0 && (i === 0 || dp[i][j-1] >= dp[i-1][j])) { edits.push({ op: '+', line: bLines[j-1], ai: i, bi: j }); j--; }
   18672| 00020|     else { edits.push({ op: '-', line: aLines[i-1], ai: i, bi: j }); i--; }
   18673| 00021|   }
   18674| 00022|   edits.reverse();
   18675| 00023|   const changed = new Set(edits.map((e, idx) => e.op !== ' ' ? idx : -1).filter(x => x >= 0));
   18676| 00024|   if (changed.size === 0) return '';
   18677| 00025|   const inHunk = new Set<number>();
   18678| 00026|   for (const c of changed) for (let k = Math.max(0, c-contextLines); k <= Math.min(edits.length-1, c+contextLines); k++) inHunk.add(k);
   18679| 00027|   const lines: string[] = [`--- ${fileA}`, `+++ ${fileB}`];
   18680| 00028|   let inBlock = false, aStart = 0, bStart = 0, aCount = 0, bCount = 0;
   18681| 00029|   const hunkLines: string[] = [];
   18682| 00030|   const flushHunk = () => { if (hunkLines.length) { lines.push(`@@ -${aStart},${aCount} +${bStart},${bCount} @@`); lines.push(...hunkLines); hunkLines.length = 0; inBlock = false; } };
   18683| 00031|   let aIdx = 1, bIdx = 1;
   18684| 00032|   for (let k = 0; k < edits.length; k++) {
   18685| 00033|     const e = edits[k];
   18686| 00034|     if (inHunk.has(k)) {
   18687| 00035|       if (!inBlock) { flushHunk(); aStart = aIdx; bStart = bIdx; aCount = 0; bCount = 0; inBlock = true; }
   18688| 00036|       hunkLines.push(e.op + e.line);
   18689| 00037|       if (e.op !== '+') { aCount++; aIdx++; }
   18690| 00038|       if (e.op !== '-') { bCount++; bIdx++; }
   18691| 00039|     } else { if (inBlock) flushHunk(); if (e.op !== '+') aIdx++; if (e.op !== '-') bIdx++; }
   18692| 00040|   }
   18693| 00041|   flushHunk();
   18694| 00042|   return lines.join('\n');
   18695| 00043| }
   18696| 00044| 
   18697| 00045| function computeDiffStatsAndPatch(
   18698| 00046|   before: string, after: string, filePath: string, maxPatchBytes = 6000
   18699| 00047| ): { linesAdded: number; linesRemoved: number; patch: string } {
   18700| 00048|   const aLines = before.split(/\r?\n/);
   18701| 00049|   const bLines = after.split(/\r?\n/);
   18702| 00050|   if (aLines.length + bLines.length > 4000) {
   18703| 00051|     return { linesAdded: Math.max(0, bLines.length - aLines.length), linesRemoved: Math.max(0, aLines.length - bLines.length), patch: '' };
   18704| 00052|   }
   18705| 00053|   const baseName = path.basename(filePath);
   18706| 00054|   let patch = computeUnifiedDiff(aLines, bLines, baseName, baseName, 3);
   18707| 00055|   if (patch.length > maxPatchBytes) { patch = patch.slice(0, maxPatchBytes) + '\n…（截斷）'; }
   18708| 00056|   const pLines = patch.split('\n');
   18709| 00057|   const linesAdded = pLines.filter(l => l.startsWith('+') && !l.startsWith('+++')).length;
   18710| 00058|   const linesRemoved = pLines.filter(l => l.startsWith('-') && !l.startsWith('---')).length;
   18711| 00059|   return { linesAdded, linesRemoved, patch };
   18712| 00060| }

   18761| 00109|   // ── read_file ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   18762| 00110|   private async _readFile(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
   18763| 00111|     const fpath = await ctx.resolvePathSmart(args.path as string);
   18764| 00112|     const rfKey = `rf:${fpath}`;
   18765| 00113|     const cached = ctx.cache.get(rfKey);
   18766| 00114|     if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
   18767| 00115|     let stat: vscode.FileStat;
   18768| 00116|     try { stat = await vscode.workspace.fs.stat(vscode.Uri.file(fpath)); } catch { return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${fpath}`; }
   18769| 00117|     const MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
   18770| 00118|     const LOG_SMART = 64 * 1024;
   18771| 00119|     const ext = fpath.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
   18772| 00120|     const isLog = ['log','txt','out','err','bld','build','trace'].includes(ext);
   18773| 00121|     const LOG_PAT = 'error:|Error:|ERROR|warning:|Warning:|WARNING|fatal:|Fatal:|FATAL|fail:|FAIL|FAILED|BUILD FAILURE|BUILD ERROR|assert|Assert|ASSERT|exception|Exception|EXCEPTION|undefined reference|cannot find|unresolved|Unresolved|ld returned|undefined symbol|Traceback|SyntaxError|TypeError|ReferenceError|ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError|abort|Abort|ABORT|crash|Crash|panic|Panic|PANIC|segfault|Segmentation fault|signal [0-9]|No such file|Permission denied|Access denied|not found';
   18774| 00122|     if (stat.size > MAX_BYTES) {
   18775| 00123|       const sizeMb = (stat.size/1024/1024).toFixed(1);
   18776| 00124|       if (isLog) {
   18777| 00125|         const [tail, errs] = await Promise.all([ctx.executeTool('read_file_smart',{path:args.path,tail:300,max_kb:96}), ctx.executeTool('read_file_smart',{path:args.path,pattern:LOG_PAT,context_lines:5,max_kb:128})]);
   18778| 00126|         return `⚠️ 檔案過大（${sizeMb} MB），自動分兩段回傳——\n\n【全檔錯誤/警告點（含前後 5 行 context）】\n${errs}\n\n【尾端 300 行（最終執行結果）】\n${tail}`;
   18779| 00127|       }
   18780| 00128|       return `⚠️ 檔案過大（${sizeMb} MB），自動回傳前 300 行：\n${await ctx.executeTool('read_file_smart',{path:args.path,head:300,max_kb:64})}`;
   18781| 00129|     }
   18782| 00130|     if (isLog && stat.size > LOG_SMART) {
   18783| 00131|       const sizeKb = (stat.size/1024).toFixed(0);
   18784| 00132|       const [errs, tail] = await Promise.all([ctx.executeTool('read_file_smart',{path:args.path,pattern:LOG_PAT,context_lines:5,max_kb:128}), ctx.executeTool('read_file_smart',{path:args.path,tail:100,max_kb:64})]);
   18785| 00133|       return `📋 Log 分析模式（${sizeKb} KB）——先掃描各式錯誤點，再補尾端執行結果\n\n【錯誤 / 警告點（含前後 5 行 context）】\n${errs}\n\n【尾端 100 行（執行結果）】\n${tail}`;
   18786| 00134|     }
   18787| 00135|     const text = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))).toString('utf8');
   18788| 00136|     const result = text.length > 50000 ? text.slice(0, 50000) + '\n…（已截斷至 50KB）' : text;
   18789| 00137|     if (text.length <= 10000) ctx.cache.set(rfKey, result);
   18790| 00138|     return result;
   18791| 00139|   }

   18793| 00141|   // ── read_file_smart ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   18794| 00142|   private async _readFileSmart(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
   18795| 00143|     const fpath = await ctx.resolvePathSmart(args.path as string);
   18796| 00144|     const pattern   = args.pattern    ? String(args.pattern)   : null;
   18797| 00145|     const startLine = args.start_line ? Math.max(1, Number(args.start_line)) : null;
   18798| 00146|     const endLine   = args.end_line   ? Math.max(1, Number(args.end_line))   : null;
   18799| 00147|     const head      = args.head       ? Math.max(1, Number(args.head))       : null;
   18800| 00148|     const tail      = args.tail       ? Math.max(1, Number(args.tail))       : null;
   18801| 00149|     const ctxLines  = args.context_lines ? Math.max(0, Number(args.context_lines)) : 0;
   18802| 00150|     const maxKb     = args.max_kb     ? Math.max(1, Math.min(512, Number(args.max_kb))) : 128;
   18803| 00151|     try {
   18804| 00152|       const nodefs   = require('fs') as typeof import('fs');
   18805| 00153|       const readline = require('readline') as typeof import('readline');
   18806| 00154|       let stat: import('fs').Stats;
   18807| 00155|       try { stat = nodefs.statSync(fpath); } catch { return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${fpath}`; }
   18808| 00156|       const fileSizeMb = (stat.size/1024/1024).toFixed(1);
   18809| 00157|       const regex = pattern ? new RegExp(pattern, 'i') : null;
   18810| 00158|       const maxBytes = maxKb * 1024;
   18811| 00159|       const matched: Array<{lineNo:number;text:string;isContext?:boolean}> = [];
   18812| 00160|       const ring: string[] = [];
   18813| 00161|       const pendingCtx = new Set<number>();
   18814| 00162|       let totalLines = 0;
   18815| 00163|       await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
   18816| 00164|         const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: nodefs.createReadStream(fpath, {encoding:'utf8'}), crlfDelay: Infinity });
   18817| 00165|         let lineNo = 0; let outBytes = 0; let collecting = true;
   18818| 00166|         let tailBuf: string[] = tail ? [] : [];
   18819| 00167|         rl.on('line', (line: string) => {
   18820| 00168|           lineNo++;
   18821| 00169|           if (!collecting) return;
   18822| 00170|           if (tail) { tailBuf.push(line); if (tailBuf.length > tail) tailBuf.shift(); return; }
   18823| 00171|           if (head && lineNo > head) { collecting = false; return; }
   18824| 00172|           if (startLine && lineNo < startLine) { if (ctxLines > 0) { ring.push(line); if (ring.length > ctxLines) ring.shift(); } return; }
   18825| 00173|           if (endLine && lineNo > endLine) { collecting = false; return; }
   18826| 00174|           const isMatch = regex ? regex.test(line) : true;
   18827| 00175|           if (isMatch) {
   18828| 00176|             if (ctxLines > 0 && regex) {
   18829| 00177|               for (let ri = 0; ri < ring.length; ri++) { const cn = lineNo-ring.length+ri; if (!matched.find(m=>m.lineNo===cn)) matched.push({lineNo:cn,text:ring[ri],isContext:true}); }
   18830| 00178|               ring.length = 0;
   18831| 00179|               for (let j = 1; j <= ctxLines; j++) pendingCtx.add(lineNo+j);
   18832| 00180|             }
   18833| 00181|             matched.push({lineNo,text:line});
   18834| 00182|             outBytes += line.length+1;
   18835| 00183|             if (outBytes > maxBytes) { collecting = false; return; }
   18836| 00184|           } else {
   18837| 00185|             if (pendingCtx.has(lineNo)) { pendingCtx.delete(lineNo); matched.push({lineNo,text:line,isContext:true}); outBytes += line.length+1; }
   18838| 00186|             if (ctxLines > 0 && regex) { ring.push(line); if (ring.length > ctxLines) ring.shift(); }
   18839| 00187|           }
   18840| 00188|         });
   18841| 00189|         rl.on('close', () => {
   18842| 00190|           totalLines = lineNo;
   18843| 00191|           if (tail && tailBuf.length > 0) { const s = lineNo-tailBuf.length+1; tailBuf.forEach((tl,i) => matched.push({lineNo:s+i,text:tl})); }
   18844| 00192|           resolve();
   18845| 00193|         });
   18846| 00194|         rl.on('error', reject);
   18847| 00195|       });
   18848| 00196|       const hdr = `📄 ${fpath}  (${fileSizeMb} MB, ${totalLines.toLocaleString()} 行)${pattern?`  pattern="${pattern}"`:''}${startLine?`  lines=${startLine}-${endLine??'∞'}`:''}${head?`  head=${head}`:''}${tail?`  tail=${tail}`:''}  matched=${matched.length} 行\n`;
   18849| 00197|       if (matched.length === 0) return hdr + '（無匹配行）';
   18850| 00198|       let totalOut = 0;
   18851| 00199|       const outputLines = matched.map(m => {
   18852| 00200|         totalOut += m.text.length+1;
   18853| 00201|         const pct = totalLines > 0 ? ` (${(m.lineNo*100/totalLines).toFixed(1)}%)` : '';
   18854| 00202|         return `${m.isContext?'  ':''}${String(m.lineNo).padStart(6)}${pct}: ${m.text}`;
   18855| 00203|       });
   18856| 00204|       return hdr + outputLines.join('\n') + (totalOut > maxBytes ? `\n…（已達 ${maxKb}KB 上限）` : '');
   18857| 00205|     } catch(e) { return `read_file_smart 錯誤：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`; }
   18858| 00206|   }

   18860| 00208|   // ── grep_file ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   18861| 00209|   private async _grepFile(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
   18862| 00210|     const gfPath = await ctx.resolvePathSmart(args.path as string);
   18863| 00211|     const kws = Array.isArray(args.keywords) ? (args.keywords as unknown[]).map(String).filter(Boolean) : [];
   18864| 00212|     if (kws.length === 0) return '錯誤：keywords 為空';
   18865| 00213|     const gfCtx = args.context_lines ? Math.max(0, Number(args.context_lines)) : 3;
   18866| 00214|     const maxPerKw = args.max_matches_per_kw ? Math.max(1, Number(args.max_matches_per_kw)) : 30;
   18867| 00215|     const maxKb = args.max_kb ? Math.max(1, Math.min(512, Number(args.max_kb))) : 128;
   18868| 00216|     const caseSens = args.case_sensitive === true;
   18869| 00217|     const maxBytes = maxKb * 1024;
   18870| 00218|     try {
   18871| 00219|       const nodefs = require('fs') as typeof import('fs');
   18872| 00220|       const readline = require('readline') as typeof import('readline');
   18873| 00221|       let stat: import('fs').Stats;
   18874| 00222|       try { stat = nodefs.statSync(gfPath); } catch { return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${gfPath}`; }
   18875| 00223|       const fileSizeMb = (stat.size/1024/1024).toFixed(1);
   18876| 00224|       const flag = caseSens ? '' : 'i';
   18877| 00225|       type KwGroup = { kw:string; re:RegExp; matches:Array<{lineNo:number;text:string;isCtx?:boolean}>; totalHits:number; capped:boolean };
   18878| 00226|       const groups: KwGroup[] = kws.map(kw => ({ kw, re: new RegExp(kw, flag), matches:[], totalHits:0, capped:false }));
   18879| 00227|       const ring: string[] = [];
   18880| 00228|       const pendingCtx: Set<number>[] = groups.map(() => new Set<number>());
   18881| 00229|       let totalFileLines = 0;
   18882| 00230|       await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
   18883| 00231|         const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: nodefs.createReadStream(gfPath, {encoding:'utf8'}), crlfDelay:Infinity });
   18884| 00232|         let lineNo = 0;
   18885| 00233|         rl.on('line', (line: string) => {
   18886| 00234|           lineNo++;
   18887| 00235|           for (let gi = 0; gi < groups.length; gi++) {
   18888| 00236|             const g = groups[gi];
   18889| 00237|             if (pendingCtx[gi].has(lineNo)) { pendingCtx[gi].delete(lineNo); if (!g.re.test(line) && !g.matches.find(m=>m.lineNo===lineNo)) g.matches.push({lineNo,text:line,isCtx:true}); }
   18890| 00238|             if (g.re.test(line)) {
   18891| 00239|               g.totalHits++;
   18892| 00240|               if (!g.capped) {
   18893| 00241|                 if (g.totalHits <= maxPerKw) {
   18894| 00242|                   if (gfCtx > 0) { const rs = Math.max(0, ring.length-gfCtx); for (let ri = rs; ri < ring.length; ri++) { const cn = lineNo-(ring.length-ri); if (cn>=1 && !g.matches.find(m=>m.lineNo===cn)) g.matches.push({lineNo:cn,text:ring[ri],isCtx:true}); } }
   18895| 00243|                   const ex = g.matches.findIndex(m=>m.lineNo===lineNo); if (ex!==-1) g.matches.splice(ex,1);
   18896| 00244|                   g.matches.push({lineNo,text:line,isCtx:false});
   18897| 00245|                   for (let j = 1; j <= gfCtx; j++) pendingCtx[gi].add(lineNo+j);
   18898| 00246|                 } else { g.capped = true; }
   18899| 00247|               }
   18900| 00248|             }
   18901| 00249|           }
   18902| 00250|           ring.push(line); if (ring.length > gfCtx+1) ring.shift();
   18903| 00251|         });
   18904| 00252|         rl.on('close', () => { totalFileLines = lineNo; resolve(); });
   18905| 00253|         rl.on('error', reject);
   18906| 00254|       });
   18907| 00255|       const allHits = groups.reduce((s,g) => s+g.totalHits, 0);
   18908| 00256|       const hdr = `📄 ${gfPath}  (${fileSizeMb} MB, ${totalFileLines.toLocaleString()} 行)\n🔍 Keywords: ${kws.map(k=>`"${k}"`).join(', ')}  |  context=${gfCtx}  |  total hits: ${allHits}\n`;
   18909| 00257|       const sections: string[] = []; let outBytes = hdr.length;
   18910| 00258|       for (const g of groups) {
   18911| 00259|         if (outBytes >= maxBytes) { sections.push(`…（已達 ${maxKb}KB 上限）`); break; }
   18912| 00260|         const sorted = g.matches.sort((a,b)=>a.lineNo-b.lineNo);
   18913| 00261|         const deduped: typeof sorted = [];
   18914| 00262|         for (const m of sorted) { if (!deduped.length || deduped[deduped.length-1].lineNo!==m.lineNo) deduped.push(m); else if (!m.isCtx) deduped[deduped.length-1].isCtx=false; }
   18915| 00263|         const capNote = g.capped ? ` (顯示前 ${maxPerKw}，共 ${g.totalHits} 處)` : ` (${g.totalHits} 處)`;
   18916| 00264|         let section = `\n━━━ "${g.kw}" ${g.totalHits===0?'— 無匹配':capNote} ━━━\n`;
   18917| 00265|         if (deduped.length === 0) { section += '（無匹配行）\n'; }
   18918| 00266|         else {
   18919| 00267|           const matchNos = deduped.filter(m=>!m.isCtx).map(m=>m.lineNo);
   18920| 00268|           if (matchNos.length > 0) section += `   📍 分布位置：${matchNos.map(n=>`${(n*100/totalFileLines).toFixed(1)}%`).join(', ')}\n`;
   18921| 00269|           let prev = -999;
   18922| 00270|           for (const m of deduped) {
   18923| 00271|             if (m.lineNo > prev+1 && prev !== -999) section += '   ——\n';
   18924| 00272|             const pct = totalFileLines > 0 ? ` (${(m.lineNo*100/totalFileLines).toFixed(1)}%)` : '';
   18925| 00273|             section += `${m.isCtx?'  ':'▶ '}${String(m.lineNo).padStart(6)}${pct}: ${m.text}\n`;
   18926| 00274|             prev = m.lineNo;
   18927| 00275|           }
   18928| 00276|         }
   18929| 00277|         if (outBytes + section.length > maxBytes) { section = section.slice(0, maxBytes-outBytes) + '\n…（截斷）\n'; }
   18930| 00278|         sections.push(section); outBytes += section.length;
   18931| 00279|       }
   18932| 00280|       return hdr + sections.join('');
   18933| 00281|     } catch(e) { return `grep_file 錯誤：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`; }
   18934| 00282|   }

   18936| 00284|   // ── read_files ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   18937| 00285|   private async _readFiles(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
   18938| 00286|     const rawPaths = Array.isArray(args.paths) ? (args.paths as unknown[]).map(String).filter(Boolean) : [];
   18939| 00287|     if (rawPaths.length === 0) return '錯誤：paths 為空陣列';
   18940| 00288|     const MAX_FILES = 30;
   18941| 00289|     const maxPerKb = Math.max(1, (args.max_per_file_kb as number) || 64) * 1024;
   18942| 00290|     const maxTotalKb = Math.max(1, (args.max_total_kb as number) || 256) * 1024;
   18943| 00291|     const truncated = rawPaths.slice(0, MAX_FILES);
   18944| 00292|     const overflow = rawPaths.length > MAX_FILES ? rawPaths.length - MAX_FILES : 0;
   18945| 00293|     const parts: string[] = []; let totalBytes = 0; const summary: string[] = [];
   18946| 00294|     for (const p of truncated) {
   18947| 00295|       if (totalBytes >= maxTotalKb) { summary.push(`⚠️ 已達總量上限 ${(maxTotalKb/1024)}KB，後續檔案跳過`); break; }
   18948| 00296|       const fpath = await ctx.resolvePathSmart(p);
   18949| 00297|       try {
   18950| 00298|         const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
   18951| 00299|         let text = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8');
   18952| 00300|         if (text.length > maxPerKb) { text = text.slice(0, maxPerKb) + `\n…（${path.basename(fpath)} 已截斷 ${Math.round(maxPerKb/1024)}KB）`; }
   18953| 00301|         parts.push(`=== ${fpath} ===\n${text}`);
   18954| 00302|         totalBytes += text.length;
   18955| 00303|       } catch { parts.push(`=== ${fpath} ===\n錯誤：找不到或無法讀取`); }
   18956| 00304|     }
   18957| 00305|     if (overflow > 0) summary.push(`⚠️ paths 數量超過上限 ${MAX_FILES}，未處理 ${overflow} 個檔案。`);
   18958| 00306|     return summary.join('\n') + '\n\n' + parts.join('\n');
   18959| 00307|   }

   18991| 00339|   // ── insert_in_file ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   18992| 00340|   private async _insertInFile(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
   18993| 00341|     const fpath = ctx.resolvePath(args.path as string);
   18994| 00342|     const lineNum = Math.max(0, Number(args.line) || 0);
   18995| 00343|     const content = (args.content as string) ?? '';
   18996| 00344|     let original: string;
   18997| 00345|     try { original = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))).toString('utf8'); } catch { return `錯誤：找不到檔案 ${fpath}`; }
   18998| 00346|     const lineEnding = original.includes('\r\n') ? '\r\n' : '\n';
   18999| 00347|     const lines = original.split(/\r?\n/);

   19031| 00379|   private async _batchReplace(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
   19032| 00380|     const brPattern = args.pattern as string; const brReplace = args.replace as string;
   19033| 00381|     const brGlob = (args.include as string) || '**/*';

   19049| 00397|           results.push(`  ${path.relative(ctx.wsRoot, uri.fsPath).replace(/\\/g,'/')}  (${(original.match(new RegExp(brPattern, brFlags)) || []).length} 處)`);

   19051| 00399|         }
   19052| 00400|       } catch { /* skip binary */ }
   19053| 00401|     }
   19054| 00402|     return total === 0 ? `找不到符合的內容 (/${brPattern}/ in ${brGlob})` : `批次取代完成，共修改 ${total} 個檔案:\n${results.join('\n')}`;

   19087| 00435|     }

   19170| 00518|   private async _fileInfo(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
   19171| 00519|     const fpath = ctx.resolvePath(args.path as string || ''); if (!fpath) return '請提供 path 參數';
   19172| 00520|     try {
   19173| 00521|       const [stat, bytes] = await Promise.all([vscode.workspace.fs.stat(vscode.Uri.file(fpath)), vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(fpath))]);
   19174| 00522|       const buf = Buffer.from(bytes);
   19175| 00523|       let encoding = 'UTF-8';
   19176| 00524|       if (buf[0]===0xEF&&buf[1]===0xBB&&buf[2]===0xBF) encoding='UTF-8 BOM';
   19177| 00525|       else if (buf[0]===0xFF&&buf[1]===0xFE) encoding='UTF-16 LE BOM';
   19178| 00526|       else if (buf[0]===0xFE&&buf[1]===0xFF) encoding='UTF-16 BE BOM';
   19179| 00527|       const text = buf.toString('utf8'); const lineCount = text.split('\n').length;
   19180| 00528|       const crlf = (text.match(/\r\n/g)||[]).length; const lf = (text.match(/(?<!\r)\n/g)||[]).length;
   19181| 00529|       const mtime = new Date(stat.mtime).toISOString().replace('T',' ').slice(0,19);
   19182| 00530|       return [`路徑: ${fpath}`,`類型: ${(stat.type&vscode.FileType.Directory)?'目錄':'檔案'}`,`大小: ${stat.size} bytes (${(stat.size/1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`,`行數: ${lineCount}`,`行尾: ${crlf>lf?'CRLF':'LF'} (CRLF:${crlf} / LF:${lf})`,`編碼: ${encoding}`,`修改時間: ${mtime} UTC`].join('\n');
   19183| 00531|     } catch(e) { return `file_info 錯誤: ${e}`; }
   19184| 00532|   }

   19221| 00569|     const include = (args.include as string) || '**/*.{ts,js,tsx,jsx,py,cs,java,go,rs,cpp,c,h,inf,dec,dsc,fdf,uni,nasm,asm,asl,md,json,yaml,yml,txt}';
   19222| 00570|     const extraExclude = ((args.exclude as string) || '').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
   19223| 00571|     const excludeGlob = '{' + ['**/node_modules/**','**/.git/**','**/dist/**','**/out/**','**/build/**','**/.next/**','**/__pycache__/**','**/*.min.js','**/*.map', ...extraExclude].join(',') + '}';
   19224| 00572|     const maxFileBytes = Math.max(1, (args.max_file_kb as number) || 128) * 1024;
   19225| 00573|     const maxTotalBytes = Math.max(1, (args.max_total_kb as number) || 512) * 1024;
   19226| 00574|     const offset = Math.max(0, Number(args.offset) || 0);
   19227| 00575|     const allUris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(include, excludeGlob, 2000);
   19228| 00576|     const binaryExts = new Set(['.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.gif','.ico','.webp','.bmp','.vsix','.zip','.tar','.gz','.exe','.dll','.so','.dylib','.wasm','.pdf','.db','.sqlite']);
   19229| 00577|     const candidates = allUris.filter(u => !binaryExts.has(path.extname(u.fsPath).toLowerCase()));
   19230| 00578|     const sliced = candidates.slice(offset);
   19231| 00579|     const parts: string[] = []; let totalBytes = 0; let truncated = false; let processed = 0;
   19232| 00580|     for (const uri of sliced) {
   19233| 00581|       processed++;
   19234| 00582|       if (processed % 10 === 0) ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'agentStepProgress', text: `📂 read_workspace 進度 ${processed}/${sliced.length} (≈${Math.round(totalBytes/1024)}KB)` });
   19235| 00583|       let content: string;
   19236| 00584|       try {
   19237| 00585|         const raw = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri));
   19238| 00586|         content = raw.length > maxFileBytes ? raw.toString('utf8', 0, maxFileBytes) + `\n…（已截斷，原始檔案 ${Math.round(raw.length/1024)} KB）` : raw.toString('utf8');
   19239| 00587|       } catch { continue; }
   19240| 00588|       const entry = `### ${vscode.workspace.asRelativePath(uri)}\n\`\`\`\n${content}\n\`\`\``;
   19241| 00589|       if (totalBytes + Buffer.byteLength(entry, 'utf8') > maxTotalBytes) { truncated = true; processed--; break; }
   19242| 00590|       totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(entry, 'utf8'); parts.push(entry);
   19243| 00591|     }
   19244| 00592|     const nextOffset = offset + processed; const remaining = Math.max(0, candidates.length - nextOffset);
   19245| 00593|     const header = `工作區共 ${candidates.length} 個檔案，本批讀取 ${parts.length} 個（offset=${offset}→${nextOffset}，合計 ≈${Math.round(totalBytes/1024)} KB）${truncated?'，已達容量上限提早停止':''}`;
   19246| 00594|     const hint = remaining > 0 ? `\n💡 剩餘 ${remaining} 個檔案未讀取，如需繼續請再次呼叫 read_workspace 並使用 offset=${nextOffset}。` : '\n✅ 所有符合條件的檔案已讀取完畢。';
   19247| 00595|     return header + hint + '\n\n' + parts.join('\n\n');
   19248| 00596|   }
   19249| 00597| }

   19430| 00027|   private _http(urlStr: string, method: string, auth: string, postBody?: string, extraHdrs: Record<string, string> = {}): Promise<HttpResult> {
   19431| 00028|     return new Promise(res => {
   19432| 00029|       let pu: URL;
   19433| 00030|       try { pu = new URL(urlStr); } catch { res({ status: 0, body: '無效 URL: ' + urlStr }); return; }
   19434| 00031|       const isHttps = pu.protocol === 'https:';
   19435| 00032|       const proto = isHttps ? https : http;
   19436| 00033|       const bodyBuf = postBody ? Buffer.from(postBody, 'utf8') : undefined;
   19437| 00034|       const opts = {
   19438| 00035|         hostname: pu.hostname, port: pu.port || (isHttps ? 443 : 80),
   19439| 00036|         path: pu.pathname + pu.search, method,
   19440| 00037|         headers: {
   19441| 00038|           'Accept': 'application/json',
   19442| 00039|           ...(auth ? { 'Authorization': auth } : {}),
   19443| 00040|           ...(bodyBuf ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', 'Content-Length': bodyBuf.length } : {}),
   19444| 00041|           ...extraHdrs,
   19445| 00042|         },
   19446| 00043|       };
   19447| 00044|       let rb = '';
   19448| 00045|       const req = proto.request(opts, r => {
   19449| 00046|         r.setEncoding('utf8');
   19450| 00047|         r.on('data', (d: string) => { rb += d; });
   19451| 00048|         r.on('end', () => res({ status: r.statusCode ?? 0, body: rb, location: r.headers.location as string | undefined }));
   19452| 00049|       });
   19453| 00050|       req.on('error', (e: Error) => res({ status: 0, body: '網路錯誤: ' + e.message }));
   19454| 00051|       req.setTimeout(15000, () => { req.destroy(); res({ status: 0, body: '超時 (15s)' }); });
   19455| 00052|       if (bodyBuf) { req.write(bodyBuf); }
   19456| 00053|       req.end();
   19457| 00054|     });
   19458| 00055|   }

   19772| 00177|           if (s.children.length) flatten(s.children, depth + 1);
   19773| 00178|         }

   19775| 00180|

   19781| 00186|         }
   19782| 00187|       }
   19783| 00188|       return lines.slice(0, 500).join('\n');
   19784| 00189|     } catch (e) {

   19822| 00031|   private _fetchUrl(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
   19823| 00032|     const rawUrl = (args.url as string || '').trim();
   19824| 00033|     if (!rawUrl) return Promise.resolve('請提供 url 參數');
   19825| 00034|     try { new URL(rawUrl); } catch { return Promise.resolve(`無效的 URL: ${rawUrl}`); }
   19826| 00035|     return new Promise<string>(resolve => {
   19827| 00036|       const protocol = rawUrl.startsWith('https') ? https : http;

   19847| 00056|   private async _httpRequest(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
   19848| 00057|     const method = ((args.method as string) || 'GET').toUpperCase();
   19849| 00058|     const reqUrl = (args.url as string || '').trim(); if (!reqUrl) return '請提供 url 參數';
   19850| 00059|     const reqHeaders = (args.headers as Record<string,string>) || {};
   19851| 00060|     const reqBody = args.body ? String(args.body) : undefined;
   19852| 00061|     const reqTimeout = Number(args.timeout || 15000);
   19853| 00062|     if (method !== 'GET' && method !== 'HEAD') {
   19854| 00063|       if (!await ctx.requestPermission('run', `HTTP ${method}: ${reqUrl}`, 'http_request')) return '使用者已拒絕 HTTP 請求';
   19855| 00064|     }

   19857| 00066|       let parsedUrl: URL; try { parsedUrl = new URL(reqUrl); } catch { resolve('無效的 URL'); return; }

   19859| 00068|       const bodyBuf = reqBody ? Buffer.from(reqBody, 'utf8') : undefined;
   19860| 00069|       const options = {
   19861| 00070|         hostname: parsedUrl.hostname, port: parsedUrl.port || (parsedUrl.protocol==='https:'?443:80),
   19862| 00071|         path: parsedUrl.pathname + parsedUrl.search, method,
   19863| 00072|         headers: { 'User-Agent':'AmiClaw-Agent/1.0', 'Accept':'application/json, text/plain, */*', ...(bodyBuf?{'Content-Type':'application/json','Content-Length':bodyBuf.length}:{}), ...reqHeaders },
   19864| 00073|       };
   19865| 00074|       let buf = '';
   19866| 00075|       const req = protocol.request(options, res => {
   19867| 00076|         res.setEncoding('utf8');
   19868| 00077|         res.on('data', (d: string) => { buf += d; if (buf.length > 100000) res.destroy(); });
   19869| 00078|         res.on('end', () => { const hdrs = Object.entries(res.headers).slice(0,8).map(([k,v])=>`${k}: ${v}`).join('\n'); resolve(`HTTP ${res.statusCode} ${res.statusMessage}\n${hdrs}\n\n${buf.trim().slice(0,8000)}`); });
   19870| 00079|         res.on('error', (e: Error) => resolve(`回應錯誤: ${e.message}`));
   19871| 00080|       });
   19872| 00081|       req.on('error', (e: Error) => resolve(`網路錯誤: ${e.message}`));
   19873| 00082|       req.setTimeout(reqTimeout, () => { req.destroy(); resolve(`超時 (${reqTimeout}ms)`); });
   19874| 00083|       if (bodyBuf) req.write(bodyBuf);
   19875| 00084|       req.end();

   19943| 00152|   private _runPyScript(code: string, cwd: string, timeout: number, transform: (raw:string)=>string): Promise<string> {
   19944| 00153|     const tmp = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `ami_net_py_${Date.now()}.py`);
   19945| 00154|     try {
   19946| 00155|       fs.writeFileSync(tmp, code, 'utf-8');
   19947| 00156|       return new Promise<string>(resolve => {
   19948| 00157|         const cmds = process.platform==='win32' ? ['py','python','python3'] : ['python3','python'];
   19949| 00158|         let tried = 0;
   19950| 00159|         const tryNext = () => {
   19951| 00160|           if (tried >= cmds.length) { resolve('錯誤：找不到 Python'); return; }
   19952| 00161|           const c = cmds[tried++];
   19953| 00162|           (require('child_process') as typeof import('child_process')).exec(`${c} "${tmp}"`, { cwd: cwd||process.cwd(), timeout }, (_e, o, e) => {
   19954| 00163|             if (_e && (_e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code==='ENOENT') { tryNext(); return; }
   19955| 00164|             resolve(transform((o||e||'').trim()));
   19956| 00165|           });
   19957| 00166|         };
   19958| 00167|         tryNext();
   19959| 00168|       });
   19960| 00169|     } finally { try { fs.unlinkSync(tmp); } catch { /* ignore */ } }
   19961| 00170|   }
   19962| 00171| }

   19981| 00016| /** When output exceeds threshold, save to .amiclaw/outputs/ and return preview + path. */
   19982| 00017| function _persistIfLarge(out: string, prefix: string, wsRoot: string): string {
   19983| 00018|   if (out.length <= OUTPUT_PERSIST_THRESHOLD) return out;
   19984| 00019|   const dir = path.join(wsRoot, '.amiclaw', 'outputs');
   19985| 00020|   try {
   19986| 00021|     fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
   19987| 00022|     const fname = `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}.txt`;
   19988| 00023|     const fpath = path.join(dir, fname);
   19989| 00024|     fs.writeFileSync(fpath, out, 'utf8');
   19990| 00025|     const lines = out.split('\n').length;
   19991| 00026|     return (
   19992| 00027|       out.slice(0, 4000) +
   19993| 00028|       `\n\n…[輸出已持久化至磁碟，共 ${out.length} 字元 / ${lines} 行]\n` +
   19994| 00029|       `路徑: ${fpath}\n` +
   19995| 00030|       `讀取方式: read_file_smart(path="${fpath}", tail=100) 或指定 start_line/end_line`
   19996| 00031|     );
   19997| 00032|   } catch {
   19998| 00033|     return out.slice(0, 8000) + '\n…（輸出過長已截斷）';
   19999| 00034|   }
   20000| 00035| }

   20120| 00024|   private async _searchWorkspace(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
   20121| 00025|     const query = ((args.query as string) ?? '').toLowerCase();
   20122| 00026|     if (!query) return '請提供搜尋關鍵字';
   20123| 00027|     const allUris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles('**/*', '{**/node_modules/**,**/.git/**,**/out/**,**/dist/**}', 200);
   20124| 00028|     const fileMatches = allUris.map(u => u.fsPath).filter(p => path.basename(p).toLowerCase().includes(query));
   20125| 00029|     const contentMatches: string[] = [];
   20126| 00030|     for (const uri of allUris) {
   20127| 00031|       if (contentMatches.length >= 40) break;
   20128| 00032|       try {
   20129| 00033|         if (SKIP_BINARY.has(path.extname(uri.fsPath).toLowerCase())) continue;
   20130| 00034|         const bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri);
   20131| 00035|         const lines = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8').split('\n');
   20132| 00036|         for (let li = 0; li < lines.length && contentMatches.length < 40; li++) {
   20133| 00037|           if (lines[li].toLowerCase().includes(query)) {
   20134| 00038|             contentMatches.push(`${uri.fsPath}:${li + 1}: ${lines[li].trim().slice(0, 120)}`);
   20135| 00039|           }
   20136| 00040|         }
   20137| 00041|       } catch { /* skip binary */ }
   20138| 00042|     }
   20139| 00043|     const parts: string[] = [];
   20140| 00044|     if (fileMatches.length > 0)   parts.push(`=== 檔案名稱匹配 (${fileMatches.length}) ===\n${fileMatches.slice(0, 30).join('\n')}`);
   20141| 00045|     if (contentMatches.length > 0) parts.push(`=== 程式碼內容匹配 (${contentMatches.length}) ===\n${contentMatches.join('\n')}`);
   20142| 00046|     return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join('\n\n') : `找不到符合 "${args.query}" 的結果`;
   20143| 00047|   }

   20145| 00049|   private async _searchRegex(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
   20146| 00050|     const pattern = (args.pattern as string || '').trim();
   20147| 00051|     if (!pattern) return '請提供 pattern 參數';
   20148| 00052|     const reFlags = ((args.flags as string) || 'i').replace(/[^imu]/g, '');
   20149| 00053|     let regex: RegExp;
   20150| 00054|     try { regex = new RegExp(pattern, reFlags); } catch (e) { return `無效的正規表達式: ${e}`; }
   20151| 00055|     const allUris = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(
   20152| 00056|       (args.include as string) || '**/*',
   20153| 00057|       '{**/node_modules/**,**/.git/**,**/out/**,**/dist/**}', 500);
   20154| 00058|     const matches: string[] = [];
   20155| 00059|     for (const uri of allUris) {
   20156| 00060|       if (matches.length >= 100) break;
   20157| 00061|       try {
   20158| 00062|         if (['.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.ico','.vsix','.zip','.exe','.dll','.pdf','.wasm'].includes(path.extname(uri.fsPath).toLowerCase())) continue;
   20159| 00063|         const lines = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri)).toString('utf8').split('\n');
   20160| 00064|         for (let li = 0; li < lines.length && matches.length < 100; li++) {
   20161| 00065|           if (regex.exec(lines[li]) !== null) matches.push(`${uri.fsPath}:${li + 1}: ${lines[li].trim().slice(0, 120)}`);
   20162| 00066|         }
   20163| 00067|       } catch { /* skip binary */ }
   20164| 00068|     }
   20165| 00069|     return matches.length > 0
   20166| 00070|       ? `=== RegExp /${pattern}/${reFlags} 匹配 (${matches.length}) ===\n${matches.join('\n')}`
   20167| 00071|       : `找不到符合 /${pattern}/${reFlags} 的結果`;
   20168| 00072|   }

   20170| 00074|   private async _agenticSearch(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
   20171| 00075|     const afQuery = ((args.query as string) ?? '').trim();
   20172| 00076|     if (!afQuery) return '請提供 query 參數';
   20173| 00077|     const wsRoot   = (vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [])[0]?.uri.fsPath ?? '';
   20174| 00078|     const afTopK   = Math.min(Math.max(Number(args.top_k) || 10, 1), 30);
   20175| 00079|     const stopWords = new Set(['的','在','裡','中','使用','處理','負責','找出','哪個','檔案','函式','類別','實作','實現','相關','所有','一個','如何','為何','what','which','file','for','the','and','or','that','with','from','this','how','where','when']);
   20176| 00080|     const keywords  = afQuery.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, '$1 $2').replace(/[_\-./]/g, ' ').toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length >= 2 && !stopWords.has(w));
   20177| 00081|     const declRe    = /^\s*(?:export\s+)?(?:(?:async\s+)?function\*?\s+([\w$]+)|class\s+([\w$]+)|interface\s+([\w$]+)|type\s+([\w$]+)\s*(?:<[^>]*>)?\s*=|(?:const|let|var)\s+([\w$]+)\s*(?::[^=]+)?=\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:\([^)]*\)|[\w$]+)\s*=>|def\s+([\w_]+)|func\s+([\w_]+)\s*\(|public\s+(?:static\s+)?\S+\s+([\w_]+)\s*\(|EFIAPI\s+([\w_]+)\s*\(|^\[([A-Za-z][\w.]+)\])/;
   20178| 00082|     const allUris   = await vscode.workspace.findFiles(
   20179| 00083|       (args.include as string) || '**/*.{ts,js,tsx,jsx,py,cs,java,go,rs,cpp,c,h,inf,dec,dsc,fdf,uni,nasm,asm,asl,vue,svelte}',
   20180| 00084|       '{**/node_modules/**,**/.git/**,**/out/**,**/dist/**,**/build/**}', 1000);
   20181| 00085|     const scores: { rel: string; score: number; decls: string[] }[] = [];
   20182| 00086|     for (const uri of allUris) {
   20183| 00087|       if (SKIP_BINARY.has(path.extname(uri.fsPath).toLowerCase())) continue;
   20184| 00088|       const rel = path.relative(wsRoot, uri.fsPath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
   20185| 00089|       let score = keywords.reduce((s, kw) => s + (rel.toLowerCase().includes(kw) ? 3 : 0), 0);
   20186| 00090|       const decls: string[] = [];
   20187| 00091|       try {
   20188| 00092|         const text  = Buffer.from(await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(uri)).toString('utf8').slice(0, 60000);
   20189| 00093|         const lines = text.split('\n');
   20190| 00094|         for (let li = 0; li < lines.length; li++) {
   20191| 00095|           const m = declRe.exec(lines[li]);
   20192| 00096|           if (m) { const d = m.slice(1).find(Boolean) ?? ''; if (d) decls.push(`L${li+1} ${d}`); }
   20193| 00097|         }
   20194| 00098|         const cl = text.toLowerCase();
   20195| 00099|         score += keywords.reduce((s, kw) => s + Math.min((cl.match(new RegExp(kw.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g')) || []).length, 5), 0);
   20196| 00100|         score += decls.reduce((s, d) => s + keywords.reduce((ss, kw) => ss + (d.toLowerCase().includes(kw) ? 4 : 0), 0), 0);
   20197| 00101|       } catch { /* skip binary */ }
   20198| 00102|       if (score > 0 || decls.length > 0) scores.push({ rel, score, decls });
   20199| 00103|     }
   20200| 00104|     scores.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
   20201| 00105|     const top = scores.slice(0, afTopK);
   20202| 00106|     if (top.length === 0) return `找不到與「${afQuery}」相關的檔案`;
   20203| 00107|     return `=== 語意搜尋「${afQuery}」結果 (前 ${top.length}/${scores.length} 個相關檔案) ===\n${top.map((f, i) => `${i+1}. ${f.rel} (相關度:${f.score})${f.decls.length > 0 ? `\n  宣告: ${f.decls.slice(0, 20).join(', ')}${f.decls.length > 20 ? ` …(+${f.decls.length-20})` : ''}` : ''}`).join('\n')}`;
   20204| 00108|   }
   20205| 00109| }

   20242| 00034|   private async _vscodeAction(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): Promise<string> {
   20243| 00035|     const wsRoot = (vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [])[0]?.uri.fsPath ?? '';
   20244| 00036|     const resolvePath = (p: string) => path.isAbsolute(p) ? p : path.join(wsRoot, p);
   20245| 00037|     const action = (args.action as string) || '';
   20246| 00038|     if (action === 'open_file') {
   20247| 00039|       const fpath = resolvePath(args.path as string || '');
   20248| 00040|       const doc = await vscode.workspace.openTextDocument(vscode.Uri.file(fpath));
   20249| 00041|       const editor = await vscode.window.showTextDocument(doc, { preview: true });
   20250| 00042|       if (args.line) {
   20251| 00043|         const pos = new vscode.Position(Math.max(0, Number(args.line) - 1), 0);
   20252| 00044|         editor.selection = new vscode.Selection(pos, pos);
   20253| 00045|         editor.revealRange(new vscode.Range(pos, pos), vscode.TextEditorRevealType.InCenter);
   20254| 00046|       }
   20255| 00047|       return `已開啟 ${fpath}${args.line ? ` 第 ${args.line} 行` : ''}`;
   20256| 00048|     }
   20257| 00049|     if (action === 'get_workspace_info') {
   20258| 00050|       const wsFolders = vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders ?? [];
   20259| 00051|       const openDocs  = vscode.workspace.textDocuments.filter(d => !d.isUntitled && d.uri.scheme === 'file');
   20260| 00052|       return `工作區: ${wsFolders.map(f => f.uri.fsPath).join(', ') || '(none)'}\n開啟中檔案:\n${openDocs.map(d => d.uri.fsPath).join('\n') || '(none)'}`;
   20261| 00053|     }
   20262| 00054|     if (action === 'show_notification') {
   20263| 00055|       vscode.window.showInformationMessage(String(args.message ?? ''));
   20264| 00056|       return '已顯示通知';
   20265| 00057|     }
   20266| 00058|     if (action === 'run_command') {
   20267| 00059|       await vscode.commands.executeCommand(args.command as string, ...(Array.isArray(args.args) ? args.args : []));
   20268| 00060|       return `已執行 VS Code 指令: ${args.command}`;
   20269| 00061|     }
   20270| 00062|     return `未知 vscode_action: ${action}`;
   20271| 00063|   }

   20273| 00065|   private _manageTodo(args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolExecutionContext): string {
   20274| 00066|     const action = (args.action as string) || 'list';
   20275| 00067|     if (action === 'add') {

   20277| 00069|       if (!text) return '請提供 todo 內容 (text 參數)';

   20279| 00071|       ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'agentTodoUpdate', todos: [...this._todos] });

   20281| 00073|     }
   20282| 00074|     if (action === 'done') {
   20283| 00075|       const id   = Number(args.id);
   20284| 00076|       const item = this._todos.find(t => t.id === id);

   20286| 00078|       item.done = true;
   20287| 00079|       ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'agentTodoUpdate', todos: [...this._todos] });

   20289| 00081|     }
   20290| 00082|     if (action === 'clear') {
   20291| 00083|       this._todos = [];
   20292| 00084|       ctx.callbacks.postToWebview({ type: 'agentTodoUpdate', todos: [] });
   20293| 00085|       return 'Todo 清單已清空';
   20294| 00086|     }
   20295| 00087|     if (this._todos.length === 0) return 'Todo 清單是空的，請先用 add 新增任務';
   20296| 00088|     return this._todos.map(t => `${t.done ? '✅' : '⏳'} #${t.id}: ${t.text}`).join('\n');

   20417| 00116| test('source template does not contain raw newline escapes in inline script strings', () => {
   20418| 00117|   const sourcePath = path.resolve(__dirname, 'WebviewRenderer.ts');
   20419| 00118|   const source = fs.readFileSync(sourcePath, 'utf8');
   20420| 00119|   const templateStart = source.indexOf('return `<!doctype html>');
   20421| 00120|   const templateEnd = source.lastIndexOf('`;');
   20422| 00121| 
   20423| 00122|   assert.ok(templateStart !== -1, 'should find HTML template start');
   20424| 00123|   assert.ok(templateEnd !== -1 && templateEnd > templateStart, 'should find HTML template end');
   20425| 00124| 
   20426| 00125|   const template = source.slice(templateStart, templateEnd);
   20427| 00126|   const rawEscapeLines = template
   20428| 00127|     .split(/\r?\n/)
   20429| 00128|     .map((line, index) => ({ lineNumber: index + 1, line }))
   20430| 00129|     .filter(({ line }) => /(?<!\\)\\[nr]/.test(line));
   20431| 00130| 
   20432| 00131|   assert.deepEqual(
   20433| 00132|     rawEscapeLines,
   20434| 00133|     [],
   20435| 00134|     'inline webview JS must use \\\\n / \\\\r inside the outer TypeScript template literal'
   20436| 00135|   );
   20437| 00136| });

   21228| 00788|       function modelSupportsThinking(modelId, label) {
   21229| 00789|         function check(s) {
   21230| 00790|           if (!s) return false;
   21231| 00791|           var raw = String(s).toLowerCase();
   21232| 00792|           // strip provider prefixes and ollama multi-server encoding
   21233| 00793|           raw = raw.replace(/^copilot::/, '');
   21234| 00794|           if (raw.indexOf('openai::') === 0) { var pp = raw.indexOf('||'); raw = pp !== -1 ? raw.slice(pp + 2) : raw.slice(8); }
   21235| 00795|           var sp = raw.indexOf('||'); if (sp !== -1) raw = raw.slice(sp + 2);
   21236| 00796|           if (raw.charAt(0) === '[') { var rb = raw.indexOf(']'); if (rb !== -1) raw = raw.slice(rb + 1).replace(/^\\s+/, ''); }
   21237| 00797|           // check for reasoning models (o1/o3/o4 series and thinking/reasoning keywords)
   21238| 00798|           if (raw.indexOf('thinking') !== -1 || raw.indexOf('reasoning') !== -1) return true;
   21239| 00799|           var _rm = raw.replace(/^[a-z0-9]+[/:._-]/, ''); // strip prefix for shortname check
   21240| 00800|           if (_rm.indexOf('o1') === 0 || _rm.indexOf('o3') === 0 || _rm.indexOf('o4') === 0) return true;
   21241| 00801|           if (raw.indexOf('/o1') !== -1 || raw.indexOf('/o3') !== -1 || raw.indexOf('/o4') !== -1) return true;
   21242| 00802|           if (raw.indexOf(':o1') !== -1 || raw.indexOf(':o3') !== -1 || raw.indexOf(':o4') !== -1) return true;
   21243| 00803|           // strip hf.co/<user>/ prefix and any path prefix for shortname check
   21244| 00804|           var m = raw;
   21245| 00805|           if (raw.indexOf('hf.co/') !== -1) { var hfSlash = raw.lastIndexOf('/'); m = hfSlash !== -1 ? raw.slice(hfSlash + 1) : raw; }

   21247| 00807|           if (m.indexOf('coder') !== -1 || m.indexOf('-instruct') !== -1 || m.indexOf(':instruct') !== -1) return false;
   21248| 00808|           return m.indexOf('deepseek-r1') === 0 || m.indexOf('deepseek-r2') === 0 ||
   21249| 00809|             m.indexOf('qwq') === 0 ||

   22469| 02029|       function renderInline(txt) {
   22470| 02030|         // 先跳脫 HTML，再套用 inline 語法
   22471| 02031|         txt = escHtml(txt);

   22475| 02035|         // $...$ → 行內數學

   22540| 02100|       // -- parseBlocks + makeCodeBlock + highlightCode --------------------------
   22541| 02101|       function parseBlocks(text) {

   22543| 02103|         var parts = []; var rest = text;
   22544| 02104|         while (true) {
   22545| 02105|           var s = rest.indexOf(TICK);
   22546| 02106|           if (s === -1) { if (rest) parts.push({ t: 'text', v: rest }); break; }
   22547| 02107|           if (s > 0) parts.push({ t: 'text', v: rest.slice(0, s) });
   22548| 02108|           rest = rest.slice(s + 3);
   22549| 02109|           var nl = rest.indexOf('\\n');
   22550| 02110|           var lang = nl !== -1 ? rest.slice(0, nl).trim() : '';
   22551| 02111|           if (nl !== -1) rest = rest.slice(nl + 1);
   22552| 02112|           var e = rest.indexOf(TICK);

   22555| 02115|           rest = e !== -1 ? rest.slice(e + 3) : '';
   22556| 02116|         }
   22557| 02117|         return parts.length ? parts : [{ t: 'text', v: text }];
   22558| 02118|       }

   24175| 03735|       // ── Permission dialog ───────────────────────────────────────────────
   24176| 03736|       var _currentPermCategory = '';
   24177| 03737|       function buildUnifiedDiff(before, after) {
   24178| 03738|         var NO_BEFORE = !before && after;
   24179| 03739|         var bLines = NO_BEFORE ? [] : (before || '').split('\\n');
   24180| 03740|         var aLines = (after  || '').split('\\n');
   24181| 03741|         var result = [];
   24182| 03742|         var LIMIT = 300;
   24183| 03743|         var bi = 0, ai = 0;
   24184| 03744|         while (bi < bLines.length || ai < aLines.length) {
   24185| 03745|           if (result.length >= LIMIT) { result.push({ t: '~', s: '... (' + (bLines.length + aLines.length - bi - ai) + ' more lines)' }); break; }
   24186| 03746|           var bl = bi < bLines.length ? bLines[bi] : null;
   24187| 03747|           var al = ai < aLines.length ? aLines[ai] : null;
   24188| 03748|           if (bl === null) { result.push({ t: '+', s: al }); ai++; }
   24189| 03749|           else if (al === null) { result.push({ t: '-', s: bl }); bi++; }
   24190| 03750|           else if (bl === al) { result.push({ t: ' ', s: bl }); bi++; ai++; }
   24191| 03751|           else { result.push({ t: '-', s: bl }); result.push({ t: '+', s: al }); bi++; ai++; }
   24192| 03752|         }
   24193| 03753|         // Trim context: only keep lines near changes (+/-)
   24194| 03754|         var CTX = 3;
   24195| 03755|         var keep = {};
   24196| 03756|         for (var ri = 0; ri < result.length; ri++) {
   24197| 03757|           if (result[ri].t !== ' ') {
   24198| 03758|             for (var d = -CTX; d <= CTX; d++) { if (ri + d >= 0 && ri + d < result.length) keep[ri + d] = true; }
   24199| 03759|           }
   24200| 03760|         }
   24201| 03761|         var trimmed = [], lastKept = -1;
   24202| 03762|         for (var ri = 0; ri < result.length; ri++) {
   24203| 03763|           if (keep[ri]) {
   24204| 03764|             if (lastKept >= 0 && ri > lastKept + 1) trimmed.push({ t: '~', s: '' });
   24205| 03765|             trimmed.push(result[ri]);
   24206| 03766|             lastKept = ri;
   24207| 03767|           }
   24208| 03768|         }
   24209| 03769|         return trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : [{ t: ' ', s: '(no changes)' }];
   24210| 03770|       }
